zhes rbad cing bskul lo: bzhi pa nya bo dgug pa ni: hūm̐ */ sangs rgyas bstan la rab zhugs shing : byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas: dus gsum rgyal pa'i gdung 'tshob pa'i: rig 'dzin rnal 'byor rnams la ni: gnod cing gdug pa'i dgra dang bgegs: bdud dang bar du gcod pa dang : dngos grub 'phrog cing 'tshe ba rnams: khro bo chen po'i byin rlabs dang : gsang sngags drag po'i mthu stobs kyis: yud tsam zhig la 'dir khug la: mngon spyod tshul bzhin bsgral ba dang : lus ngag rdul du bshig nas kyang : sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar gyis: nga yi dbang du gyur nas kyang : bsgo ba'i bka' la nyan par gyis: bcom ldan rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha: 'di na gnag pa'i las yod kyi: bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs: skyod cig yum gyi mkha' nas skyod: dam tshig can gyi thugs dam bskul: lcags kyu can gyis snying nas zung : zhags pa can gyis yan lag chings: lcags sgrog can gyis lus can sdoms: dril bu can gyis rdul du rlogs: mthu dang rdzu 'phrul 'phrog nas kyang : mgon skyabs grogs dang bral bar mdzod: bla srog rnam shes gzugs la phob: zung zhig rgyob cig rnam par chings: rings par khug la smyor chug cig: lus ngag rdul du brlags nas kyang : gzugs phung rngams pa'i zhal du stobs: pho nya kun gyis phrin las mdzod: ces brjod: lnga pa bden pa brjod pa ni: lag pa lcags kyu'i phyag rgya byas la: na mo/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ rigs sngags dang*/ gzungs sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par du bcom ldan 'das rgyal pa zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs khro bo khro mo yab yum sprul pa bka' sdod pho nya chos skyong srung ma rnams thugs rje dang phrin las thogs pa med pa'i bka' bden pa dang*/

bden pa chen po de'i byin rlabs kyis/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che bshig pa/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smod pa/ bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba/ dam nyams pa'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad skad cig yud tsam zhig la gzugs liṅga ru bris shing*/ ming byang bu ru btab pa 'di la khug cig: badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐: badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ: badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭe hoḥ ā we sha ya a: zhes dang*/ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ sogs dang*/ de bzhin du/ dgra bgegs a pā na ya a pā na ya: ha sa na ya ha sa na ya: ā we sha ya ā we sha ya: shri trin ha na ya shri trin ha na ya: dz+wa la pa ya dz+wa la pa ya: ta thā ya ta thā ya: bhan+dha ya bhan+dha ya: zhes brjod: drug pa phur skor bya ba ni: hūm̐ */ chos kyi dbyings las rang byung grub pa'i lha: khrag 'thung rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: shin tu mi bzad rab 'jigs skur ston pa: dpal chen drag po'i phrin las mdzod: dpal chen khrag 'thung he ru kaḥ yab yum sras 'khor sprul par bcas: g.yas g.yon thabs shes phur bu sgril: sras mchog rigs kyi phur bu 'di: thogs med rang byung lhun gyis grub: sgril ba tsam gyis lha yang 'dar: rdeg pa tsam gyis srid gsum g.yo: btab na khams gsum thal bar rlog: btab bo theb par mdzod cig kī la ya: dgra bgegs 'byung po sgrol cig mā ra ya: hūm̐ */ yon tan rgyud las byung ba yi: yang dag thugs kyi sprul pa ste: 'debs byed las kyi phur bu 'bum: srid gsum byad ma'i snying la thob: kī la ya yi sgra sgrog pa: srid pa'i phur bu bdag gis bskul: bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: zhes phur bu btab bo: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ha ho phaṭa ni ma tsit+ta ma: rdul phran rdul phran: keṃ keṃ rak+ta ma ri tsit+ta snying la shad shad: tshin+dha ma rus la keṃ keṃ: ru tri sha la rbad: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

dbugs la hub hub: āḥhūm̐ he ma mo bh+yo dzaḥ dgra bgegs a mu kaṃ mā ra ya rbad: ces brjod do: bdun pa dmar sbreng ba ni: hūm̐ */ nyon mongs 'khor ba dbyings su bsgral ba'i phyir: 'khor ba'i rtsa ba nyon mongs gzung 'dzin khrag: dug gsum ru tra bsgral ba'i rak+ta'i rgyun: dung chen snod du dmar chen ar+ghaṃ sbyar: dpal chen khrag 'thung 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: khams gsum yongs sgrol dpa' bo chen po yis: dug lnga chags pa'i khrag gi mtsho la rol: gzung 'dzin chags pas mnar ba'i dgra bo rnams: chags med bde chen sa la 'god par shog: ma hā mū la rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi: zhes brjod do: brgyad pa bstab pa bya ba ni: hūm̐ */ bstab bo bstab bo zhal du bstab: yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs zhal phyes shig: nam mkha' gang ba'i zhal phye la: ri rab tsam gyi mche ba gtsigs: bar snang gang ba'i ljags sgril cig: chos dbyings stong nyid lto ba ru: mchod rdzas dgra bgegs zhal du bstab: zhal du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi: mgul du bsgril lo ā ra li: dbyings su bstim mo sa ma ya: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa: dgra bgegs 'byung po sarba bi na ya: sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ sha trūṃ ma hā maṃ sa la khā hi: ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: ma hā keṃ ni ri ti la khā hi: ma hā tsit+ta la khā hi: ma hā ba su ta la khā hi: ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi: ma hā tsak+ṣuḥl khā hi: zhes dbul lo: dgu pa bzlog pa'i phrin las gzhung bsrang ba ni: hūm̐ */ bcom ldan dpal chen badz+ra he ru kaḥ rdo rje khrag 'thung dbang du sdud pa dang : dam nyams 'di yi rnam shes da rol la: rdo rje khrag 'thung pho nya'i tshogs rnams zlog: gti mug dpal chen bud+dha he ru kaḥ bud+dha khrag 'thung dbang du sdud pa dang : dam nyams 'di yi gzugs phung da rol la: de bzhin khrag 'thung pho nya'i tshogs rnams zlog: nga rgyal dpal chen rat+na he ru kaḥ rin chen khrag 'thung dbang du sdud pa dang :

dam nyams 'di yi tshor ba'i phung po rol: rin chen khrag 'thung pho nya'i tshogs rnams zlog: 'dod chags dpal chen pad+ma he ru kaḥ pad+ma khrag 'thung dbang du sdud pa dang : dam nyams 'di yi 'du shes phung po rol: pad+ma khrag 'thung pho nya'i tshogs rnams zlog: phrag dog khrag 'thung karma he ru kaḥ las kyi khrag 'thung dbang du sdud pa dang : dam nyams 'di yi 'du byed phung po rol: karma khrag 'thung pho nya'i tshogs rnams zlog: yum chen badz+ra kro dhī shwa rī mas: dam nyams 'di yi bkrag dang mdangs la rol: rdo rje rigs kyi sprul pa'i tshogs rnams zlog: yum chen bud+dha kro dhī shwa rī mas: dam nyams 'di yi sha dang rus la rol: de bzhin rigs kyi sprul pa'i tshogs rnams zlog: yum chen rat+na kro dhī shwa rī mas: dam nyams 'di yi drod la da rol la: rin chen rigs kyi sprul pa'i tshogs rnams zlog: yum chen pad+ma kro dhī shwa rī mas: dam nyams 'di yi khrag dang chu la rol: pad+ma rigs kyi sprul pa'i tshogs rnams zlog: yum chen karma kro dhī shwa rī mas: dam nyams 'di yi dbugs dang rlung la rol: las kyi rigs kyi sprul pa'i tshogs rnams zlog: rdo rje rigs kyi pho nya chen po ste: phog par rgyob cig ma mo kau rī ma: rdo rje can gyi pho nya'i tshogs rnams zlog: rin chen rigs kyi bshan pa chen mo ste: snying la gzir cig ma mo tsau rī ma: mda' gzhu can gyi pho nya'i tshogs rnams zlog: pad+ma rigs kyi pho nya chen po ste: dbang du sdus shig ma mo pra mo ha: rgyal mtshan can gyi pho nya'i tshogs rnams zlog: las byed las kyi pho nya chen mo ste: rgyu zhags drongs shig ma mo bai tā lī: rgyu zhags can gyi pho nya'i tshogs rnams zlog: 'dod chags 'joms pa'i pho nya chen mo ste: glo snying drongs shig ma mo puk+ka sī: glo snying thogs pa'i pho nya'i tshogs rnams zlog: zhe sdang 'joms pa'i pho nya chen mo ste:

rak+ta 'thung zhig ma mo gasma rī: thod khrag can gyi pho nya'i tshogs rnams zlog: nga rgyal 'joms pa'i pho nya chen mo ste: tsit+ta phyung zhig ma mo sme sha ni: snying chen 'byin pa'i pho nya'i tshogs rnams zlog: phrag dog 'joms pa'i pho nya chen mo ste: mgo lus phrol zhig ma mo tsaṇ+ḍa lī: mgo lus 'phral ba'i pho nya'i tshogs rnams zlog: phyag na zhing gi mchog phran bsnams pa ste: sha la rol cig phra men singha ma: seng mgo can gyi pho nya'i tshogs rnams zlog: phyag mtshan phyag rgya brang khar bsnol ba ste: rus pa 'chos shig phra men byā gh+rī ma: stag mgo can gyi pho nya'i tshogs rnams zlog: phyag na pags chen ldag pa'i phra men ma: dgra bo'i pags chen bshus shig sri la ma: wa mgo can gyi pho nya'i tshogs rnams zlog: zas su sha chen za ba'i phra men ma: dgra bgegs sha chen zo zhig shwa na ma: spyang mgo can gyi pho nya'i tshogs rnams zlog: skom du thod khrag 'thung ba'i phra men ma: dgra yi dung khrag 'thung shig kṛ ta ma: bya rgod mgo can pho nya'i tshogs rnams zlog: zhing chen phrag la khur ba'i phra men ma: dgra bo'i pags chen bshus shig kaṃ ka ma: kaṃ ka'i mgo can pho nya'i tshogs rnams zlog: mig tshil 'byin pa'i pho nya chen mo ste: dgra yi mig tshil brus shig khwa khwa ma: sha za bya rog mgo can pho nya zlog: glo snying 'byin pa'i pho nya chen mo ste: dgra yi glo snying phyung zhig ul+lu ma: 'ug pa'i mgo can pho nya'i tshogs rnams zlog: nyon mongs sems can gnas nas 'dren mdzad ma: dgra yi snying nas drongs shig stag gdong ma: stag gdong can gyi pho nya'i tshogs rnams zlog: dgra bgegs yan lag 'ching mdzad zhags pa ma: dam nyams yan lag chings shig phag gdong ma: phag gdong can gyi pho nya'i tshogs rnams zlog: 'khor ba gnas su 'ching zhing sdom byed ma: dam nyams dgra bgegs sdoms shig spre'u gdong ma: spre'u gdong can gyi pho nya'i tshogs rnams zlog:

rnam par myos par rtog byed dril bu ma: dgra la sod cig rgyob cig spyang gdong ma: spyang gdong can gyi pho nya'i tshogs rnams zlog: bka' yi bstan pa bsrung ba'i las mdzad ma: srin mo chen mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyang : dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la: srin mo nyi shu brgyad kyi gdug rtsub zlog: gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs 'dir gshegs shig: mi sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dam nyams 'byung po 'di la da rol cig: ma hā maṃ sa la khā hi: ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: ma hā tsit+ta la khā hi: ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi: ma hā keṃ ni ri ti la khā hi: ma hā ba su ta la khā hi: ma hā tsak+ṣuḥl khā hi: ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā hi: ma hā ba ling+ta la khā hi: bcu pa bzlog cing bh+yos gdab pa ni: hūm̐ */ zlog byed khrag 'thung he ru kaḥ bh+yo zlog drag po'i dus la bab: sangs rgyas bstan zhugs rnal 'byor la: phyogs bcu kun nas gdug pa yi: bsam sbyor ngan pa'i rig sngags dang : sde brgyad dregs pa'i rigs sngags dang : snang srid lha 'dre'i rbod gtong dang : drang srong bka' yi dmod pa dang : ban bon 'dus pa'i sngags zor dang : gshin rje'i 'khor lo ma mo'i thun: klu yi mnan gtad pho nya'i zor: mthu brub byad dang mi kha ngan: lo zla zhag dang za ma'i skag: dus min 'chi ba la sogs rnams: byad ma dgra bgegs rnams la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo gnod pa'i bgegs la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo bar chad bdud la bh+yo: zhes dang phyag thal mo brdabs la: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa: rbad zor sarba bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: oṃ traka rak+sha rak+mo ni kha la kha tshe thun bh+yo: rak+mo rak+mo kha la kha tshe thun bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: dhir yam sarba sha trūṃ s+t+ra sa ka sbub cig sbub cig: tis phur nan: rbod zor sarba bh+yo zlog: badz+ra pra mo ha a lo ki lo:

ma ma dun bh+yo: gardza thun bh+yo zlog: he he sa ma ya bh+yo zlog: traka rak+sha sa ma ya bh+yo zlog: kha tang kha tang : ma thun bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: de ma kha li rak+sha tsit+ta rbad bh+yo zlog: de he sa ma ya: ma ma bh+yo bh+yo: hūm̐ ha he phaṭa bh+yo: tri ta ya mo ha ya: pra ha ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa: sa ma ya bh+yo: a ti pra ma ni: sa ra ṇa bh+yo: a la la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo: zlog zlog zlog: dam nyams dgra bo che ge mos btang ba'i phur kha zlog: zor kha zlog: byol kha zlog: dmod kha zlog: rbod gtong zlog: rbad kha zlog: mnan kha zlog: gtad kha zlog: khram kha zlog: rbad 'dre rbod gtong bsam pa ngan pa thams cad dgra la bh+yo bh+yo: zlog zlog: oṃ traka rak+sha kha 'dar nṛ rbad bh+yo: kha la dzaḥdun nṛ rbad bh+yo: nā ga shu tse nṛ rbad bh+yo: shan+tiṃ pa nṛ rbad bh+yo: ma nṛ rak+sha nṛ rbad bh+yo: yak+sha kha dun nṛ rbad bh+yo: kha dun tshal pa nṛ rbad bh+yo: hri tri dz+wa la nṛ rbad bh+yo: srid pa pho rgyud dregs pa'i chad pa dgra la bh+yo bh+yo: dza kha thun kha la yak+sha ya: du ra yak+sha snying la ya: khal tse nā ga srog la ya: kha sa ga sha rbad su ya: ma ma yak+sha khrag la ya: ha ri khā hi las la ya: rak+sha ya: shu'o rak+sha dbugs la ya: gh+raṃ bh+yo taṃ bh+yo las la ya: mo rgyud mkha' 'gro'i chad pa dgra la bh+yo: tri kha thun kha tse yak+sha rbad: ma ni dza la kha la rbad: ma nṛ rak+sha snying la rbad: bhi ri tsa ni gzugs la rbad: snying khrag dza la srog la rbad: a ka yak+sha srog la rbad: mā ra aṃ ku sha ya snying la rbad: ma ni rak+sha srog la rbad: klu gnyan dregs pa'i chad pa dgra la bh+yo bh+yo: dgra la thun bh+yo: dgra la byad bh+yo: dgra la zor bh+yo: dgra la pha bh+yo: dgra la ma bh+yo: dgra la ming po bh+yo: dgra la sring mo bh+yo: dgra la sngags bh+yo: dgra la bdud bh+yo: dgra la btsan bh+yo: dgra la rgyal po bh+yo: dgra la ma mo bh+yo: dgra la dri za bh+yo: dgra la gnod sbyin bh+yo: dgra la nā ga bh+yo:

dgra la gshin rje bh+yo: dgra la mu stegs bh+yo: dgra la rā hu la bh+yo: dgra la rmu bh+yo: byad ma dgra bo'i steng du bh+yo: byad ma dgra bo'i steng du zlog: byad ma dgra bo'i steng du nan: byad ma dgra bo'i kha thaṃ: byad ma dgra bo'i kā ya nan: byad ma dgra bo'i wāka nan: byad ma dgra bo'i tsit+ta nan: zhes bzlog cing bh+yos btab bo: bcu gcig pa zor bskul ba ni: hūm̐ */ bcom ldan dpal dgu 'bar ba yi: mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: hūm̐ */ shar phyogs pho nya rab 'bar ba: mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: hūm̐ */ lho phyogs pho nya rab 'bar ba: mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: hūm̐ */ nub phyogs pho nya rab 'bar ba: mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: hūm̐ */ byang phyogs pho nya rab 'bar ba: mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha pad+ma kro dhī shwa rī a hrīḥ badz+ra kī li kī la ya ma hā yak+sha kā la rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa:

badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ trika nan: e hur thuṃ dzaḥ mā ra ya rbad: sarba ru tra hriṃ hriṃ dza: sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ bh+yo: sha trūṃ hur thuṃ dzaḥ mā ra ya rbad: dgra bgegs dam sri nṛ tri rbad thuṃ: dha ra ya dha ra ya: mā ra ya mā ra ya: nā ga du tshin+dha tshin+dha: mi li mi li: ban+dha ban+dha: nā ga ni swā hā: hūm̐ ha he phaṭa bh+yo: hṛ da ya mo ha ya: pra ha ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa: a ti kra ma ni: sa ra ṇa bh+yo: a la la bh+yo: zlog zlog: ces brjod cing zor 'phang : bcu gnyis pa bcol dam bya ba ni: hūm̐ */ yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs la: dam nyams dgra bgegs 'byung po 'di: gsod cing bsgral bar bya ba'i phyir: mgo lus rgyan dang bcas pa 'bul: bcol lo gtad do gnyer du longs: lus ngag yid gsum rdul du rlogs: sha khrag gzugs kyi phung po shigs: rnam shes bde chen gnas su drongs: bzhes shig lhag ma med par mdzod: bcol lo gtad do gnyer du longs: zhes brjod do: bcu gsum pa smon lam gdab pa ni: hoḥ khrag 'thung rol pa'i dur khrod chen po na: yab badz+ra he ru kaḥ yum badz+ra kro dhī shwa rī ma: khrag 'thung rigs bzhi yab yum: kau rī la sogs gnas kyi ma mo brgyad: singha la sogs yul gyi phra men brgyad: stag gdong la sogs sgo ma bzhi: bka' srung srin mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad: khrag 'thung gi lha tshogs lnga bcu rtsa brgyad la phrin las gnyan po bcol ba ni: zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod la sogs pa'i phrin las rnam pa bzhi sgrub pa dang : rdo rje slob dpon mched dang lcam dral rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la bsrung zhing byin gyis brlab tu gsol: tshe ring ba dang : nad med pa dang : dpal 'byor longs spyod thams cad rgyas par mdzad du gsol: chag che nyam nga rbad 'dre rbod gtong rmis ltas mtshan ma ngan pa thams cad phyir zlog cig: bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra la rbad cing : gnod par byed pa'i bgegs rnams 'dul ba'i phrin las su bcol ba ni:

sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa: dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smod pa: rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku dgra: rnal 'byor pa'i sgos dgra: mched dang lcam dral gyi spyi dgra: rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi rkyen dgra: sems can yongs la 'tshe ba: snga dgra lag gis bdar ba: phyi dgra snying la bsams pa: da dgra dngos su 'khu ba: gzugs can gyi dgra: gzugs med kyi bgegs: bar gcod kyi rkyen: bsam pa ngan pa 'chang ba: sbyor ba rtsub mo ston pa'i byad ma dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad thal ba'i rdul du rlogs shig: sku gsung thugs kyi dbyings su gtad do: bcol ba'i las gyis shig: sgrub pa'i rtags phyung zhig: phrin las thams cad mngon sum du 'grub par mdzod cig: ces brjod do: ༈ /spyi don gsum pa 'jam dpal gyi zlog pa'i phrin las gzhung bsrang ba la yang bcu gsum ste: dang po gtor ma 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ */ 'jig rten snod du bcud rnams gtor mar bcas: snang srid thams cad mchod pa'i yo byad de: mdzes shing bkra bar bshams nas su: 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs 'khor bcas la: gnyis su med pa'i tshogs su 'bul: phung po'i snod du dbang po'i gtor mar bcas: dur khrod gzhal yas mchod pa'i yo byad de: mdzes shing bkra bar bshams nas su: 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs 'khor bcas la: gnyis su med pa'i tshogs su 'bul: bhan+dha lcang lor 'bru bcud gtor mar bcas: dri ro reg bya mchod pa'i yo byad de: mdzes shing bkra bar bshams nas su: 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs 'khor bcas la: gnyis su med pa'i tshogs su 'bul: mchog chen mchog phran sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga: mchod pa'i bye brag sna tshogs rnams: mdzes shing bkra bar bshams nas su: 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs 'khor bcas la: gnyis su med pa'i tshogs su 'bul: zhes dbul lo: gnyis pa spyir bskul ba ni: hūm̐ */ gshin rje rol pa'i dur khrod chen po na: bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje sbyor sgrol yum:

gshed bzhi sbyor sgrol phyogs skyong yab yum dang : sgo srung gshin rje bka' srung ging bdud sogs: 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs thugs dam can: mi mngon dbyings nas sku bzhengs thugs dam bskul: rmad byung rol pa'i sman raka gtor mas mchod: thugs dam rgyud bskul phrin las rnam bzhi mdzod: gsum pa dam can sgos su bskul ba ni: hūm̐ */ gri thogs ging gi thugs dam bskul: shar phyogs ging chen dkar po ni: sku la dung khrab dkar po gsol: phyag na dung gi ral gri bsnams: srog chod snying phyung sha rus gtub: hūm̐ */ lho phyogs ging chen ser po ni: sku la gser khrab ser po gsol: phyag na gser gyi ral gri bsnams: srog chod snying phyung sha rus gtub: hūm̐ */ nub phyogs ging chen dmar po ni: sku la bse khrab dmar po gsol: phyag na bse yi ral gri bsnams: srog chod snying phyung sha rus gtub: hūm̐ */ byang phyogs ging chen sngon po ni: sku la g.yu khrab sngon po gsol: phyag na g.yu yi ral gri bsnams: srog chod snying phyung sha rus gtub: hūm̐ */ khram thogs bdud kyi thugs dam bskul: shar bdud sngon po ral pa can: phyag na bdud kyi khram shing bsnams: dam nyams dgra bo khram la thob: khram bdag srog bdud mche ba can: phyag na bdud kyi khram shing bsnams: dam nyams dgra bo khram la thob: zla bdud rol po zhags pa can: phyag na bdud kyi khram shing bsnams: dam nyams dgra bo khram la thob: srog bdud gser gyi sta re can: phyag na bdud kyi khram shing bsnams: dam nyams dgra bo khram la thob: hūm̐ */ sho thogs rtsis pa'i thugs dam bskul: nyi ma dang po'i rtsis byed ging : dkar po lag na sho rde'u thogs: dam nyams dgra bo rtsis la thob: nyi ma gnyis pa'i rtsis byed ging : ser po lag na sho rde'u thogs: dam nyams dgra bo rtsis la thob: nyi ma gsum pa'i rtsis byed ging : dmar po lag na sho rde'u thogs: dam nyams dgra bo rtsis la thob:

nyi ma bzhi pa'i rtsis byed ging : sngon po lag na sho rde'u thogs: dam nyams dgra bo rtsis la thob: hūm̐ */ bshan pa bzhi yi thugs dam bskul: nad gtong ma mo'i bshan pa ni: gsod byed chen mo'i thugs dam bskul: bdud dang ḍā ki kun gyi bdag: nag mo chen mo kha gdangs ma: bshan pa dgra la rngams pa'i tshe: bshan pa gri thogs zings se zing : ma mo zor thogs chi li li: thun gyi ser ba sha ra ra: khrag gi bu yug thu lu lu: nad kyi na bun thibs se theb: ma mo'i bshan pa dgra la bh+yo: hūm̐ */ myos pa btsan gyi bshan pa ni: dmar mo 'jigs pa'i khro gtum can: spyan ni khrag gi mtsho 'khyil zhing : khrag gi kha chu tsa ra ra: dug gi rlangs pa thul lu lu: phyag na btsan mdung dmar po bsnams: btsan gyi bshan pa'i dus la bab: glen pa klu yi bshan pa ni: sku mdog mthing nag 'jigs pa la: sbrul gyi ral pas sa gzhi khengs: sku la sbrul gyi ber chen gsol: sbrul nag rlon pa'i sked ching can: phyag na sbrul zhags nag po thogs: sbrul gyi kha nas dug mda' rgyob: klu yi bshan pa'i dus la bab: gdug pa gza' yi bshan pa ni: sku mdog nag po tse re re: g.yas na mdung dar nag po phyar: g.yon na snying dang zhags pa bsnams: dar nag ru mtshon phyar ba'i tshe: bdud kyi dmag tshogs nyer re re: zhags pa nag po na ra ra: nag po srog la dbang byed pa: gza' yi bshan pa'i dus la bab: 'jam dpal sku yi bka' srung thugs dam bskul: dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: yid la gnag pa'i dgra bgegs myur du sgrol: ya ma rā dza sa do me ya: ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya: ya da yo ni ra ya k+ṣe ya: ya k+ṣe yats+tsha ni ra ma ya: thun ya: zhes rbad cing bskul lo: bzhi pa nya bo dgug pa ni: hūm̐ */ sangs rgyas bstan la rab zhugs shing : byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas: dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob pa'i: rig 'dzin rnal 'byor rnams la ni: gnod cing gdug pa'i dgra dang bgegs:

bdud dang bar du gcod pa dang : dngos grub 'phrog cing 'tshe ba rnams: khro bo chen po'i byin rlabs dang : gsang sngags drag po'i mthu stobs kyis: yud tsam zhig la 'dir khug cig: mngon spyod tshul bzhin bsgral ba dang : lus ngag rdul bzhin bshig nas kyang : sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar gyis: nga yi dbang du gyur nas kyang : bsgo ba'i bka' la nyan par gyis: bcom ldan rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha: 'di na gnag pa'i las yod kyi: bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs: skyod cig yum gyi mkha' nas skyod: dam tshig can gyi thugs dam bskul: lcags kyu can gyis snying nas zung : zhags pa can gyis mgul nas chings: lcags sgrog can gyis yan lag sdoms: dril bu can gyis rdul du rlogs: mthu dang rdzu 'phrul 'phrog nas kyang : mgon skyabs grogs dang bral bar gyis: bla srog rnam shes gzugs la phob: zung zhig rgyob cig rnam par chings: rings par khug la smyor chug cig: lus ngag rdul du brlags nas kyang : gzugs phung rngams pa'i zhal du stobs: pho nya kun gyis phrin las mdzod: ces brjod do: lnga pa bden stobs brjod pa ni: na mo/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ rigs sngags dang*/ gzungs sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par du bcom ldan 'das rgyal pa zhi khro rab 'byams 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs khro bo khro mo yab yum sprul pa bka' sdod pho nya chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi thugs rje dang phrin las thogs pa med pa'i bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po de'i byin rlabs kyis/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che bshig pa/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smod pa/ bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba/ dam nyams pa'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad skad cig yud tsam zhig la gzugs liṅga ru bris shing*/

ming byang bu ru btab pa 'di la khug cig: badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐: badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ: badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭe hoḥ ā we sha ya a: zhes dang*/ oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka ha na ma tha bhañdza hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ sogs dang*/ de bzhin du/ a pā na ya a pā na ya: ha sa na ya ha sa na ya: ā we sha ya ā we sha ya: shri trin ha na ya shri trin ha na ya: dz+wa la pa ya dz+wa la pa ya: ta thā ya ta thā ya: bhan+dha ya bhan+dha ya: zhes brjod: drug pa phur skor bya ba ni: hūm̐ */ chos kyi dbyings las rang byung grub pa'i lha: gshin rje rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: shin tu mi bzad rab 'jigs skur ston pa: dpal chen drag po'i 'phrin las mdzod: dpal chen rat+na he ru kaḥ yab yum sras 'khor sprul par bcas: g.yas g.yon thabs shes phur bu sgril: sras mchog rigs kyi phur bu 'di: thogs med rang byung lhun gyis grub: sgril ba tsam gyis lha yang 'dar: rdeg pa tsam gyis srid gsum g.yo: btab na khams gsum thal bar rlog: btab bo theb par mdzod cig kī la ya: dgra bgegs 'byung po sgrol cig mā ra ya: hūm̐ */ yon tan rgyud las byung ba yi: 'jam dpal sku yi sprul pa ste: 'debs byed las kyi phur bu 'bum: srid gsum byad ma'i snying la thob: kī la ya yi sgra sgrog pa: srid pa'i phur bu bdag gis bskul: bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: zhes phur bu btab bo: oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka ha na ma tha bhañdza hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ sa ma ya mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka ya ma rā dza ma mo e ka tsa ti dza dzaḥ traka rak+sha kha mun tra: snying kha rak+mo bh+yo bh+yo: rak+mo ke kaṃ dza dzaḥ kha la ma hi bh+yo: ya ya lon lon: snying kha rak+mo srog la bh+yo: oṃ ya mān+ta ka ya ma rā dza sa do me ya: ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya: ya da yo ni ra ya k+ṣe ya: ya k+ṣe yats+tsha ni ra ma ya dgra bgegs mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ rnal ma rnal te: srog la rngams: srog la mer: srog la chum:

thum pa'i thum pa'i: lcags kyi skra gcig mas dgra bo'i snying phyung zhig: mā ra ya rbad: ces brjod do: bdun pa dmar sbreng ba ni: hūm̐ */ nyon mongs 'khor ba dbyings su bsgral ba'i phyir: 'khor ba'i rtsa ba nyon mongs gzung 'dzin khrag: dug gsum ru tra bsgral ba'i rak+ta'i rgyun: dung chen snod du dmar chen ar+ghaṃ sbyar: dpal chen khrag 'thung 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: khams gsum yongs sgrol dpa' bo chen po yis: dug lnga chags pa'i khrag gi mtsho la rol: gzung 'dzin chags pas mnar ba'i dgra bo rnams: chags med bde chen sa la 'god par shog: ma hā mū la rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi: zhes so: brgyad pa bstab pa bya ba ni: hūm̐ */ bstab bo bstab bo zhal du bstab: 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs zhal phyes shig: nam mkha' gang ba'i zhal phye la: ri rab tsam gyi mche ba gtsigs: bar snang gang ba'i ljags sgril cig: chos dbyings stong nyid lto ba ru: mchod rdzas dgra bgegs zhal du bstab: zhal du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi: mgul du bsgril lo ā ra li: dbyings su bstim mo sa ma ya: oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka ha na ma tha bhañdza hūm̐ phaṭa: sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ sha trūṃ ma hā maṃ sa la khā hi: ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: ma hā keṃ ni ri ti la khā hi: ma hā tsit+ta la khā hi: ma hā ba su ta la khā hi: ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi: ma hā tsak+ṣuḥl khā hi: zhes dbul lo: dgu pa bzlog pa'i phrin las gzhung bsrang ba ni: ham̐'u */ thams cad dbang du sdud mdzad khro bo'i rje: sha khrag srog la dbang sgyur bdud kyi rje: dam nyams 'di yi sha khrag srog la rol: las kyi gshin rje'i pho nya'i tshogs rnams zlog: sbyor ba'i yum chen ma mo be tā lī/ ma bdud 'bum gyi bdag mo chen mo khyod: dam nyams dgra bgegs 'di yi khrag la rol: ma bdud nag mo'i pho nya'i tshogs rnams zlog: sgrol ba'i yum chen e ka tsa ti ma: dam can rnal 'byor yongs kyi dgra lha mo:

dam nyams dgra dgegs 'di yi snying la rol: sgrol byed sngags kyi pho nya'i tshogs rnams zlog: gshed chen gshin rje ya ma rā dza khyod: dam nyams dgra bgegs 'di yi mgo la rol: gshin rje'i pho nya'i tshogs rnams bzlog tu gsol: sbyor ba'i yum chen bdud kyi lcam gcig ma: dam nyams dgra bgegs 'di yi khrag la rol: bdud kyi pho nya'i tshogs rnams bzlog tu gsol: sgrol ba'i yum chen dpal gyi bka' nyan ma: dam nyams dgra bgegs 'di yi khrag la rol: dpal gyi pho nya'i tshogs rnams bzlog tu gsol: gshed chen gshin rje myos byed 'bar ba khyod: dam nyams dgra bgegs 'di yi yid dkrugs la: gshin rje'i srid pa'i dmag dpung tshogs rnams zlog: sbyor ba'i yum chen gtum mo dug hrul ma: dgra bgegs 'di yi snying khrag gtso la stob: ma mo pho nya'i tshogs rnams bzlog tu gsol: sgrol ba'i yum chen phyag bzhi khrag gi bdag: dam nyams dgra bgegs 'di yi snying khrag 'thung : khrag 'thung ma mo pho nya'i tshogs rnams zlog: gshed chen bdud po ār+ya me ru tse: dam nyams dgra bgegs khrag tu skyug tu chug: gshin rje bdud kyi pho nya'i tshogs rnams zlog: sbyor ba'i yum chen khro mo 'od zer can: dgra bgegs 'di yi snying khrag gtso la stob: khro mo pho nya'i tshogs rnams bzlog tu gsol: sgrol ba'i yum mchog gling bzhi gtsug 'byams ma: dgra bgegs 'di yi gzugs la da rol la: srid pa gling bzhi'i pho nya'i tshogs rnams zlog: gshed chen gnod sbyin ral pa tshar dgu khyod: dam nyams dgra bgegs 'di yi srog chod la: gshin rje gnod sbyin pho nya'i tshogs rnams zlog: sbyor ba'i yum chen nag mo re ma ti: dam nyams dgra bgegs khrag gi mtsho la rol: dpal ldan lha mo'i pho nya'i tshogs rnams zlog: sgrol ba'i yum chen srin mo mgo 'chang ma: dam nyams dgra bgegs rtsa khrag 'di rol la: srin mo pho nya'i tshogs rnams bzlog tu gsol:

steng gi phyogs nas gshin rje nag 'joms khyod: dam nyams dgra bgegs klad par da rol la: steng gi phyogs kyi gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol: steng gi phyogs nas gshin rje bya sangs khyod: dam nyams dgra bgegs 'di yi mgo la rol: steng gi lha gdon thams cad bzlog tu gsol: shar gyi phyogs nas kong rtse brag 'joms khyod: dam nyams dgra bgegs rus la da rol la: shar gyi gdon tshogs thams cad bzlog tu gsol: shar lho mtshams nas a wa glang mgo khyod: dam nyams dgra bgegs srog rtsa dmar nas drongs: shar lho mtshams kyi gdon tshogs thams cad zlog: lho yi phyogs nas gshin rje ya ba ti: dam nyams dgra bgegs rmugs shing 'thibs su chug: lha yi gdon tshogs thams cad bzlog tu gsol: lho nub mtshams nas gshin rje mig dmar khyod: dam nyams dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlog: lho nub mtshams kyi gdon tshogs thams cad zlog: nub kyi phyogs nas gshin rje dmigs pa khyod: dam nyams dgra bgegs skye 'chi'i rtsa ba gcod: nub kyi phyogs kyi gdon tshogs thams cad zlog: nub byang mtshams nas gshin rje tel pa khyod: dam nyams dgra bgegs ma lus zhal du rngub: nub byang mtshams kyi gdon tshogs thams cad zlog: byang gi phyogs nas gshin rje bdud 'joms khyod: dam nyams dgra bgegs gshin rje'i gnas su skyol: byang gi phyogs kyi gdon tshogs thams cad zlog: byang shar mtshams nas chos kyi rgyal po khyod: dam nyams dgra bgegs khram la 'debs par byed: byang shar mtshams kyi gdon tshogs thams cad zlog: 'og gi phyogs kyi gshin rje dmar po ni: dam nyams dgra bgegs ma lus dbang du sdud: 'og gi phyogs kyi gdon tshogs thams cad zlog: 'og gi phyogs nas gshin rje thod dbyug ni: dam nyams ma lus mgo lus 'phral bar gyis: steng gi phyogs nas nag mo ral gcig ma: dam nyams dgra la nad ngan sna tshogs thong : nag mo 'bum gyi bka' bsgyur dgra la zlog:

steng gi phyogs nas shel gyi gdong dgu ma: dam nyams dgra la rims nad char ltar phob: lha srin sde brgyad bka' bsgyur dgra la zlog: shar gyi phyogs nas ral gcig shel mig ma: dam nyams dgra la snying chu gzer nad thong : dri za pho mo'i bka' bsgyur dgra la zlog: shar lho mtshams nas dkar skya mche gtsigs ma: dam nyams dgra la 'go nad da thong la: drang srong pho mo'i bka' bsgyur dgra la zlog: lho yi phyogs nas dred kyi rngam stabs can: dam nyams dgra la rgyu gzer bshal nad thong : grul bum pho mo'i bka' bsgyur dgra la zlog: lho nub mtshams nas khrag gi ral gcig ma: dam nyams dgra yi sha khrag rlon pa zo: srin po pho mo'i bka' bsgyur dgra la zlog: nub kyi phyogs nas klu mo pus 'gro ma: dam nyams dgra la 'dze nad sna dgu thong : klu rgyal pho mo'i bka' bsgyur dgra la zlog: nub byang mtshams nas rlung lha spyan gsum ma: dam nyams dgra la brgyal nad smyo 'bog thong : rlung lha pho mo'i bka' bsgyur dgra la zlog: byang gi phyogs nas smug nag ral gcig ma: dam nyams dgra la lhog pa skem nad thong : gnod sbyin pho mo'i bka' bsgyur dgra la zlog: byang shar mtshams nas dmar mo 'od zer can: dam nyams dgra yi dbang po sdom par gyis: dbang ldan pho mo'i bka' bsgyur dgra la zlog: 'og gi phyogs nas dmar mo mgo dgu ma: dam nyams dgra la dmu chu skran nad thong : klu bdud pho mo'i bka' bsgyur dgra la zlog: 'og gi phyogs nas nag mo phag mgo ma: dam nyams dgra la bying nad 'thibs pa thong : sa bdag pho mo'i bka' bsgyur dgra la zlog: shar phyogs sgo ba bya rgod mgo bo can: dgra bo'i srog rtsa dmar nas 'dren par byed: 'gugs shing sdom pa'i phrin las dus la bab: lho yi sgo ba nag po stag mgo can: dam nyams dgra yi mgo lus 'ching bar byed: dgra bo 'gugs shing sgrol ba'i dus la bab: nub kyi sgo ba bse yi kaṃ ka'i mgo:

dam nyams dgra bo'i dbang po lnga sdom la: dgra bo sdom zhing zlog pa'i dus la bab: byang gi sgo ba spyang ki'i mgo bo can: dam nyams dgra bo thal ba'i rdul du rlogs: zlog cing gsod pa'i phrin las dus la bab: bka' dang bstan pa bsrung ba'i las mdzod cig: gri thogs ging dang khram thogs bdud bzhi dang : sho thogs rtsis pa srog gcod bshan pa'i tshogs: dam nyams dgra yi sha khrag 'di rol la: gdon dang dgra dang mi mthun rkyen rnams zlog: gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs 'dir gshegs la: mi sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dam nyams 'byung po 'di la da rol cig: ma hā maṃ sa la khā hi: ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: ma hā keṃ ni ri ti la khā hi: ma hā tsit+ta la khā hi: ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi: ma hā ba su ta la khā hi: ma hā tsak+ṣuḥkhā hi: ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā hi: ma hā ba ling+ta la khā hi: bcu pa bzlog cing bh+yos gdab pa ni: hūm̐ */ zlog byed dpal chen he ru kaḥ bh+yo zlog drag po'i dus la bab: sangs rgyas bstan zhugs rnal 'byor la: phyogs bcu kun nas gdug pa yi: bsam sbyor ngan pa'i rig sngags dang : sde brgyad dregs pa'i rig sngags dang : snang srid lha 'dre'i rbod gtong dang : drang srong bka' yi dmod pa dang : ban bon 'dus pa'i sngags zor dang : gshin rje'i 'khor lo ma mo'i thun: klu yi gtad mnan pho nya'i zor: mthu brub byad dang mi kha ngan: lo zla zhag dang za ma'i skag: dus min 'chi ba la sogs rnams: byad ma dgra bgegs rnams la zlog: bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo gnod pa'i bgegs la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo bar chad bdud la bh+yo: zhes pa dang : oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka ha na ma tha bhañdza hūm̐ phaṭa: rbod zor sarba bh+yo bh+yo: zlog zlog: oṃ ya ma rā tsa bh+yo zlog: sa do me ya bh+yo zlog: ya me do ru bh+yo zlog: ṇa yo da ya bh+yo zlog:

ya da yo ni bh+yo zlog: ra ya k+ṣe ya bh+yo zlog: ya k+ṣe yats+tsha bh+yo zlog: ni ra ma ya bh+yo zlog: ging ka ra ging ka ra bh+yo zlog: karma rak+sha hrīḥbh+yo bh+yo: zlog zlog: karma rak+sha hri ti ku ru kha kha baṃ bh+yo zlog: ha sha ru tra mā ra ya bh+yo zlog: ru tra thun ma bh+yo zlog: rak+sha thun ma bh+yo zlog: bdud tri ni ra zung bh+yo zlog: ya tri ni ra zung bh+yo zlog: tri tsha pa la ni ra zung bh+yo zlog: tshu shig tri ni ra zung bh+yo zlog: dun tri na tri shwa ma tri du na bh+yo zlog: ma tri dza dza bh+yo zlog: yang yang thing thing bh+yo zlog: mā ra ya tri dza bh+yo zlog: yang yang thing thing kro dha ni kro dha ni pa tra pa tra bh+yo zlog: shu la shu la bh+yo zlog: da sha grī ba da sha grī ba bh+yo zlog: yak+sha grī ba yak+sha grī ba bh+yo zlog: oṃ badz+ra dha ra li snying go chod bh+yo zlog: kha la za mun dha long dun snying bh+yo zlog: dha ra ya rbad bh+yo zlog: oṃ badz+ra khrag ti tig na rbad bh+yo zlog: oṃ badz+ra tsakra ru kra'i ra ya rbad bh+yo zlog: badz+ra shu tri da ra khri ya badz+ra hriṃ rbad su rbad su: rbad du rbad du: da ra ka sha sa ma ya bh+yo zlog: oṃ shrī sa ma ya mañdzu e ka du zlog: oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka ya ma rā dza bh+yo zlog: pra ma rā tsa bh+yo zlog: suṃ tri ra tsa bh+yo zlog: tri kar sha li bh+yo zlog: oṃ a kro rā tsa du ra na sa du ra snying la phril phril: a kro rā tsa tsi ta tsha ni: sha shi srog la rbad rbad: ya ya sgal pa ya tri dzaḥ dgra bo'i snying la kha thun rbad rbad: a kro te ka shrī mañdzu ya ma rā dza bh+yo zlog: oṃ a kro rā tsa kro ma ti sha sha traka thun bh+yo zlog: e ka pa ra na hriṃ hriṃ: du kha tshe du kha tshe bh+yo zlog: oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka ha na ha na haṃ'u phaṭa: ya ya bra bra mā ra ya: shrī kā la rū pa sha rbad: che ge mo nṛ tri bh+yo zlog: bdag la gnod byed dgra bo che ge mos btang ba'i phur kha zlog:

zor kha zlog: byol kha zlog: dmod kha zlog: rbad 'dre zlog: rbod gtong zlog: mnan kha zlog: gtad kha zlog: khram kha zlog: rbad 'dre rbod gtong bsam ngan thams cad dgra la bh+yo bh+yo: zlog zlog: oṃ traka rak+sha kha 'dar nṛ rbad bh+yo: kha la dza dun nṛ rbad bh+yo: nā ga shu tse nṛ rbad bh+yo: shan+tiṃ pa nṛ rbad bh+yo: ma nṛ rak+sha nṛ rbad bh+yo: yak+sha kha dun nṛ rbad bh+yo: kha dun tshal pa nṛ rbad bh+yo: hri tri dz+wa la nṛ rbad bh+yo: srid pa pho rgyud dregs pa'i chad pa dgra la bh+yo bh+yo bh+yoḥ dza kha thun kha la yak+sha ya: du ra yak+sha snying la ya: khal tse nā ga srog la ya: kha sa ga sha rbad su ya: ma ma yak+sha khrag la ya: ha ri khā hi las la ya: rak+sha ya: shu'o rak+sha dbugs la ya: gh+raṃ bh+yo taṃ bh+yo las la ya: mo rgyud mkha' 'gro'i chad pa dgra la bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo: tri kha thun kha tse yak+sha rbad: ma ni dza la kha la rbad: ma nṛ rak+sha snying la rbad: bhi ri tsa ni gzugs la rbad: snying khrag dza la srog la rbad: a ka yak+sha srog la rbad: mā ra aṃ ku sha ya snying la rbad: ma ni rak+sha srog la rbad: klu gnyan dregs pa'i chad pa dgra la bh+yo bh+yo: dgra la thun bh+yo: dgra la byad bh+yo: dgra la zor bh+yo: dgra la pha bh+yo: dgra la ma bh+yo: dgra la ming po bh+yo: dgra la sring mo bh+yo: dgra la sngags bh+yo: dgra la bdud bh+yo: dgra la btsan bh+yo: dgra la rgyal po bh+yo: dgra la ma mo bh+yo: dgra la dri za bh+yo: dgra la gnod sbyin bh+yo: dgra la nā ga bh+yo: dgra la gshin rje bh+yo: dgra la mu stegs bh+yo: dgra la rā hu la bh+yo: dgra la rmu bh+yo: byad ma dgra bo'i steng du bh+yo: byad ma dgra bo'i steng du zlog: byad ma dgra bo'i steng du nan: byad ma dgra bo'i kha tham: byad ma dgra bo'i kā ya nan: byad ma dgra bo'i wāka nan: byad ma dgra bo'i tsit+ta nan: zhes bzlog cing bh+yos gdab bo: bcu gcig pa zor bskul ba ni: hūm̐ */ bcom ldan dpal dgu 'bar ba yi:

mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: hūm̐ */ shar phyogs pho nya rab 'bar ba: mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: hūm̐ */ lho phyogs pho nya rab 'bar ba: mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: hūm̐ */ nub phyogs pho nya rab 'bar ba: mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: hūm̐ */ byang phyogs pho nya rab 'bar ba: mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha pad+ma kro dhī shwa rī a hri'aḥ badz+ra kī li kī li ya ma hā yak+sha kā la rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ trika nan: e hur thuṃ dzaḥmā ra ya rbad: sarba ru tra hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥ sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ bh+yo sha trūṃ hur thuṃ dzaḥmā ra ya rbad: dgra bgegs dam sri nṛ tri rbad thuṃ: dha ra ya dha ra ya: mā ra ya mā ra ya: nā ga tshin+dha tshin+dha: mi li mi li: bhan+dha bhan+dha nā ga ni swā hā: hūm̐ ha he phaṭa bh+yo: hṛ da ya mo ha ya: pra ha ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa: sa ma yaḥ

a ti kra ma ni: sa ra ṇa bh+yo: a la la bh+yo: zlog zlog: ces brjod do: bcu gnyis pa bcol dam bya ba ni: hūm̐ */ 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs la: dam nyams dgra bgegs 'byung po 'di: gsod cing bsgral bar bya ba'i phyir: mgo lus rgyan dang bcas pa 'bul: bcol lo gtad do gnyer du longs: lus ngag yid gsum rdul du rlogs: sha khrag gzugs kyi phung po shigs: rnam shes bde chen gnas su drongs: bzhes shig lhag ma med par mdzod: bcol lo gtad do gnyer du longs: zhes brjod do: bcu gsum pa smon lam gdab ba ni: hoḥ gshin rje rol pa'i dur khrod chen po na: yab 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po: sbyor yum za byed be tā lī nag mo: sgrol yum e ka dzā ti: gshed bzhi sbyor sgrol yab yum: las kyi gshin rje phyogs skyong bcu gnyis yab yum: gshin rje sgo ba bzhi: bka' srung gri thogs ging : khram thogs bdud bzhi: sho thogs rtsis pa bzhi: srog gcod bshan pa bzhi la sogs pa 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs lnga bcu rtsa dgu la phrin las gnyan po bcol ba ni: zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod la sogs pa'i phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub pa dang : rdo rje slob dpon mched dang lcam dral dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la bsrung zhing byin gyis brlab tu gsol: tshe ring ba dang : nad med pa dang : dpal 'byor longs spyod thams cad rgyas par mdzad du gsol: chags che nyam nga rbad 'dre rbod gtong mo dang rmis ltas mtshan ma ngan pa thams cad phyir zlog cig: bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra la rbad cing : gnod par byed pa'i bgegs rnams 'dul ba'i phrin las su bcol ba ni: sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che bshig pa: dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smod pa: rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku dgra: rnal 'byor pa'i sgos dgra: mched dang lcam dral gyi spyi dgra: rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi rkyen dgra: sems can yongs la 'tshe ba:

snga dgra lag gis bdar ba: phyi dgra snying la bsams pa: da dgra dngos su 'khu ba: gzugs can gyi dgra: gzugs med kyi bgegs: bar gcod kyi rkyen: bsam pa ngan pa 'chang ba: sbyor ba rtsub mo ston par byed pa'i dgra bgegs byad ma gdug pa can thams cad thal ba'i rdul du rlogs shig: sku gsung thugs kyi dbyings su gtad do: bcol ba'i las gyis shig: sgrub pa'i rtags phyung zhig: 'phrin las thams cad mngon sum du 'grub par mdzod cig: ces brjod do: ༈ /spyi don bzhi pa pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs kyi zlog pa'i phrin las gzhung bsrang ba la yang bcu gsum ste: dang po gtor ma 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ */ 'jig rten snod du bcud rnams gtor mar bcas: snang srid thams cad mchod pa'i yo byad de: mdzes shing bkra bar bshams nas su: pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs la: gnyis su med pa'i tshogs su 'bul: phung po'i snod du dbang po'i gtor mar bcas: dur khrod gzhal yas mchod pa'i yo byad de: mdzes shing bkra bar bshams nas su: pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs la: gnyis su med pa'i tshogs su 'bul: bhan+dha lcang lor 'bru bcud gtor mar bcas: dri ro reg bya mchod pa'i yo byad de: mdzes shing bkra bar bshams nas su: pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs la: gnyis su med pa'i tshogs su 'bul: mchog chen mchog phran sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga: mchod pa'i bye brag sna tshogs rnams: mdzes shing bkra bar bshams nas su: pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs la: gnyis su med pa'i tshogs su 'bul: zhes dbul lo: gnyis pa spyir bskul ba ni: hūm̐ */ pad+ma rol pa'i dur khrod chen po na: bcom ldan dpal chen rta mgrin yab yum dang : sras mchog zil gnon khro rgyal yab yum brgyad: dbang chen sgo ba khyi spyang pho nya'i tshogs: pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs thugs dam can: mi mngon dbyings nas sku bzhengs thugs dam bskul: rmad byung rol pa'i sman raka gtor mas mchod: thugs dam rgyud bskul phrin las rnam bzhi mdzod:

ces pa dang : gsum pa dam can sgos su bskul ba ni: hūm̐ */ sku las sprul pa'i khams brgya mo: dung gi dred mo mgo gsum zhon: gsung las sprul pa'i khams brgya mo: zangs kyi 'phar ba mgo brgyad zhon: thugs las sprul pa'i khams brgya mo: lcags kyi spyang mo mgo dgu zhon: yon tan sprul pa'i khams brgya mo: g.yu yi spyang mo mgo gsum zhon: phrin las sprul pa'i khams brgya mo: gser gyi seng ge lnga dril zhon: gnyis med sprul pa'i khams brgya mo: dung gi seng ge mgo bcu zhon: shar phyogs long ba rgyab 'brel ni: 'brug chen sngon po chibs su bcibs: na bza' le brgan dpung ldum gsol: phyag na lcags kyu dgra sta thogs: dbu yi ral pa tshar re las: gza' rgod mig dmar char du 'bebs: sprul pa dmus long bco lngas bskor: lho phyogs long ba rgyab 'brel ni: lcags kyi sdig pa chibs su bcibs: na bza' gsa' yi ras la gsol: phyag na lcags kyi khyung chen bsnams: dbu yi ral pa tshar re la: nyi ma 'bum gyi char du 'bebs: sprul pa dmus long bco lngas bskor: nub phyogs long ba rgyab 'brel ni: ba glang dmar po chibs su bcibs: na bza' klu 'brug lpags pa gsol: phyag na sbrul gyi zhags pa thogs: dbu yi ral pa tshar re la: bdud dang ma mo char du 'bebs: sprul pa dmus long bco lngas bskor: byang phyogs long ba rgyab 'brel ni: ba glang dkar po chibs su bcibs: na bza' zhing gi g.yang gzhi gsol: lag pa phral nas gar stabs byed: dbu yi ral pa tshar re la: long ba'i sprul pa char du 'bebs: sprul pa dmus long bco lngas bskor: hūm̐ */ shar gyi phyogs nas rgyug pa ni: dung gi khyi mo ral pa can: lho yi phyogs nas rgyug pa ni: gser gyi khyi mo ral pa can: nub kyi phyogs nas rgyug pa ni: zangs kyi khyi mo ral pa can: byang gi phyogs nas rgyug pa ni: g.yu yi khyi mo ral pa can: shar lho mtshams nas rgyug pa ni:

byi ru'i khyi mo ral pa can: lho nub mtshams nas rgyug pa ni: mchong gi khyi mo ral pa can: nub byang mtshams nas rgyug pa ni: bse yi khyi mo ral pa can: byang shar mtshams nas rgyug pa ni: shel gyi khyi mo ral pa can: dpal gyi khyi brgyad thugs dam bskul: kun kyang 'jigs tshul rngam pa'i sku: mche ba spu gri bltams pa 'dra: mig ni nyi ma'i zer las che: dgra bgegs skrag pa'i las mdzod cig: hūm̐ */ shar gyi phyogs nas rgyug pa ni: dung gi spyang mo ral pa can: lho yi phyogs nas rgyug pa ni: gser gyi spyang mo ral pa can: nub kyi phyogs nas rgyug pa ni: zangs kyi spyang mo ral pa can: byang gi phyogs nas rgyug pa ni: g.yu yi spyang mo ral pa can: shar lho mtshams nas rgyug pa ni: mthing gi spyang mo ral pa can: lho nub mtshams nas rgyug pa ni: mu men spyang mo ral pa can: nub byang mtshams nas rgyug pa ni: mchong gi spyang mo ral pa can: byang shar mtshams nas rgyug pa ni: ra gan spyang mo ral pa can: spyang mo ro zan thugs dam bskul: kun kyang spyan gyis dur khrod gzigs: las su dur khrod gnas su rgyug: kha nas ro zhal dur thag gcod: ma thogs myur du las gyis shig: hūm̐ */ shar gyi phyogs kyi pho nya ni: dkar mo nyi 'dab 'jigs pa'i gzugs: lho yi phyogs kyi pho nya ni: ser mo zla 'dab 'jigs pa'i gzugs: nub kyi phyogs kyi pho nya ni: dmar mo me 'dab 'jigs pa'i gzugs: byang gi phyogs kyi pho nya ni: sngon mo chu 'dab 'jigs pa'i gzugs: kun kyang ljags la glog 'gyu bas: 'jig rten thams cad sreg par byed: zhal nas chu 'bab rba rlabs g.yeng : shangs nas rlung 'thor bu yug 'tshub: spyan nas khro chu'i thog kyang 'bebs: ljags las sprul pa'i pho nya 'gyed: mche bas khams gsum sgrol bar byed: pho nya chen po khyed rnams kyis: ma thogs myur du phrin las mdzod: rlung 'brug sku mdog sngon po la:

rin chen g.yu yi 'dab ma can: me 'brug sku mdog dmar po la: 'bar ba me yi 'dab gshog can: chu 'brug sku mdog sngon po la: gdug pa sbrul gyi 'dab gshog can: gcig ni sna tshogs gzugs can ma: rdo rje'i 'dab gshog 'bar bas bltams: kun kyang 'brug sgra 'u ru ru: kha nas glog dmar khyugs se khyug: dam nyams dgra la mngags pa'i tshe: yud tsam zhig gis dgra bgegs sgrol: pad+ma gsung gi bka' srung thugs dam can: dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: yid la gnag pa'i dgra bgegs myur du sgrol: tri pa tri pa hūm̐ phaṭa: kha la ro sha kha la ro sha hūm̐ phaṭa: ya sha kun khaṃ khaṃ dzaḥ ya sha kun khaṃ khaṃ dzaḥhūm̐ phaṭa: dza lam dza lam hūm̐ phaṭa: sa ma ya sha hūm̐ phaṭa: dza la a mo gha: dza la a mo gha hūm̐ phaṭa: ces rbad cing bskul lo: bzhi pa nya bo dgug pa ni: hūm̐ */ sangs rgyas bstan la rab zhugs shing : byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas: dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob pa'i: rig 'dzin rnal 'byor rnams la yang : gnod cing gdug pa'i dgra dang bgegs: bdud dang bar du gcod pa dang : dngos grub 'phrog cing 'tshe ba rnams: khro bo chen po'i byin rlabs dang : gsang sngags drag po'i mthu stobs kyis: yud tsam zhig gis 'dir khug la: mngon spyod tshul bzhin bsgral ba dang : lus ngag rdul du bshig nas kyang : sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar gyis: nga yi dbang du gyur nas kyang : bsgo ba'i bka' la nyan par gyis: bcom ldan rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha: 'di na gnag pa'i las yod kyi: bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs: skyod cig yum gyi mkha' nas skyod: dam tshig can gyi thugs dam bskul: lcags kyu can gyis snying nas zung : zhags pa can gyis mgul nas chings: lcags sgrog can gyis yan lag sdoms: dril bu can gyis rdul du rlogs: mthu dang rdzu 'phrul 'phrog nas kyang : mgon skyabs grogs dang bral bar mdzod: bla srog rnam shes gzugs la phob:

zung zhig rgyob cig rnam par chings: rings par khug la smyor chug cig: lus ngag rdul du brlags nas kyang : gzugs phung rngams pa'i zhal du stobs: pho nya kun gyis phrin las mdzod: ces brjod do: lnga ba bden pa brjod pa ni: na mo/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ rigs sngags dang*/ gzungs sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ khyad par du bcom ldan 'das rgyal pa zhi khro rab 'byams/ pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs khro bo dang khro mo yab yum sprul pa bka' sdod chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi thugs rje dang phrin las thogs pa med pa'i bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che bshig pa/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smod pa/ bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba/ dam nyams pa'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad skad cig yud tsam la/ gzugs liṅga ru bris shing*/ ming byang bu ru btab pa 'di la khug cig: badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐: badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ: badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭe hoḥ ā we sha ya a: zhes dang*/ oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ sogs dang*/ a pā na ya a pa na ya: ha sa na ya ha sa na ya: ā we sha ya ā we sha ya: shri trin ha na ya shri trin ha na ya: dz+wa la pa ya dz+wa la pa ya: ta thā ya ta thā ya: bhan+dha ya bhan+dha ya: zhes brjod do: drug pa phur skor bya ba ni: hūm̐ */ chos dbyings rang byung grub pa'i lha: pad+ma rol pa'i dur khrod nas: shin tu mi bzad skur ston pa: dpal chen drag po'i phrin las mdzod: dpal chen pad+ma he ru kaḥ yab yum sras 'khor pho nyar bcas: g.yas g.yon thabs shes phur bu sgril: sras mchog rigs kyi phur bu 'di: thogs med rang byung lhun gyis grub: sgril ba tsam gyis lha yang 'dar: rdeg pa tsam gyis srid gsum g.yo:

btab na khams gsum thal bar rlog: btab bo theb par mdzod cig kī la ya: dgra bgegs 'byung po sgrol cig mā ra ya: hūm̐ */ yon tan rgyud las byung ba yi: pad+ma gsung gi sprul pa ste: 'debs byed las kyi phur bu 'bum: srid gsum byad ma'i snying la thob: kī la ya yi sgra sgrog pa: srid pa'i phur bu bdag gis bskul: bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: zhes phur bu gdab bo: oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba: ma hā kro dha e ka tsa ti sa ma ya: hu lu hu lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa: ā ra li dza dza: oṃ thuṃ thuṃ: myag myag: mug mug: shar shar: zhi bar byos: du dang du dang : rbad rbad: dza dzaḥ bh+yo bh+yo: hūm̐ hūm̐: myag rbad: mo du sod: mo'u ra yag chod: srog gi dbang po snying kha la rak+sha ya ra tsa ya: tad+ya thā: snying rbad ya: khrag ti ma te: ma ti brag sha: mgo khrag za ni chod: sa lo chod: mu lo chod: sha khyi khye: dgra bo'i snying srog rtsad nas phyung zhig swā hā: zhes brjod do: bdun pa dmar sbreng ba ni: hūm̐ */ nyon mongs 'khor ba dbyings su bsgral ba'i phyir: 'khor ba'i rtsa ba nyon mongs gzung 'dzin khrag: dug gsum ru tra bsgral ba'i rak+ta'i rgyun: dung chen snod du dmar chen ar+ghaṃ sbyar: dpal chen khrag 'thung 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: khams gsum yongs sgrol dpa' bo chen po yis: dug lnga chags pa khrag gi mtsho la rol: gzung 'dzin chags pas mnar ba'i dgra bo 'di: chags med bde chen sa la 'god par shog: ma hā mū la rak+ta la kha raṃ khā hi: zhes so: brgyad pa bstab pa bya ba ni: hūm̐ */ bstab bo bstab bo zhal du bstab: pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs zhal phyes shig: nam mkha' gang ba'i zhal phye la: ri rab tsam gyi mche ba gtsigs: bar snang gang ba'i ljags sgril cig: chos dbyings stong nyid lto ba ru: mchod rdzas dgra bgegs zhal du bstab: zhal du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi: mgul du bsgril lo ā ra li:

dbyings su bstim mo sa ma ya: oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ sha trūṃ ma hā maṃ sa la khā hi: ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: ma hā keṃ ni ri ti la khā hi: mahā tsit+ta la khā hi: ma hā ba su ta la khā hi: ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi: ma hā tsak+ṣuḥl khā hi: zhes dbul lo: dgu pa bzlog pa'i phrin las gzhung bsrang ba ni: hūm̐ */ bcom ldan dpal chen dbang chen rta mgrin te: khams gsum ma lus dbang du sdud pa dang : dam nyams dgra yi chags pa'i khrag la rol: dbang chen bgegs kyi tshogs rnams bzlog tu gsol: yum chen pad+ma gzi ldan ral gcig ma: dam nyams dgra yi rtsa khrag 'di rol la: dbang chen ma mo'i gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol: las kyi rgyal po byi la'i mgo bo can: dgra bgegs thams cad myur du 'dir khug la: dgra bo'i bsam sbyor ngan pa bzlog tu gsol: las kyi rgyal po pu shud mgo bo can: dam nyams dgra bo'i 'byung ba'i bcud bsdus la: gdug pa'i sdang sems ngan pa bzlog tu gsol: ye shes zil gnon khro bo chen po yis: ye shes lha yi dmag tshogs bzlog tu gsol: las kyi zil gnon khro bo chen po yis: ye shes khro bo dbang bsdus pho nya zlog: ye shes ma mo zil gnon khro bo yis: ma mo thams cad dbang bsdus pho nya zlog: ye shes khyung chen zil gnon khro bo yis: klu rnams dbang bsdus pho nya thams cad zlog: pho rgyud zil gnon khro bo chen po yis: srid pa pho rgyud dbang bsdus pho nya zlog: mo rgyud zil gnon khro bo chen po yis: srid pa mo rgyud dbang bsdus pho nya zlog: klu rnams zil gnon khro bo chen po yis: klu rnams dbang bsdus sa bdag ming sring zlog: gza' rnams zil gnon khro bo chen po yis: gza' rnams dbang bsdus gza' bdud ming sring zlog: zil gnon khro mo chen mo mi pham mas: ye shes lha mo dbang bsdus pho nya zlog:

zil gnon khro mo chen mo ral gcig mas: ye shes ma mo dbang bsdus pho nya zlog: zil gnon chen mo za byed be tā lī: ye shes ma mo dbang bsdus pho nya zlog: ye shes khro mo chen mo khro gnyer mas: klu mo rnams kyi pho nya'i tshogs rnams zlog: zil gnon khro mo rdo rje las byed mas: rdo rje can gyi pho nya'i tshogs rnams zlog: zil gnon khro mo gshin rje las byed mas: gshin rje dbang bsdus pho nya'i tshogs rnams zlog: zil gnon khro mo klu mo las byed mas: klu rnams dbang bsdus pho nya'i tshogs rnams zlog: zil gnon khro mo gnod sbyin las byed mas: gnod sbyin dbang bsdus pho nya'i tshogs rnams zlog: shar gyi sgo bas dgra bgegs snying nas drongs: shar gyi gdon tshogs bzlog la dgra la sgyur: lho yi sgo bas dgra bgegs yan lag chings: lho yi gdon tshogs bzlog la dgra la sgyur: nub kyi sgo bas dgra bgegs dbang po sdoms: nub kyi gdon tshogs bzlog la dgra la sgyur: byang gi sgo bas dam nyams srog dbugs chod: byang gi gdon tshogs bzlog la dgra la sgyur: bka' yi bstan srung khams brgya dmus long dang : dpal gyi khyi spyang me 'brug rlung 'brug rnams: dam nyams dgra yi sha khrag glo snying rol: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad bzlog tu gsol: gru gsum dmar nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs 'dir gshegs la: mi sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dam nyams 'byung po 'di la da rol cig: ma hā maṃ sa la khā hi: ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: ma hā tsit+ta la khā hi: ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi: ma hā keṃ ni ri ti la khā hi: ma hā ba su ta la khā hi: ma hā tsak+ṣuḥl khā hi: ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā hi: ma hā ba ling+ta la khā hi: bcu pa bzlog cing bh+yos gdab pa ni: hūm̐ */ zlog byed pad+ma he ru kaḥ bh+yo zlog drag po'i dus la bab: sangs rgyas bstan zhugs rnal 'byor la:

phyogs bcu kun nas gdug pa yi: bsam sbyor ngan pa'i rig sngags dang : sde brgyad dregs pa'i ngan sngags dang : snang srid lha 'dre'i rbod gtong dang : drang srong bka' yi dmod pa dang : ban bon 'dus pa'i sngags zor dang : gshin rje'i 'khor lo ma mo'i thun: klu yi gtad mnan pho nya'i zor: mthu brub byad dang mi kha ngan: lo zla zhag dang za ma'i skag: dus min 'chi ba la sogs rnams: byad ma dgra bgegs rnams la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo gnod pa'i bgegs la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo bar chad bdud la bh+yo: zhes pa dang : oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐/ oṃ bud+dha badz+ra oṃ bh+yo zlog: sarba badz+ra hūm̐ bh+yo zlog: rat+na badz+ra trāṃ bh+yo zlog: pad+ma badz+ra hrīḥbh+yo zlog: karma badz+ra āḥbh+yo zlog: gu h+ya badz+ra phaṭa bh+yo zlog: oṃ sha ri khā hi bh+yo zlog: ku ku rak+sha kha long khā hi: bh+yo zlog: dīp+ta kra shan mu kha kha long kha bh+yo zlog: tri hūm̐ phaṭa bh+yo zlog: hrīḥhūm̐ phaṭa bh+yo zlog: ha hūm̐ phaṭa bh+yo zlog: dzi na laṃ to tse raṃ bh+yo zlog: yak+sha ku ru bhañdza bh+yo zlog: tri ya tri ya bh+yo zlog: kha la ro sha kha la ro sha bh+yo zlog: yak+sha kun baṃ dza bh+yo zlog: dza la ma dza laṃ: hūm̐ tri ya tri ya bh+yo zlog: sa ma yak+sha sa ma ya hūm̐ bh+yo zlog: dza laṃ ma la a mo gha trāṃ trāṃ: hūm̐ phaṭa bh+yo zlog: bhan+dha yak+sha: bhan+dha sha ya: bhan+dha yag chod bh+yo zlog: rbod gtong byed pa'i dgra bo ha ha ha mā ra ya staṃ bha ya nan bh+yo zlog: sha trūṃ a mu kaṃ mā ra ya bh+yo zlog: oṃ badz+ra ga ru ḍa nā ga ka hūm̐ bh+yo zlog: nyi mas blang nan: klad pa nan: gu na zhi: tsi tra mu tra zlog: byad na ra tsa shig: nā ga ra tsa zlog: nā ga ra tsa gho la nan: ga ru ḍa tsa le hūm̐ phaṭa: ta ka tsa dza te ta ki byi dza ye: hu lu hu lu: pu ru pu te swā hā: ga ru ḍa nā ga rā tsa'i snying la hur hur bh+yo zlog:

bdag la dgra bo che ge mos btang ba'i phur kha zlog: zor kha zlog: byol kha zlog: dmod kha zlog: rbad kha zlog: rbad 'dre zlog: rbod gtong zlog: mnan kha zlog: gtad kha zlog: khram kha zlog: rbad 'dre rbod gtong bsam ngan thams cad dgra la bh+yo zlog: oṃ traka rak+sha kha 'dar nṛ rbad bh+yo: kha la dza dun nṛ rbad bh+yo: nā ga shu tse nṛ rbad bh+yo: shan+tiṃ pa nṛ rbad bh+yo: ma nṛ rak+sha nṛ rbad bh+yo: yak+sha kha thun nṛ rbad bh+yo: kha dun tshal pa nṛ rbad bh+yo: hri tri dz+wa la nṛ rbad bh+yo: srid pa pho rgyud dregs pa'i chad pa dgra la bh+yo bh+yo: dza kha thun kha la yak+sha ya: du ra yak+sha snying la ya: khal tse nā ga srog la ya: kha sa ga sha rbad su ya: ma ma rak+sha khrag la ya: ha ri khā hi las la ya: rak+sha ya: shu'o rak+sha dbugs la ya: gh+raṃ bh+yo taṃ bh+yo las la ya: mo rgyud mkha' 'gro'i chad pa dgra la bh+yo bh+yo: tri kha thun kha tse yak+sha rbad: ma ni dza la kha la rbad: ma nṛ rak+sha snying la rbad: bhi ri tsa ni gzugs la rbad: snying khrag dza la srog la rbad: a ka yak+sha srog la rbad: mā ra aṃ ku sha ya snying la rbad: klu gnyan dregs pa'i chad pa dgra la bh+yo: dgra la thun bh+yo: dgra la byad bh+yo: dgra la zor bh+yo: dgra la pha bh+yo: dgra la ma bh+yo: dgra la ming po bh+yo: dgra la sring mo bh+yo: dgra la sngags bh+yo: dgra la bdud bh+yo: dgra la btsan bh+yo: dgra la rgyal po bh+yo: dgra la ma mo bh+yo: dgra la dri za bh+yo: dgra la gnod sbyin bh+yo: dgra la gshin rje bh+yo: dgra la mu stegs bh+yo: dgra la nā ga bh+yo: dgra la rā hu la bh+yo: byad ma dgra bo'i steng du bh+yo: byad ma dgra bo'i steng du zlog: byad ma dgra bo'i steng du nan: byad ma dgra bo'i kha tham: byad ma dgra bo'i kā ya nan: byad ma dgra bo'i wāka nan: byad ma dgra bo'i tsit+ta nan: zhes bzlog cing bh+yos gdab bo: bcu gcig pa zor bskul ba ni: hūm̐ */ bcom ldan dpal dgu 'bar ba yi:

mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: hūm̐ */ shar phyogs pho nya rab 'bar ba: mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: hūm̐ */ lho phyogs pho nya rab 'bar ba: mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: hūm̐ */ nub phyogs pho nya rab 'bar ba: mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: hūm̐ */ byang phyogs pho nya rab 'bar ba: mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha pad+ma kro dhī shwa rī badz+ra kī li kī la ya ma hā yak+sha kā la rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ trika nan: e hur thuṃ dzaḥ mā ra ya rbad: sarba ru tra hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥ sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ bh+yo: sha trūṃ hur thuṃ dzaḥmā ra ya rbad: dgra bgegs dam sri nṛ tri rbad thuṃ: dha ra ya dha ra ya: mā ra ya mā ra ya: nā ga du tshin+dha tshin+dha: mi li mi li: bhan+dha ya bhan+dha ya: nā ga ni swā hā: hūm̐ ha he phaṭa bh+yo: hṛ da ya mo ha ya: pra ha ra ṇa ya hūm̐ phaṭa:

sa ma ya: a ti kra ma ni: sa ra ṇa bh+yo: a la la bh+yo bh+yo: zlog zlog: ces brjod do: bcu gnyis pa bcol dam bya ba ni: hūm̐ */ pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs la: dam nyams dgra bgegs 'byung po 'di: gsod cing bsgral bar bya ba'i phyir: mgo lus rgyan dang bcas pa 'bul: bcol lo gtad do gnyer du longs: lus ngag yid gsum rdul du rlogs: sha khrag gzugs kyi phung po shigs: rnam shes bde chen gnas su drongs: bzhes shig lhag ma med par mdzod: bcol lo gtad do gnyer du longs: zhes brjod: bcu gsum pa smon lam gdab pa ni: hoḥ pad+ma rol pa'i dur khrod chen po na: yab pad+ma dbang chen: yum pad+ma gzi ldan ma: dbang chen sras mchog rigs bzhi yab yum: ye shes dpal gyi khro bo khro mo yab yum bcu drug dbang chen sgo ba bzhi: bka' srung khams brgya mo drug: sprul pa dmus long bzhi: khyi brgyad: spyang brgyad: pho nya mche gshog: me 'brug: rlung 'brug: dbang phyug srin mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad: pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs dgu bcu rtsa drug la phrin las gnyan po bcol ba ni: zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod la sogs pa phrin las rnam pa bzhi sgrub pa dang : rdo rje slob dpon mched dang lcam dral: rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la bsrung zhing byin gyis brlab tu gsol: tshe ring ba dang : nad med pa dang : dpal 'byor longs spyod thams cad rgyas par mdzad du gsol: chags che nyam nga rbad 'dre rbod gtong mo dang rmis ltas ngan pa thams cad phyir zlog cig: bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra la rbad cing : gnod par byed pa'i bgegs rnams 'dul ba'i 'phrin las gnyan po bcol ba ni: sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che bshig pa: dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smod pa: rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku dgra: rnal 'byor pa'i sgos dgra: mched dang lcam dral gyi spyi dgra: rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi rkyen dgra: sems can yongs la 'tshe ba:

snga dgra lag gis bdar ba: phyi dgra snying la bsams pa: da dgra dngos su 'khu ba: gzugs can gyi dgra: gzugs med kyi bgegs: bar gcod kyi rkyen: bsam pa ngan pa 'chang ba: sbyor ba rtsub mo ston par byed pa'i byad ma dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad thal ba'i rdul du rlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: sku gsung thugs kyi dbyings su gtad do: bcol ba'i las gyis shig: sgrub pa'i rtags phyung zhig: phrin las thams cad mngon sum du 'grub par mdzod cig: ces brjod do: ༈ /spyi don lnga pa phur pa phrin las kyi lha tshogs kyi zlog pa'i phrin las kyi gzhung bsrang ba la don bcu gsum ste: dang po gtor ma 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ */ 'jig rten snod du bcud rnams gtor mar bcas: snang srid thams cad mchod pa'i yo byad de: mdzes shing bkra bar bshams nas su: phur pa phrin las lha tshogs la: gnyis su med pa'i tshogs su 'bul: phung po'i snod du dbang po'i gtor mar bcas: dur khrod gzhal yas mchod pa'i yo byad de: mdzes shing bkra bar bshams nas su: phur pa phrin las lha tshogs la: gnyis su med pa'i tshogs su 'bul: bhan+dha lcang lor 'bru bcud gtor mar bcas: dri ro reg bya mchod pa'i yo byad de: mdzes shing bkra bar bshams nas su: phur pa phrin las lha tshogs la: gnyis su med pa'i tshogs su 'bul: mchog chen mchog phran sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga: mchod pa'i bye brag sna tshogs rnams: mdzes shing bkra bar bshams nas su: phur pa phrin las lha tshogs la: gnyis su med pa'i tshogs su 'bul: zhes dbul lo: gnyis pa spyir bskul ba ni: hūm̐ */ phur pa rol pa'i dur khrod chen po na: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum dang : sras mchog khro bcu yab yum khra thabs dang : sgo ba dam can phur srung bcu drug sogs: phur pa phrin las lha tshogs thugs dam can: mi mngon dbyings nas sku bzhengs thugs dam bskul: rmad byung rol pa'i sman raka gtor mas mchod:

thugs dam rgyud bskul phrin las rnam bzhi mdzod: ces dang : gsum pa dam can sgos su bskul ba ni: hūm̐ */ nam gyi srod kyi dam can ma: lcags kyi spyang mo mgo dgu la: mi mo lcags kyi mgo can zhon: lag na lcags kyi phur bu sgril: shwa na mu kha'i dus la bab: gser gyi 'phar ba lce brgyad ma: mi mo gser gyi mgo can zhon: lag na gser gyi phur bu sgril: sri la mu kha'i dus la bab: zangs kyi wa mo rkang gsum ma: mi mo zangs kyi mgo can zhon: lag na zangs kyi phur bu sgril: sri la mu kha'i dus la bab: lcags kyi khyi mo ral can la: mi mo lcags kyi mgo can zhon: lag na lcags kyi phur bu sgril: shwa na mu kha'i dus la bab: nam gyi gung gi dam can ma: nag mo ral pas stong khams khyab: phyag na mchog gi phur bu sgril: chibs su drel rta rkang gsum bcibs: re ma ti yi dus la bab: ser nag rma bya'i thul pa can: phyag na mchog gi phur bu sgril: chibs su drel rta rkang gsum bcibs: re ma dzi yi dus la bab: dmar nag re lde nag po gsol: phyag na mchog gi phur bu sgril: chibs su drel rta rkang gsum bcibs: re ma dza yi dus la bab: ljang nag dar nag go zu gsol: phyag na mchog gi phur bu sgril: chibs su drel rta rkang gsum bcibs: re ma dzu yi dus la bab: nam gyi tho rangs dam can ma: mthing nag lcags phur ral pa can: phyag na lcags kyi phur bu sgril: chibs su bdud rta nag po bcibs: rdo rje ya 'byin dus la bab: ser mo gser phur ral pa can: phyag na gser gyi phur bu sgril: chibs su gza' rta ser po bcibs: rdo rje de 'byin dus la bab: dmar mo zangs phur ral pa can: phyag na zangs kyi phur bu sgril: chibs su btsan rta dmar po bcibs: rdo rje bse 'byin dus la bab: ljang mo g.yu phur ral pa can: phyag na g.yu yi phur bu sgril: chibs su chu rta sngon po bcibs: rdo rje phag 'byin dus la bab:

shar phyogs srog gi skyes bu ni: dkar po lag na phur bu sgril: srin po khyab byed dus la bab: lho phyogs gshin rje'i skyes bu ni: nag po lag na phur bu sgril: gshin rje nag po'i dus la bab: nub phyogs ya bdud skyes bu ni: dmar po lag na phur bu sgril: sog po mig ring dus la bab: byang phyogs gnod sbyin skyes bu ni: sngon po lag na phur bu sgril: mon pa mig ring dus la bab: shar bdud dkar po mche ba can: phyag na dung gi phur bu sgril: shar gyi skyes bu'i dus la bab: lho bdud rog po ral pa can: phyag na g.yu yi phur bu sgril: lho yi skyes bu'i dus la bab: nub bdud nag po ral pa can: phyag na zhags pa phur bu bsnams: nub kyi skyes bu'i dus la bab: byang bdud ljang nag ral pa can: phyag na ral gri phur bu bsnams: byang gi skyes bu'i dus la bab: pra ma rā tsa srin po'i ging : dkar po lag na phur bu sgril: shar gyi dmag dpon dus la bab: ya ma rā tsa gshin rje'i ging : sngon po lag na phur bu sgril: lho yi dmag dpon dus la bab: da sha grī ba bdud kyi ging : nag po lag na phur bu sgril: nub kyi dmag dpon dus la bab: yak+sha grī ba gnod sbyin ging : ser po lag na phur bu sgril: byang gi dmag dpon dus la bab: phur pa phrin las bka' srung thugs dam can: dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: yid la gnag pa'i dgra bgegs myur du sgrol: ka taṃ ka ye dza ye bi dza ye a dzi te a pa ra dzi te ma ra se na pra marda ni ye hūm̐ phaṭa: ces rbad cing bskul lo: bzhi pa nya bo dgug pa ni: hūm̐ */ sangs rgyas bstan la rab zhugs shing : byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas: dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob pa'i: rig 'dzin rnal 'byor rnams la ni: gnod cing gdug pa'i dgra dang bgegs: bdud dang bar du gcod pa dang : dngos grub 'phrog cing 'tshe ba rnams: khro bo chen po'i byin rlabs dang :

gsang sngags drag po'i mthu stobs kyis: yud tsam zhig gis 'dir khug la: mngon spyod tshul bzhin bsgral ba dang : lus ngag rdul du brlags nas kyang : sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar gyis: nga yi dbang du gyur nas kyang : bsgo ba'i bka' la nyan par gyis: bcom ldan rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha: 'di na gnag pa'i las yod kyi: bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs: skyod cig yum gyi mkha' nas skyod: dam tshig can gyi thugs dam bskul: lcags kyu can gyis snying nas zung : zhags pa can gyis yan lag chings: lcags sgrog can gyis lus kun sdoms: dril bu can gyis rdul du rlogs: mthu dang rdzu 'phrul 'phrog nas kyang : mgon skyabs grogs dang bral bar gyis: bla srog rnam shes gzugs la phob: zung zhig rgyob cig rnam par chings: rings par khug la smyor chug cig: lus ngag rdul du brlags nas kyang : gzugs phung rngams pa'i zhal du stobs: pho nya kun gyis phrin las mdzod: ces brjod do: lnga pa bden stobs brjod pa ni: na mo/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ rigs sngags dang*/ gzungs sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ khyad par du bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams/ phur pa phrin las kyi lha tshogs khro bo dang khro mo yab yum sprul pa bka' sdod pho nya chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi thugs rje dang phrin las thogs pa med pa'i bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che bshig pa/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smod pa/ bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba/ dam nyams pa'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad skad cig yud tsam zhig la gzugs liṅga ru bris shing*/ ming byang bu ru btab pa 'di la khug cig: badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐: badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ: badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭe hoḥ

ā we sha ya a: zhes dang : oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nāṃ baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ sogs dang*/ de bzhin du/ a pā na ya a pā na ya: ha sa na ya ha sa na ya: ā we sha ya ā we sha ya: shi trin ha na ya shri trin ha na ya: dz+wa la pa ya dz+wa la pa ya: ta thā ya ta thā ya: bhan+dha ya bhan+dha ya: zhes brjod: drug pa phur skor bya ba ni: hūm̐ */ chos dbyings rang byung grub pa'i lha: phur pa rol pa'i dur khrod nas: shin tu mi bzad skur ston pa: dpal chen drag po'i phrin las mdzod: dpal chen karma he ru kaḥ yab yum sras 'khor sprul par bcas: g.yas g.yon thabs shes phur bu sgril: sras mchog rigs kyi phur bu 'di: thogs med rang byung lhun gyis grub: sgril ba tsam gyis lha yang 'dar: rdeg pa tsam gyis srid gsum g.yo: btab na khams gsum thal bar rlog: btab bo theb par mdzod cig kī la ya: dgra bgegs 'byung po sgrol cig mā ra ya: hūm̐ */ yon tan rgyud las byung ba yi: phur pa phrin las sprul pa ste: 'debs byed las kyi phur bu 'bum: srid gsum byad ma'i snying la thob: kī la ya yi sgra sgrog pa: srid pa'i phur bu bdag gis bskul: bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: zhes phur bu btab: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī li ya sarba bigh+nāṃ baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: ma ma rak+mo: yak+mo kā la rū pa: snying rtsa la yaṃ yaṃ: srog rtsa la yaṃ yaṃ: snying la phril phril: srog la chum chum: tsit+ta srog la btung btung : snying khrag shad thuṃ ril ril: snying tsig tsig 'ur 'ur: shig shig: 'gul 'gul: myag myag: sod sod: dha ti ma ma karma shī gh+raṃ ka re ya: ma ra pa ni: pra ma taṃ nṛ tri hūm̐ phaṭa: ces brjod do: bdun pa dmar sbreng ba ni: hūm̐ */ nyon mongs 'khor ba dbyings su bsgral ba'i phyir: 'khor ba'i rtsa ba nyon mongs gzung 'dzin khrag: dug gsum ru tra bsgral ba'i rak+ta'i rgyun: dung chen snod du dmar chen ar+ghaṃ sbyar:

dpal chen khrag 'thung 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: khams gsum yongs sgrol dpa' bo chen po yis: dug lnga chags pa'i khrag gi mtsho la rol: gzung 'dzin chags pas mnar ba'i dgra bo rnams: chags med bde chen sa la 'god par shog: ma hā mū la rak+ta la kha raṃ khā hi: brgyad pa bstab pa bya ba ni: hūm̐ */ bstab bo bstab bo zhal du bstab: phur pa phrin las lha tshogs zhal phyes shig: nam mkha' gang ba'i zhal phye la: ri rab tsam gyi mche ba gtsigs: bar snang gang ba'i ljags sgril cig: chos dbyings stong nyid lto ba ru: mchod rdzas dgra bgegs zhal du bstab: zhal du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi: mgul du bsgril lo ā ra li: dbyings su bstim mo sa ma ya: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nāṃ baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ sha trūṃ ma hā maṃ sa la khā hi: ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: ma hā keṃ ni ri ti la khā hi: ma hā tsit+ta la kha hi: ma hā ba su ta la khā hi: ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi: ma hā tsak+ṣuḥl khā hi: zhes dbul lo: dgu pa bzlog pa'i 'phrin las gzhung bsrang ba ni: hūm̐ */ khro mchog rdo rje gzhon nu khro bo'i rgyal: rigs kyi khro bo thams cad dbang bsdus la: dgra bgegs gzugs phung rnam shes da rol la: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og gnyis dang bcu: kun nas gnod pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad zlog: yum chen khro mo 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma: dam nyams dgra yi bkrag la da rol la: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las dus la bab: rnam par rgyal bas dgra sha 'di la rol: dri za'i dmag tshogs bzlog la dgra la sgyur: dbyug pa sngon po dgra sha 'di rol la: me lha'i dmag tshogs bzlog la dgra la sgyur: gshin rje'i gshed po dgra sha 'di rol la: grul bum dmag tshogs bzlog la dgra la sgyur: mi g.yo mgon po dgra sha 'di rol la: srin po'i dmag tshogs bzlog la dgra la sgyur: rta mgrin rgyal po dgra sha 'di rol la: klu yi dmag tshogs bzlog la dgra la sgyur:

gzhan gyis mi thub dgra sha 'di rol la: rlung lha'i dmag tshogs bzlog la dgra la sgyur: bdud rtsi 'khyil pas dgra sha 'di rol la: gnod sbyin dmag tshogs bzlog la dgra la sgyur: khams gsum rnal rgyal dgra sha 'di rol la: dbang ldan dmag tshogs bzlog la dgra la sgyur: hūm̐ chen rgyal pos dgra sha 'di rol la: tshangs pa'i dmag tshogs bzlog la dgra la sgyur: stobs chen rgyal pos dgra sha 'di rol la: sa bdag dmag tshogs bzlog la dgra la sgyur: rdo rje snyems mas dgra bo'i khrag la rol: shar gyi phyogs kyi dgra bgegs sgrol cing zlog: rdo rje sder mo dgra bo'i khrag la rol: shar lho mtshams kyi dgra bgegs sgrol cing zlog: dur khrod bdag mo dgra bo'i khrag la rol: lho yi phyogs kyi dgra bgegs sgrol cing zlog: rdo rje gtun khung dgra bo'i khrag la rol: lho nub mtshams kyi dgra bgegs sgrol cing zlog: rdo rje gtum mo dgra bo'i khrag la rol: nub kyi phyogs kyi dgra bgegs sgrol cing zlog: rdo rje mda' snyems dgra bo'i khrag la rol: nub byang mtshams kyi dgra bgegs sgrol cing zlog: rdo rje rlung 'byin dgra bo'i khrag la rol: byang gi phyogs kyi dgra bgegs sgrol cing zlog: rdo rje gnod byed dgra bo'i khrag la rol: byang shar mtshams kyi dgra bgegs sgrol cing zlog: rdo rje dgra 'byin dgra bo'i khrag la rol: steng gi phyogs kyi dgra bgegs sgrol cing zlog: rdo rje skyod byed dgra bo'i khrag la rol: 'og gi phyogs kyi dgra bgegs sgrol cing zlog: rdo rje phra men stag gi mgo bo can: ti ra thogs nas za zhing rgyug par byed: cir yang bsgyur ba'i mtshon cha thogs nas ni: khro bo'i bka' bzhin rang gi las byed pa: phrin las shar gyi dgra bgegs bzlog tu gsol: rdo rje phra men g.yag gi mgo bo can: rgyu ma thogs nas za zhing rgyug par byed:

cir yang bsgyur ba'i mtshon cha thogs nas ni: khro bo'i bka' bzhin rang gi las byed pa: phrin las shar lho'i dgra bgegs sgrol cing zlog: rdo rje phra men sha ba'i mgo bo can: zhing chen thogs nas za zhing rgyug par byed: cir yang bsgyur ba'i mtshon cha thogs nas ni: khro bo'i bka' bzhin rang gi las byed pa: phrin las lho yi dgra bgegs sgrol cing zlog: rdo rje phra men gzig gi mgo bo can: tsit+ta thogs nas za zhing rgyug par byed: cir yang bsgyur ba'i mtshon cha thogs nas ni: khro bo'i bka' bzhin rang gi las byed pa: phrin las lho nub dgra bgegs sgrol cing zlog: rdo rje phra men byi la'i mgo bo can: klad khrag thogs nas za zhing rgyug par byed: cir yang bsgyur ba'i mtshon cha thogs nas ni: khro bo'i bka' bzhin rang gi las byed pa: phrin las nub kyi dgra bgegs sgrol cing zlog: rdo rje phra men spyang ki'i mgo bo can: sha chen thogs nas za zhing rgyug par byed: cir yang bsgyur ba'i mtshon cha thogs nas ni: khro bo'i bka' bzhin rang gi las byed pa: phrin las nub byang dgra bgegs bzlog tu gsol: rdo rje phra men seng ge'i mgo bo can: zhing chen thogs nas za zhing rgyug par byed: cir yang bsgyur ba'i mtshon cha thogs nas ni: khro bo'i bka' bzhin rang gi las byed pa: phrin las byang gi dgra bgegs bzlog tu gsol: rdo rje phra men dom gyi mgo bo can: rkang gzugs thogs nas za zhing rgyug par byed: cir yang bsgyur ba'i mtshon cha thogs nas ni: khro bo'i bka' bzhin rang gi las byed pa: phrin las byang shar dgra bgegs bzlog tu gsol: rdo rje phra men phag gi mgo bo can: lag gzugs thogs nas za zhing rgyug par byed: cir yang bsgyur ba'i mtshon cha thogs nas ni: khro bo'i bka' bzhin rang gi las byed pa: phrin las steng gi dgra bgegs bzlog tu gsol: rdo rje phra men dred kyi mgo bo can:

lhu gzugs thog nas za zhing rgyug par byed: cir yang bsgyur ba'i mtshon cha thogs nas ni: khro bo'i bka' bzhin rang gi las byed pa: phrin las 'og gi dgra bgegs sgrol cing zlog: phra men bya rgod mgo can mgyogs pa'i shugs: shar phyogs dgra bgegs thams cad sgrol zhing zlog: phra men bya rog mgo can rig pa'i sku: shar lho'i dgra bgegs thams cad bsgyur zhing zlog: phra men 'ug pa'i mgo can shes rab can: lho yi dgra bgegs thams cad bsgyur zhing zlog: phra men khwa ta'i mgo can sgrib shing can: lho nub dgra bgegs thams cad bzlog tu gsol: phra men pu shud mgo can mig tshil can: nub kyi dgra bgegs thams cad bsgyur zhing zlog: phra men khra yi mgo can mgyogs pa mo: nub byang dgra bgegs thams cad bsgyur zhing zlog: phra men pha bang mgo can thabs la mkhas: byang gi dgra bgegs thams cad bzlog tu gsol: phra men gsod byed sre mo'i mgo bo can: byang shar dgra bgegs thams cad bzlog tu gsol: phra men rmigs bu'i mgo can las la spyod: steng gi dgra bgegs thams cad bsgyur zhing zlog: phra men sgrol byed byi la'i mgo bo can: 'og gi dgra bgegs thams cad bsgyur zhing zlog: shar gyi sgo ba pu shud mgo bo can: shar gyi gdon tshogs thams cad bsgyur zhing zlog: lho yi sgo ba skya ga'i mgo bo can: lho yi gdon tshogs thams cad bsgyur zhing zlog: nub kyi sgo ba srin bya'i mgo bo can: nub kyi dgra bgegs thams cad bsgyur zhing zlog: byang gi sgo ba khra yi mgo bo can: byang gi gdon tshogs thams cad bsgyur zhing zlog: shar gyi sras mchog badz+ra kī la ya: shar gyi dgra bgegs thams cad zhi bas zlog: lho yi sras mchog rat+na kī la ya: lho yi dgra bgegs thams cad rgyas pas zlog: nub kyi sras mchog pad+ma kī la ya: nub kyi dgra bgegs thams cad dbang gis zlog: byang gi sras mchog karma kī la ya:

byang gi dgra bgegs thams cad drag pos zlog: bka' yi bstan srung ma mo bcu gnyis kyang : dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la: dpal gyi bka' bzhin las kyi dgra bgegs zlog: bka' yi bstan srung pho bdud bcu gnyis kyang : dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la: dpal gyi bka' bzhin las kyi dgra bgegs zlog: gru gsum ljang nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: phur pa phrin las lha tshogs 'dir gshegs la: mi sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dam nyams 'byung po 'di la da rol cig: ma hā maṃ sa la khā hi: ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: ma hā tsit+ta la khā hi: ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi: ma hā keṃ ni ri ti la khā hi: ma hā ba su ta la khā hi: ma hā tsak+ṣuḥl khā hi: ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā hi: ma hā ba ling+ta la khā hi: bcu pa bzlog cing bh+yos gdab pa ni: hūm̐ */ zlog byed karma he ru kaḥ bh+yo zlog drag po'i dus la bab: sangs rgyas bstan zhugs rnal 'byor la: phyogs bcu kun nas gdug pa yi: bsam sbyor ngan pa'i rig sngags dang : sde brgyad dregs pa'i ngan sngags dang : snang srid lha 'dre'i rbod gtong dang : drang srong bka' yi dmod pa dang : ban bon 'dus pa'i sngags zor dang : gshin rje'i 'khor lo ma mo'i thun: klu yi gtad mnan pho nya'i zor: mthu brub byad dang mi kha ngan: lo zla zhag dang za ma'i skag: dus min 'chi ba la sogs rnams: byad ma dgra bgegs rnams la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo gnod pa'i bgegs la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo bar chad bdud la bh+yo: zhes pa dang*/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nāṃ baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: rbod zor sarba bh+yo zlog: oṃ shwa na mu kha dza dzaḥhūm̐ phaṭa bh+yo zlog: shwa na mu kha dgra bo'i lus srog sha la ni dzaḥbh+yo zlog: oṃ shwa na mu kha dzaḥhūm̐ bh+yo zlog: oṃ shwa na mu kha dgra bo'i don snying rtsa la dzaḥbh+yo zlog: oṃ sri la mu kha dza dzaḥhūm̐ bh+yo zlog:
