sri la mu kha dgra bo'i dbang po lnga la he dzaḥbh+yo zlog: oṃ shrī ma hā mu kha dgra bo'i rtsa khrag srog rtsa snying la he dzaḥbh+yo zlog: oṃ tad+ya thā: traka rak+sha ru mi ru mi nan: muk+ti muk+ti baṃ ma ru lu bh+yo ru lu bh+yo: ma hā yak+sha tika nag mo dun bh+yo zlog: oṃ pad+ma dha ra ru ti re ma ti bh+yo zlog: tsit+ta tsit+ta dgra bo'i glo snying ma ma bh+yo zlog: ma ta mo ru lu ma bh+yo: dgra bo'i snying la dzaḥbh+yo zlog: oṃ ru lu ru lu ko ma ri ye sren mo nan dza dzaḥbh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: bh+yo bh+yo rbad rbad dza dzaḥ kha long kha ru lu dgra bo'i srog dzaḥbh+yo zlog: oṃ muk+ti muk+ti su ru su ru: tsa pa la dzaḥbh+yo zlog: rak+mo shan shan ni kha thun yak+sha snying la shad shad bh+yo zlog: oṃ pra mun dha ri dza dzaḥbh+yo zlog: bse byin yak+sha du ru rbad bh+yo zlog: ke mun dha ri dza dzaḥbh+yo zlog: dha byin yak+sha ru ru rbad bh+yo zlog: oṃ sum tri ba ra ba ra: tsit+ta yo gi nī shwa ra ya ma tsit+ta hūm̐ bh+yo zlog: dgra bo nṛ mā ra ya bh+yo zlog: sa ma ya bh+yo zlog: sa ma ya snying la ya khrag tshal pa bh+yo zlog: bdud pra mā ra ya snying khug baṃ ril bh+yo zlog: oṃ ma ral du pra ma rā tsa mi ta pa la dgra bo'i srog la thib thib: dun tri nan bh+yo zlog: a dzi te a pa ra tsit+ta e dza dzaḥ sa mun+ta sa mun+ta: rak+sha dun dun/ li li/ kram kram/ dza dzaḥ kri li shad ka thun ril rbad chum phur ti shig: snying la thun srog la chum: ka taṃ ka ye dza ye bi dza ye: a dzi te ma pa ra na pra marda ni ye rā tsa ging ka ra sa ra tsika hri tri a pā na ye bh+yo zlog: dgra bo che ge mos btang ba'i phur kha bh+yo zlog: rbad kha bh+yo zlog: thun kha bh+yo zlog: zor kha bh+yo zlog: byol kha bh+yo zlog: dmod kha bh+yo zlog: mnan kha bh+yo zlog: gtad kha bh+yo zlog: khram kha bh+yo zlog: rbad 'dre rbod gtong bsam ngan thams cad dgra la bh+yo zlog:

oṃ trag rak+sha kha 'dar nṛ rbad bh+yo: kha la dza thun nṛ rbad bh+yo: nā ga shu tse nṛ rbad bh+yo: shan+tiṃ pa tri nṛ rbad bh+yo: ma nṛ rak+sha nṛ rbad bh+yo: yak+ṣa kha thun nṛ rbad bh+yo: kha thun tshal pa nṛ rbad bh+yo: hri tri dz+wa la nṛ rbad bh+yo: srid pa pho rgyud dregs pa'i chad pa dgra la bh+yo bh+yo: dza kha thun kha la yak+sha ya: du ra yak+sha snying la ya: khal tse nā ga srog la ya: kha sa ga sha rbad su ya: ma ma rak+sha khrag la ya: ha ri khā hi las la ya: rak+sha ya: shu'o rak+sha dbugs la ya: gh+raṃ bh+yo taṃ bh+yo las la ya: mo rgyud mkha' 'gro'i chad pa dgra la bh+yo bh+yo: tri kha thun khal tse yak+sha rbad: ma ni dza la kha la rbad: ma nṛ rak+sha snying la rbad: bhi ri tsa ni gzugs la rbad: snying khrag dza la srog la rbad: a ka yak+sha srog la rbad: mā ra aṃ ku sha ya snying la rbad: ma nri rak+sha srog la rbad: klu gnyan dregs pa'i chad pa dgra la bh+yo bh+yo: dgra la thun bh+yo: dgra la byad bh+yo: dgra la zor bh+yo: dgra la pha bh+yo: dgra la ma bh+yo: dgra la ming po bh+yo: dgra la sring mo bh+yo: dgra la sngags bh+yo: dgra la bdud bh+yo: dgra la btsan bh+yo: dgra la rgyal po bh+yo: dgra la ma mo bh+yo: dgra la dri za bh+yo: dgra la gnod sbyin bh+yo: dgra la nā ga bh+yo: dgra la gshin rje bh+yo: dgra la mu stegs bh+yo: dgra la rā hu la bh+yo: dgra la rmu bh+yo: byad ma dgra bo'i steng du bh+yo: byad ma dgra bo'i steng du zlog: byad ma dgra bo'i steng du nan: byad ma dgra bo'i kha tham: byad ma dgra bo'i kā ya nan: byad ma dgra bo'i wāka nan: byad ma dgra bo'i tsit+ta nan: zhes bzlog cing bh+yos gdab bo: bcu gcig pa zor bskul ni: hūm̐ */ bcom ldan dpal dgu 'bar ba yi: mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur:

shar phyogs pho nya rab 'bar ba: mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: lho phyogs pho nya rab 'bar ba: mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: lho phyogs pho nya rab 'bar ba: mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: nub phyogs pho nya rab 'bar ba: mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: byang phyogs pho nya rab 'bar ba: mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha pad+ma kro dhī shwa rī a hrīḥ badz+ra kī li kī la ya mahā yak+sha kā la rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ trika nan: e hur thuṃ dzaḥmā ra ya rbad: sarba ru tra hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥ sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ bh+yo: sha trūṃ hur thuṃ dzaḥmā ra ya rbad: dgra bgegs nṛ tri rbad thuṃ: dha ra ya dha ra ya: mā ra ya mā ra ya: nā ga du tshin+dha tshin+dha: mi li mi li: bhan+dha bhan+dha: nā ga ni swā hā: hūm̐ ha he phaṭa bh+yo: hṛ da ya mo ha ya: pra ha ra ṇa ya hūm̐ phaṭa: sa ma ya a ti kra ma ni:

sa ra ṇa bh+yo: a la la bh+yo bh+yo: zlog zlog: ces brjod do: bcu gnyis pa bcol dam bya ba ni: hūm̐ */ phur ba phrin las lha tshogs la: dam nyams dgra bgegs 'byung po 'di: gsod cing bsgral bar bya ba'i phyir: mgo lus rgyan dang bcas pa 'bul: bcol lo gtad do gnyer du longs: lus ngag yid gsum rdul du rlogs: sha khrag gzugs kyi phung po shigs: rnam shes bde chen gnas su drongs: bzhes shig lhag ma med par bzhes: bcol lo gtad do gnyer du longs: zhes brjod do: bcu gsum pa smon lam gdab pa ni: hoḥ phur pa rol pa'i dur khrod chen po na: yab rdo rje gzhon nu: yum 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma: sras mchog kī la ya rigs bzhi: 'jigs byed kyi khro bo pha bcu ma bcu: za byed kyi sprul pa pha bcu: gsod byed kyi phra men ma bcu: pho nya phra men sgo ma bzhi: bka' yi bstan pa bsrung ba'i shwa na ma mched bzhi: sa bdag ma mched bzhi: bdag nyid ma mched bzhi: bse lcags dung gsum: skyes bu bcu gnyis la sogs te: phur pa phrin las kyi lha tshogs bdun cu rtsa bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la phrin las gnyan po bcol ba ni: zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod la sogs pa'i phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub pa dang : rdo rje slob dpon mched dang lcam dral rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la bsrung zhing byin gyis brlab tu gsol: tshe ring ba dang : nad med pa dang : dpal 'byor longs spyod thams cad rgyas par mdzad du gsol: chag che nyam nga rbad 'dre rbod gtong mo ngan rmis ltas mtshan ma ngan pa thams cad phyir zlog cig: bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra la rbad cing gnod par byed pa'i bgegs rnams 'dul ba'i phrin las bcol ba ni: sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che bshig pa: dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smod pa: rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku dgra: rnal 'byor pa'i sgos dgra: mched dang lcam dral gyi spyi dgra:

rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi rkyen dgra: sems can yongs la 'tshe ba: snga dgra lag gis bdar ba: phyi dgra snying la bsams pa: da dgra dngos su 'khu ba: gzugs can gyi dgra: gzugs med kyi bgegs: bar gcod kyi rkyen: bsam pa ngan pa 'chang ba: sbyor ba rtsub mo ston par byed pa'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad thal ba'i rdul du rlogs shig: sku gsung thugs kyi dbyings su gtad do: bcol ba'i las gyis shig: sgrub pa'i rtags phyung zhig: phrin las thams cad mngon sum du 'grub par mdzod cig: ces brjod do: ༈ /spyi don drug pa ma mo rbod gtong gi lha tshogs kyi zlog pa'i phrin las kyi gzhung bsrang ba la'ang bcu gsum ste: dang po gtor ma dbul ba ni: hūm̐ */ 'jig rten snod du bcud rnams gtor mar bcas: snang srid thams cad mchod pa'i yo byad de: mdzes shing bkra bar bshams nas su: ma mo rbod gtong lha tshogs la: gnyis su med pa'i tshogs su 'bul: phung po'i snod du dbang po'i gtor mar bcas: dur khrod gzhal yas mchod pa'i yo byad de: mdzes shing bkra bar bshams nas su: ma mo rbod gtong lha tshogs la: gnyis su med pa'i tshogs su 'bul: bhan+dha lcang lor 'bru bcud gtor mar bcas: dri ro reg bya mchod pa'i yo byad de: mdzes shing bkra bar bshams nas su: ma mo rbod gtong lha tshogs la: gnyis su med pa'i tshogs su 'bul: mchog chen mchog phran sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga: mchod pa'i yo byad sna tshogs rnams: mdzes shing bkra bar bshams nas su: ma mo rbod gtong lha tshogs la: gnyis su med pa'i tshogs su 'bul: zhes dbul lo: gnyis pa spyir bskul ba ni: hūm̐ */ ma mo rol pa'i dur khrod chen po na: bcom ldan dpal chen bla med he ru kaḥ dbyings kyi yum drug rje mo bcu bzhi dang : sring mo sgo ma sman mo lnga bcu brgyad: ma mo rbod gtong lha tshogs thugs dam can: mi mngon dbyings nas sku bzhengs thugs dam bskul:

rmad byung rol pa'i sman raka gtor mas mchod: thugs dam rgyud bskul phrin las rnam bzhi mdzod: ces dang : gsum pa dam can sgos su bskul ba ni: hūm̐ */ sngon mo 'bum gyi las byed ma: mtsho sman rgyal mo dpal ldan ma: sku mdog sngon mo me long thogs: dkar mo 'bum gyi las byed ma: dkar mo chen mo dbu dgu ma: lag na bhan+dha sbram po thogs: ser mo 'bum gyi las byed ma: srid pa'i bu mo dam tshig can: lag na bhan+dha skam po thogs: smug mo 'bum gyi las byed ma: smug nag chen mo dbu lnga ma: lag na bhan+dha rlon pa thogs: dkar mo stong gi las byed ma: khram kha gtong ba'i dbang mo che: lag na thod pa dkar po thogs: ser mo stong gi las byed ma: ri rab gling bzhi'i dbang mo che: lag na bhan+dha ser po thogs: smug mo stong gi las byed ma: theg chen sa gzhi'i dbang mo che: lag na bhan+dha dmar po thogs: sngon mo stong gi las byed ma: rgya mtsho gling gi dbang mo che: lag na bhan+dha sngon po thogs: gnam gyi ye dhar chen mo ni: nag mo mun pa'i go zu can: lag na bhan+dha khrag bkang bsnams: bar gyi glog dmar sring mo ni: khrag gi bud med dmar nag la: lag na bhan+dha khrag bkang thogs: sa yi phung byed nag mo ni: mun pa'i bud med nag mo la: lag na bhan+dha khrag bkang thogs: rtsis kyi ma gsum dus la bab: gsang ba'i ma mo sbeb byed ma: nag mo chen mo lcags kyu thogs: pho nyar lcags kyi spyang mo khrid: gsang ba'i ma mo 'khrug byed ma: nag mo khrag gi lcags kyu thogs: pho nyar zangs kyi khyi mo khrid: gsang ba'i ma mo gsod byed ma: nag mo chen mo spu gri thogs: pho nyar zangs kyi wa mo khrid: gsang ba'i ma gsum dus la bab: ma mo chen mo ro kha ma: nag mo thod pa khrag bkang thogs: ma mo chen mo tsa muṇ+ḍi: smug mo thod pa khrag bkang thogs: ma mo chen mo tsaṇ+ḍi ma: nag mo thod pa khrag bkang thogs: ro kha mched gsum dus la bab:

shar gyi stag srin zor ba gdong : dkar mo lag na zor ba thogs: lho yi bam srin dred mo gdong : ser mo lag na spu gri thogs: nub kyi kong srin ba glang gdong : dmar mo lag na zor ba thogs: byang gi 'brog srin chu srin gdong : sngon mo lag na zor ba thogs: gdong mo bzhi yi dus la bab: ma mo rbod gtong srung ma thugs dam can: dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: yid la gnag pa'i dgra bgegs myur du sgrol: ma ma ru lu ru lu bh+yo: traka rak+sha k+ṣa bh+yo: rak+mo rak+mo sa ma ya bh+yo: zhes rbad cing bskul lo: bzhi pa nya bo dgug pa ni: hūm̐ */ sangs rgyas bstan la rab zhugs shing : byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas: dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob pa'i: rig 'dzin rnal 'byor rnams la ni: gnod cing gdug pa'i dgra dang bgegs: bdud dang bar du gcod pa dang : dngos grub 'phrog cing 'tshe ba rnams: khro bo chen po'i byin rlabs dang : gsang sngags drag po'i mthu stobs kyis: yud tsam zhig gis 'dir khug la: mngon spyod tshul bzhin bsgral ba dang : lus ngag rdul du bshig nas kyang : sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar gyis: nga yi dbang du gyur nas kyang : bsgo ba'i bka' bzhin nyan par gyis: bcom ldan rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha: 'di na gnag pa'i las yod kyi: bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs: skyod cig yum gyi mkha' nas skyod: dam tshig can gyi thugs dam bskul: lcags kyu can gyis snying nas zung : zhags pa can gyis mgul nas chings: lcags sgrog can gyis yan lag sdoms: dril bu can gyis rdul du rlogs: mthu dang rdzu 'phrul 'phrog nas kyang : mgon skyabs grogs dang bral bar mdzod: bla srog rnam shes gzugs la phob: zung zhig rgyob cig rnam par chings: rings par khug la smyor chug cig: lus ngag rdul du brlags nas kyang : gzugs phung rngams pa'i zhal du stobs: pho nya kun gyis phrin las mdzod:

ces brjod do: lnga ba bden stobs brjod pa ni: na mo/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ rigs sngags dang*/ gzungs sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ khyad par du bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams/ ma mo rbod gtong gi lha tshogs khro bo dang khro mo yab yum sprul pa bka' sdod pho nya chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi thugs rje dang phrin las thogs pa med pa'i bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che bshig pa/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smod pa/ bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba/ dam nyams pa'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad skad cig yud tsam zhig la gzugs liṅga ru bris shing*/ ming byang bu ru btab pa 'di la khug cig: badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐: badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ: badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭe hoḥ ā we sha ya a: zhes pa dang*/ oṃ gu h+ya dz+nyā na shrī he ru kaḥ gu h+ya dz+nyā na kro dhī shwa rī s+t+waṃ: ma ma yo gi nī ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ sogs dang*/ de bzhin du/ a pā na ya a pā na ya: ha sa na ya ha sa na ya: ā we sha ya ā we sha ya: shri trin ha na ya shri trin ha na ya: dz+wa la pa ya dz+wa la pa ya: ta thā ya ta thā ya: bhan+dha ya bhan+dha ya: zhes brjod do: drug pa phur skor bya ba ni: hūm̐ */ chos dbyings rang byung grub pa'i lha: ma mo rol pa'i dur khrod nas: shin tu mi bzad skur ston pa: dpal chen drag po'i phrin las mdzod: dpal chen bla med he ru kaḥ yab yum sras 'khor pho nyar bcas: g.yas g.yon thabs shes phur bu sgril: sras mchog rigs kyi phur bu 'di: thogs med rang byung lhun gyis grub: sgril ba tsam gyis lha yang 'dar: rdeg pa tsam gyis srid gsum g.yo: btab na khams gsum thal bar rlog: btab bo theb par mdzod cig kī la ya:

dgra bgegs 'byung po sgrol cig mā ra ya: hūm̐ */ yon tan rgyud las byung ba yi: ma mo rbod gtong sprul pa ste: 'debs byed las kyi phur bu 'bum: srid gsum byad ma'i snying la thob: kī la ya yi sgra sgrog pa: srid pa'i phur bu bdag gis bskul: bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: ces phur bu btab: oṃ gu h+ya dz+nyā na shrī he ru kaḥ gu h+ya dz+nyā na kro dhī shwa rī s+t+waṃ: ma ma yo gi nī ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa: badz+ra nī la kha ṭ+wāṃ kro dhī shwa rī ba ga pad+ma dhe klo shwa na ma dza dzaḥbh+yo bh+yo: ma ma traka rak+sha: ma ma traka rak+sha: ru lu ru lu rak+mo: snying khrag la ma mo bh+yo: traka rak+sha ma ma sri thun bh+yo: dgra bgegs sri du mā ra ya phaṭa: badz+ra ta ha tsa dril rmug sha rmug sha: rbad da ra rbad da ra: mug ti myog sha sod: tsa si snying la ya: mig dkyus nas phyung zhig: rgyus rtsa rtsad nas chod cig: lce lkog nas drongs shig: oṃ ma ma rak+mo tsa tsa snying kha raka rbad su bh+yo: rak+mo rak+mo srog rbad su chom mā ra ya chom rbad: mā ra ya rbad: sod mā ra ya sod: thuṃ ril ya: traka rak+sha rbad ya: gtub gtub: dum bu baṃ baṃ: dgra bgegs kyi srog la mā ra ya rbad: ces brjod do: bdun pa dmar sbreng ba ni: hūm̐ */ nyon mongs 'khor ba dbyings su bsgral ba'i phyir: 'khor ba'i rtsa ba nyon mongs gzung 'dzin khrag: dug gsum ru tra bsgral ba'i rak+ta'i rgyun: dung chen snod du dmar chen ar+ghaṃ sbyar: dpal chen khrag 'thung 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: khams gsum yongs sgrol dpa' bo chen po yis: dug lnga chags pa khrag gi mtsho la rol: gzung 'dzin chags pas mnar ba'i dgra bo 'di: chags med bde chen sa la 'god par shog: ma hā mū la rak+ta la khā hi: zhes dbul lo: brgyad pa bstab pa bya ba ni: hūm̐ */ bstab bo bstab bo zhal du bstab: ma mo rbod gtong lha tshogs zhal phyes shig: nam mkha' gang ba'i zhal phye la:

ri rab tsam gyi mche ba gtsigs: bar snang gang ba'i ljags sgril cig: chos dbyings stong nyid lto ba ru: mchod rdzas dgra bgegs zhal du bstab: zhal du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi: mgul du bsgril lo ā ra li: dbyings su bstim mo sa ma ya: oṃ gu h+ya dz+nyā na shrī he ru kaḥ gu h+ya dz+nyā na kro dhī shwa rī s+t+waṃ: ma ma yo gi nī ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa: sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ sha trūṃ ma hā maṃ sa la khā hi: ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: ma hā keṃ ni ri ti la khā hi: mahā tsit+ta la khā hi: ma hā ba su ta la khā hi: ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi: ma hā tsak+ṣuḥl khā hi: zhes dbul lo: dgu pa bzlog pa'i phrin las gzhung bsrang ba ni: hūm̐ */ bcom ldan dpal chen bla med he ru kaḥ srid pa'i ma mo thams cad zil gyis gnon: dam nyams dgra yi rnam shes da rol la: ma mo'i dmag dpung dam nyams dgra la zlog: gsang ba'i yum chen kun tu bzang mo ni: srid pa'i ma mo thams cad dbang bsdus la: srid pa ma mo'i gdug rtsub dgra la zlog: rtag pa'i rgyal mo ma mo rnam snang gsal: dam nyams dgra yi sha khrag da rol la: rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dmag dpung dgra la zlog: rtag pa'i rgyal mo chen mo 'od gsal 'bar: dam nyams dgra bo'i drod la da rol la: rin chen mkha' 'gro'i dmag dpung dgra la zlog: rtag pa'i rgyal mo chen mo snyan gsal ma: dam nyams dgra yi khrag la da rol la: pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i dmag dpung dgra la zlog: rtag pa'i rgyal mo chen mo yang gsal g.yos: dam nyams dgra yi dbugs la da rol la: las kyi mkha' 'gro'i dmag dpung dgra la zlog: rtag pa'i rgyal mo chen mo bkrag gsal snyems: dam nyams dgra yi bkrag la da rol la: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dmag dpung dgra la zlog: srid pa'i bde 'gro chen mo ma gcig ma: phra men rgya mtsho chen mo gsang ba'i yum: snang srid lha 'dre'i dmag dpung dgra la zlog: dpag bsam shing gi yal ga chen po la:

ma gcig nyi zla stong gi thod phreng can: srid pa'i gza' skar dmag dpung dgra la zlog: rdo rje nyi ma khros pa'i dbang mo che: khams gsum ma lus thams cad gsal mdzad ma: zlog cig rdo rje rigs kyi pho nya thams cad zlog: khams gsum 'tsho byed khros pa'i dbang mo che: khams gsum thams cad gsal bar dbang byed ma: zlog cig rin chen rigs kyi pho nya dgra la zlog: pad+ma khrag 'thung khros pa'i dbang mo ches: khams gsum thams cad dbang du sdud par byed: zlog cig pad+ma rigs kyi pho nya dgra la zlog: srid pa bde sbyor khros pa'i dbang mo che: srid pa gsum po thams cad bde la 'god: zlog cig las kyi rigs kyi pho nya dgra la zlog: snang srid rgyan mdzad rgyan gyi rgyal mo yis: dam nyams dgra bgegs 'di yi sha la rol: zlog bsgyur byed cing bdag nyid lhag lhag bzhad: dgod pa'i stobs kyis bzlog cing bsgyur du gsol: dbyings nas dbyings phyug rgyal mo chen mo yis: dbyings nas zlog sgyur chen mo mdzad du gsol: stong khams kun tu rgyug cing 'gro ba mo: gcig pu yum mchog rgyal mo chen mo yis: mi mthun dgra bgegs bzlog pa'i dus la bab: shar gyi phyogs nas dkar mo spyan gcig ma: dam nyams dgra yi rus la da rol la: shar gyi dgra bgegs thams cad bzlog tu gsol: lho yi phyogs nas nag mo mche ba can: dam nyams dgra yi sha la da rol la: lho yi dgra bgegs thams cad bzlog tu gsol: nub kyi phyogs nas dmar mo dbang sdud ma: dam nyams dgra yi khrag la da rol la: nub kyi dgra bgegs thams cad bzlog tu gsol: byang gi phyogs nas ser mo rkang ldag ma: dam nyams dgra yi dbugs la da rol la: byang gi dgra bgegs thams cad bzlog tu gsol: srid pa gsum gyi bh+yo zlog byed pa mo: srid pa za byed ma mo chen mo yi: dam nyams dgra yi lte bar da rol la: srid pa lha yi dmag dpung bzlog tu gsol:

srid pa cha snyoms ma mo chen mo yis: srid pa gsum po rkos la 'debs pa mo: dam nyams dgra yi pho ba 'di rol la: srid gsum gdug pa'i dmag dpung dgra la zlog: rnal 'byor dgra lha dzā ti ral gcig ma: rnal 'byor phal gyi dgra bgegs thams cad zlog: bstan srung las byed e ka tsa ti mas: bstan pa'i ru tra thams cad bsgral du gsol: bdud kyi yum la gshin rje'i lcam gcig ma: mi nad phyugs nad thams cad rgyun chod la: bdud dang gshin rje'i cho 'phrul dgra la zlog: mdog bzang nag mo grub pa'i rnal 'byor mas: nag mo'i tshogs kyi dmag dpung dgra la zlog: mdog bzang sngon mo lha mo rnal 'byor mas: sngon mo'i tshogs kyi dmag dpung dgra la zlog: mdog bzang dkar mo gling bzhi spyi 'gro mas: dkar mo'i tshogs kyi dmag dpung dgra la zlog: dbu brgya spyan stong ldan pa'i gar dbang mas: stong phrag brgyad cu'i gdon tshogs dgra la sgyur: pad+ma gar dbang sa bdag dpal phreng mas: sa bdag gdon gyi dmag tshogs dgra la sgyur: shar gyi dkar mo chen mo mche gtsigs mas: shar phyogs dri za'i dmag dpung dgra la sgyur: lho yi nag mo chen mo kha 'jam mas: nag mo 'bum sde'i dmag dpung dgra la zlog: nub kyi dmar mo chen mo mchu 'jib mas: dmar mo 'bum sde'i dmag dpung dgra la zlog: byang gi phyogs nas ser mo rkang ldag mas: ser mo 'bum sde'i dmag dpung dgra la zlog: har ting dkar mo byang shar gru 'degs mas: byang shar gdon gyi dmag dpung dgra la zlog: dun ting nag mo shar lho'i gru 'degs mas: shar lho'i gdon gyi dmag dpung dgra la zlog: shan+tiṃ dmar mo lho nub gru 'degs mas: lho nub gdon gyi dmag dpung dgra la zlog: grub ting ser mo nub byang gru 'degs mas: nub byang gdon gyi dmag dpung dgra la zlog: rgya mtsho chen po rab 'byams dkyil 'khor nas: dpal ldan shugs 'gro sum cus dgra bgegs zlog:

khro gtum rngam pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po nas: mdzes tshul gros byed rnams kyi dgra bgegs zlog: nam mkha' yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po nas: bdud dregs kun 'dus ma mo'i dgra bgegs zlog: dbang phyug chen po rngam pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: lcags kyu 'phro 'dus dgra bgegs thams cad zlog: gling bzhi'i mgyogs ma lha yi sring mo ste: lha chen ma hā de wa'i bka' bsgyur la: lha yi chad pa dam nyams dgra la zlog: mkha' la khyung lding gshin rje'i sring mo ste: gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' bsgyur la: gshin rje'i chad pa dam nyams dgra la zlog: dmar mo g.yag thod klu yi sring mo ste: klu rgyal 'jog po zhes bya'i bka' bsgyur la: klu yi chad pa dam nyams dgra la zlog: nag mo sder chen gnod sbyin sring gcig ma: gnod sbyin gang ba bzang po'i bka' bsgyur la: gnod sbyin chad pa dam nyams dgra la zlog: dkar mo chen mo dbu brgya rgyal po'i sring : shar phyogs ging chen srog bdag bka' bsgyur la: brgyal nad smyo 'bog dam nyams dgra la thong : mtsho sman rgyal mo chen mo dpal ldan ma: sa bdag klu gnyan tshogs kyi bka' bsgyur la: dam nyams dgra la mdze nad sna dgu thong : srid pa'i bu mo las mkhan mthu mo che: the'u rang has po che yi bka' bsgyur la: rims nad yams nad dam nyams dgra la thong : dur khrod gnas pa'i lha mo tsa muṇ+ḍi: btsan rgod yam shud dmar po'i bka' bsgyur la: dam nyams dgra la mkhris pa gsha' ya thong : sems las skyes pa'i lha mo rnam pa bzhi: lus las skyes pa'i lha mo rnam pa bzhi: dam la gnas pa'i sring mo rnam pa bzhi: yid la gzhung ba'i mdza' mo rnam pa bzhi: bdud rtsi sgrub pa'i rgyal mo rnam pa bzhi: phur bu sgrub pa'i blon mo rnam pa bzhi: ma mo kun gyi gtso mo rnam pa bzhi: ma mo thun gyi bdag mo rnam pa bzhi: yid pa gshin pa'i bran mo rnam pa bzhi: dgra bo'i bla srog 'phrog pa'i lha mo bzhi:

srid pa ma mo'i bka' srung las byed tshogs: dam nyams dgra bo'i glo snying sha khrag dang : dbang po nang khrol rnams la da rol la: srid pa ma mo'i bka' bsgyur dgra la zlog: gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: ma mo rbod gtong lha tshogs 'dir gshegs la: mi sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dam nyams 'byung po 'di la da rol cig: ma hā maṃ sa la khā hi: ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi: ma hā keṃ ni ri ti la khā hi: ma hā ba su ta la khā hi: ma hā tsak+ṣuḥl khā hi: ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā hi: ma hā ba ling+ta la khā hi: bcu pa bzlog cing bh+yos gdab pa ni: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ zlog byed bla med he ru kaḥ bh+yo zlog drag po'i dus la bab: sangs rgyas bstan zhugs rnal 'byor la: phyogs bcu kun nas gdug pa yi: bsam sbyor ngan pa'i rigs sngags dang : sde brgyad dregs pa'i ngan sngags dang : snang srid lha 'dre'i rbod gtong dang : drang srong bka' yi dmod pa dang : ban bon 'dus pa'i sngags zor dang : gshin rje'i 'khor lo ma mo'i thun: klu yi gtad mnan pho nya'i zor: mthu brub byad dang mi kha ngan: lo zla zhag dang za ma'i skag: dus min 'chi ba la sogs rnams: byad ma dgra bgegs rnams la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo gnod pa'i bgegs la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo bar chad bdud la bh+yo: zhes dang*/ oṃ gu h+ya dz+nyā na shrī he ru kaḥ gu h+ya dz+nyā na kro dhī shwa rī s+t+waṃ: ma ma yo gi nī ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa: ma ma e ka tsa ti ru ru ro ru tsa pa la a shuka me nṛ dzaḥbh+yo zlog: traka rak+sha ma mun tra ma ma ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo zlog: rak+mo ti kum dza kha la ma hi bh+yo zlog: spyi ting kha la ma hi bh+yo zlog: rak+sha ya snying zor thogs ma kha raka dza dzaḥrak+mo rak+mo snying kha rak+mo dza dzaḥ kha raka: sha ma snying kha rak+mo dzaḥbh+yo zlog: ru lu ru lu snying khrag kha la rak+sha nṛ rbad thuṃ ri li bh+yo zlog:

nṛ sha ku ru rak+ta kha raṃ kha raṃ ni sha bh+yo zlog: traka rak+sha mu tra snying kha rak+mo bh+yo zlog: rak+mo rak+mo ru lu tsa pa la bh+yo zlog: dgra yi snying kha rak+mo bh+yo zlog: rak+mo rak+mo tsab tsab mo bh+yo zlog: rak+mo rak+mo khrag ma bu tra ma traka rak+sha mun tra bh+yo zlog: ru lu ru lu bh+yo zlog: ma ma snying kha rak+mo bh+yo zlog: ru lu ru lu bh+yo zlog: ma snying la gzer ru tra bh+yo zlog: ma ma traka rak+sha srog la gzer thuṃ rbad bh+yo zlog: ma ma traka rak+sha snying srog rtsa la thuṃ rbad bh+yo zlog: dun ting dun ting ru ru la ya dzaḥbh+yo zlog: dzaḥku ma shan+ti rbad bh+yo zlog: tri ma ra du ru rbad ya bh+yo zlog: du ru ma tri rbad ya bh+yo zlog: ba ya ra ru lu rbad ya bh+yo zlog: chum chu no ma tsa rbad ya bh+yo zlog: sha la ya: rus la ya: chem chem rbad rbad: pu shag pa rbad: traka thuṃ: rbad mug ya bh+yo zlog: du ru ra ti ma bh+yo zlog: shu la dha ri bh+yo zlog: tsa mun dha ri bh+yo zlog: kaṃ ka dha ri bh+yo zlog: ma ma sha ra ma ma sa ma ya: da sha kha sha baṃ traka rak+sha ma ma bh+yo zlog: snying khrag tsa thun ma: thun dzaḥbh+yo zlog: ma ma ya ma nṛ khug dam dza: ma tri rak+sha ma thun khrag dral dral dun dun ma ma srog shan mā yā: sha ru mu kha sa dha ha pa tsa dha ha na tsa: sod sod bh+yo zlog: rbod zor sarba bh+yo zlog: dgra bo che ge mos btang ba'i phur kha bh+yo zlog: zor kha bh+yo zlog: byol kha bh+yo zlog: dmod mo bh+yo zlog: rbad kha bh+yo zlog: rbod gtong bh+yo zlog: mnan kha bh+yo zlog: gtad kha bh+yo zlog: khram kha bh+yo zlog: rbad 'dre rbod gtong zlog: bsam ngan gtong ba thams cad zlog: oṃ traka rak+sha kha 'dar nṛ rbad bh+yo: kha la dza dun nṛ rbad bh+yo: nā ga shu tse nṛ rbad bh+yo: shan+tiṃ pa nṛ rbad bh+yo: ma nṛ rak+sha nṛ rbad bh+yo: yak+sha kha thun nṛ rbad bh+yo: kha thun tshal pa nṛ rbad bh+yo: hri tri dz+wa la nṛ rbad bh+yo:

srid pa pho rgyud dregs pa'i chad pa dgra la bh+yo bh+yo: dza kha thun kha la yak+sha ya: du ra yak+sha snying la ya: khal tse nā ga srog la ya: kha sa ga sha rbad su ya: ma ma rak+sha khrag la ya: ha ri khā hi las la ya: rak+sha ya: shu'o rak+sha dbugs la ya: gh+raṃ bh+yo taṃ bh+yo las la ya: mo rgyud mkha' 'gro'i chad pa dgra la bh+yo bh+yo: tri kha thun khal tse yak+sha rbad: ma ni dza la kha la rbad: ma nṛ rak+sha snying la rbad: bhi ri tsa ni gzugs la rbad: snying khrag dza la srog la rbad: a ka yak+sha srog la rbad: mā ra aṃ ku sha ya snying la rbad: ma ni rak+sha srog la rbad: klu gnyan dregs pa'i chad pa dgra la bh+yo bh+yo: dgra la thun bh+yo: dgra la byad bh+yo: dgra la zor bh+yo: dgra la pha bh+yo: dgra la ma bh+yo: dgra la ming po bh+yo: dgra la sring mo bh+yo: dgra la sngags bh+yo: dgra la bdud bh+yo: dgra la btsan bh+yo: dgra la rgyal po bh+yo: dgra la ma mo bh+yo: dgra la dri za bh+yo: dgra la gnod sbyin bh+yo: dgra la nā ga bh+yo: dgra la gshin rje bh+yo: dgra la rmu bh+yo: dgra la mu stegs bh+yo: dgra la rā hu la bh+yo: byad ma dgra bo'i steng du bh+yo: byad ma dgra bo'i steng du zlog: byad ma dgra bo'i steng du nan: byad ma dgra bo'i kha tham: byad ma dgra bo'i kā ya nan: byad ma dgra bo'i wāka nan: byad ma dgra bo'i tsit+ta nan: zhes bzlog cing bh+yos gdab bo: bcu gcig pa zor bskul ba ni: hūm̐ */ bcom ldan dpal dgu 'bar ba yi: mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la bsgyur: hūm̐ */ shar phyogs pho nya rab 'bar ba: mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog:

bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: hūm̐ */ lho phyogs pho nya rab 'bar ba: mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: hūm̐ */ nub phyogs pho nya rab 'bar ba: mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: hūm̐ */ byang phyogs pho nya rab 'bar ba: mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha pad+ma kro dhī shwa rī a hrīḥ badz+ra kī li kī li ya ma hā yak+sha kā la rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ trika nan: e hur thuṃ dzaḥmā ra ya rbad: sarba ru tra hriṃ hriṃ dza: sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ bh+yo: sha trūṃ hur thuṃ dzaḥ mā ra ya rbad: dgra bgegs dam sri nṛ tri rbad thuṃ: dha ra ya dha ra ya: mā ra ya mā raya: nā ga du tshin+dha tshin+dha: mi li mi li: bhan+dha bhan+dha nā ga ni swā hā: hūm̐ ha he phaṭa bh+yo: hṛ da ya mo ha ya: pra ha ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa: sa ma ya a ti kra ma ni: sa ra ṇa bh+yo: a la la bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: ces brjod do: bcu gnyis pa bcol dam bya ba ni: hūm̐ */ ma mo rbod gtong lha tshogs la: dam nyams dgra bgegs 'byung po 'di: gsod cing bsgral bar bya ba'i phyir: mgo lus rgyan dang bcas pa 'bul: bcol lo gtad do gnyer du longs: lus ngag yid gsum rdul du rlogs: sha khrag gzugs kyi phung po shigs: rnam shes bde chen gnas su drongs: bzhes shig lhag ma med par mdzod:

bcol lo gtad do gnyer du longs: zhes brjod do: bcu gsum pa smon lam gdab ba ni: hoḥ ma mo rol pa'i dur khrod chen po na: yab bla med he ru kaḥ yum nyid gzhi mu kha le: dbyings kyi yum drug: rtag pa'i rgyal mo lnga: bde 'gro thod phreng : khros pa'i ma bzhi: thugs kyi dgyes sde bzhi: sbas pa'i ma bzhi: chags byed cha snyoms: dzā ti dza ra spun gnyis: nam mkha'i rgyal mo ni mtshan gnyis: 'dod khams gtso mo spun gsum: dmag gi rgyal mo bzhi: gru 'degs ma bzhi: ye shes ma bdun: sring mo sgo ba bzhi: phung byed sbas pa'i ma bzhi: gdong mo mched bzhi: ro kha ma gsum: nag mo phung gsum: gsang ba'i pho nya gsum: ma mo rbod gtong gi lha tshogs bdun cu rtsa bdun la phrin las gnyan po bcol ba ni: zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod la sogs pa'i phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub pa dang : rdo rje slob dpon mched dang lcam dral dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la bsrung zhing byin gyis brlab tu gsol: tshe ring ba dang : nad med pa dang : dpal 'byor longs spyod thams cad rgyas par mdzad du gsol: chags che nyam nga rbad 'dre rbod gtong mo ngan rmis ltas mtshan ma ngan pa thams cad phyir zlog cig: bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra la rbad cing gnod par byed pa'i bgegs rnams 'dul ba'i phrin las su bcol ba ni: sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che bshig pa: dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smod pa: rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku dgra: rnal 'byor pa'i sgos dgra: mched dang lcam dral gyi spyi dgra: rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi rkyen dgra: sems can yongs la 'tshe ba: snga dgra lag gis bdar ba: phyi dgra snying la bsams pa: da dgra dngos su 'khu ba: gzugs can gyi dgra: gzugs med kyi bgegs: bar gcod kyi rkyen: bsam pa ngan pa 'chang ba: sbyor ba rtsub mo ston par byed pa'i byad ma dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad thal ba'i rdul du rlog pa'i phrin las mdzod cig:

sku gsung thugs kyi dbyings su gtad do: bcol ba'i las gyis shig: sgrub pa'i rtags phyung zhig: 'phrin las thams cad mngon sum du 'grub par mdzod cig: ces brjod do: ༈ /spyi don bdun pa rig 'dzin slob dpon gyi lha tshogs kyi zlog pa'i phrin las gzhung bsrang ba la yang bcu gsum ste: dang po gtor ma 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ */ 'jig rten snod du bcud rnams gtor mar bcas: snang srid thams cad mchod pa'i yo byad de: mdzes shing bkra bar bshams nas su: rig 'dzin slob dpon lha tshogs la: gnyis su med pa'i tshogs su 'bul: phung po'i snod du dbang po'i gtor mar bcas: dur khrod gzhal yas mchod pa'i yo byad de: mdzes shing bkra bar bshams nas su: rig 'dzin slob dpon lha tshogs la: gnyis su med pa'i tshogs su 'bul: bhan+dha lcang lor 'bru bcud gtor mar bcas: dri ro reg bya mchod pa'i yo byad de: mdzes shing bkra bar bshams nas su: rig 'dzin slob dpon lha tshogs la: gnyis su med pa'i tshogs su 'bul: mchog chen mchog phran sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga: mchod pa'i bye brag sna tshogs rnams: mdzes shing bkra bar bshams nas su: rig 'dzin slob dpon lha tshogs la: gnyis su med pa'i tshogs su 'bul: zhes dbul lo: gnyis pa spyir bskul ba ni: hūm̐ */ rig 'dzin rol pa'i dur khrod chen po na: rig 'dzin gtso bo rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: grub pa'i rig 'dzin bzhi dang rig 'dzin brgyad: sgo bzhi rdo rje slob dpon khro bo'i tshogs: rig 'dzin slob dpon lha tshogs thugs dam can: mi mngon dbyings nas sku bzhengs thugs dam bskul: rmad byung rol pa'i sman raka gtor mas mchod: thugs dam rgyud bskul phrin las rnam bzhi mdzod: ces pa dang : gsum pa dam can sgos su bskul ba ni: hūm̐ */ rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma: dkar mo rdo rje thod khrag thogs: rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma: ser mo rin chen thod khrag thogs:

pad+ma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma: dmar mo pad+ma thod khrag thogs: las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma: ljang gu rgya gram thod khrag thogs: 'jig rten las kyi mkha' 'gro ma: sna tshogs gri gug thod khrag thogs: rdo rje rigs kyi dpa' bo ni: sngon po rdo rje thod khrag thogs: rin chen rigs kyi dpa' bo ni: ser po rin chen thod khrag thogs: pad+ma rigs kyi dpa' bo ni: dmar po pad+ma thod khrag thogs: las kyi rigs kyi dpa' bo ni: ljang gu rgya gram thod khrag thogs: 'jig rten las kyi dpa' bo ni: sna tshogs gri gug thod khrag thogs: dpal bo dpa' mo rnal 'byor tshogs: sil snyan mang po si li li: rgyan cha mang po pu ru ru: mkha' 'gro mang po sprin ltar gtibs: 'dir byon rig 'dzin srung ma'i tshogs: dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa bzhes: yid la gnag pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba hūm̐ phaṭa: ces rbad cing bskul lo: bzhi pa nya bo dgug pa ni: hūm̐ */ sangs rgyas bstan la rab zhugs shing : byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas: dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob pa'i: rig 'dzin rnal 'byor rnams la yang : gnod cing gdug pa'i dgra dang bgegs: bdud dang bar du gcod pa dang : dngos grub 'phrog cing 'tshe ba rnams: khro bo chen po'i byin rlabs dang : gsang sngags drag po'i mthu stobs kyis: yud tsam zhig gis 'dir khug la: mngon spyod tshul bzhin bsgral ba dang : lus ngag rdul du bshig nas kyang : sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar gyis: nga yi dbang du gyur nas kyang : bsgo ba'i bka' la nyan par gyis: bcom ldan rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha: 'di na gnag pa'i las yod kyi: bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs: skyod cig yum gyi mkha' nas skyod: dam tshig can gyi thugs dam bskul: lcags kyu can gyis snying nas zung : zhags pa can gyis mgul nas chings: lcags sgrog can gyis yan lag sdoms: dril bu can gyis rdul du rlogs:

mthu dang rdzu 'phrul 'phrog nas kyang : mgon skyabs grogs dang bral bar mdzod: bla srog rnam shes gzugs la phob: zung zhig rgyob cig rnam par chings: rings par khug la smyor chug cig: lus ngag rdul du brlags nas kyang : gzugs phung rngams pa'i zhal du stobs: pho nya kun gyis phrin las mdzod: ces brjod do: lnga pa bden pa brjod pa ni: na mo/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ rigs sngags dang*/ gzungs sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ khyad par du bcom ldan 'das rgyal pa zhi khro rab 'byams/ rig 'dzin slob dpon gyi lha tshogs khro bo dang khro mo yab yum sprul pa pho nya bka' sdod chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi thugs rje dang phrin las thogs pa med pa'i bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che bshig pa/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smod pa/ bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba/ dam nyams pa'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad skad cig yud tsam zhig la gzugs liṅga ru bris shing*/ ming byang bu ru bris pa 'di la khug cig: badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐: badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ: badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭe hoḥ ā we sha ya a: zhes dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ sogs dang*/ de bzhin du/ a pā na ya a pā na ya: ha sa na ya ha sa na ya: ā we sha ya ā we sha ya: shri trin ha na ya shri trin ha na ya: dz+wa la pa ya dz+wa la pa ya: ta thā ya ta thā ya: bhan+dha ya bhan+dha ya: zhes brjod do: drug pa phur skor bya ba ni: hūm̐ */ chos dbyings rang byung grub pa'i lha: rig 'dzin rol pa'i dur khrod nas: shin tu mi bzad skur ston pa: dpal chen drag po'i phrin las mdzod: yab yum sras 'khor pho nyar bcas: g.yas g.yon thabs shes phur bu sgril: sras mchog rigs kyi phur bu 'di:

thogs med rang byung lhun gyis grub: sgril ba tsam gyis lha yang 'dar: rdeg pa tsam gyis srid gsum g.yo: btab na khams gsum thal bar rlog: btab bo theb par mdzod cig kī la ya: dgra bgegs 'byung po sgrol cig mā ra ya: hūm̐ */ yon tan rgyud las byung ba yi: rig 'dzin slob dpon sprul pa ste: 'debs byed las kyi phur bu 'bum: srid gsum byad ma'i snying la thob: kī la ya yi sgra sgrog pa: srid pa'i phur bu bdag gis bskul: bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: ces phur bu gdab bo: oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba hūm̐ phaṭa: kā la rū pa dgra bgegs che ge mo'i srog la mā ra ya rbad: kī li kī la ya nṛ rbad: ces brjod do: bdun pa dmar sbreng ba ni: hūm̐ */ nyon mongs 'khor ba dbyings su bsgral ba'i phyir: 'khor ba'i rtsa ba nyon mongs gzung 'dzin khrag: dug gsum ru tra bsgral ba'i rak+ta'i rgyun: dung chen snod du dmar chen ar+ghaṃ sbyar: dpal chen khrag 'thung 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: khams gsum yongs sgrol dpa' bo chen po yis: dug lnga chags pa khrag gi mtsho la rol: gzung 'dzin chags pas mnar ba'i dgra bo 'di: chags med bde chen sa la 'god par shog: ma hā mū la rak+ta la kha raṃ khā hi: zhes so: brgyad pa bstab pa bya ba ni: hūm̐ */ bstab bo bstab bo zhal du bstab: rig 'dzin bla ma'i lha tshogs zhal phyes shig: nam mkha' gang ba'i zhal phye la: ri rab tsam gyi mche ba gtsigs: bar snang gang ba'i ljags sgril cig: chos dbyings stong nyid lto ba ru: mchod rdzas dgra bgegs zhal du bstab: zhal du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi: mgul du bsgril lo ā ra li: dbyings su bstim mo sa ma ya: oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba hūm̐ phaṭa: sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ sha trūṃ ma hā maṃ sa la khā hi: ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: ma hā tsit+ta la khā hi: ma hā keṃ ni ri ti la khā hi: ma hā ba su ta la khā hi: ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi:

ma hā tsak+ṣuḥl khā hi: ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā hi: zhes dbul lo: dgu pa bzlog pa'i phrin las gzhung bsrang ba ni: hūm̐ */ che mchog yon tan rig 'dzin chen po rnams: yon tan gnas nas sku bzhengs 'dir gshegs shig: mchod pa'i gtor ma dgra sha 'di la rol: dgra bgegs zlog cing sgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: yang dag thugs kyi rig 'dzin chen po rnams: thugs kyi gnas nas sku bzhengs 'dir gshegs shig: mchod pa'i gtor ma dgra sha 'di rol la: dgra bgegs zlog cing sgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: 'jam dpal sku yi rig 'dzin chen po rnams: sku yi gnas nas sku bzhengs 'dir gshegs shig: mchod pa'i gtor ma dgra sha 'di rol la: dgra bgegs zlog cing sgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: pad+ma gsung gi rig 'dzin chen po rnams: gsung gi gnas nas sku bzhengs 'dir gshegs shig: mchod pa'i gtor ma dgra sha 'di rol la: dgra bgegs zlog cing sgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: phur pa phrin las rig 'dzin chen po rnams: rig 'dzin gnas nas sku bzhengs 'dir gshegs shig: mchod pa'i gtor ma dgra sha 'di rol la: dgra bgegs zlog cing sgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin chen po rnams: lhun grub gnas nas sku bzhengs 'dir gshegs shig: mchod pa'i gtor ma dgra sha 'di la rol: dgra bgegs zlog cing sgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin chen po rnams: phyag rgya'i gnas nas sku bzhengs 'dir gshegs shig: mchod pa'i gtor ma dgra sha 'di rol la: dgra bgegs zlog cing sgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: sa la gnas pa'i rig 'dzin chen po rnams: sar gnas gnas nas sku bzhengs 'dir gshegs shig: mchod pa'i gtor ma dgra sha 'di rol la: dgra bgegs zlog cing sgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin chen po rnams: rig 'dzin gnas nas sku bzhengs 'dir gshegs shig: mchod pa'i gtor ma dgra sha 'di rol la:

dgra bgegs zlog cing sgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: ma mo rbod gtong rig 'dzin chen po rnams: rbod gtong gnas nas sku bzhengs 'dir gshegs shig: mchod pa'i gtor ma dgra sha 'di rol la: dgra bgegs zlog cing sgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: 'jig rten mchod bstod rig 'dzin chen po rnams: 'jig rten gnas nas sku bzhengs 'dir gshegs shig: mchod pa'i gtor ma dgra sha 'di rol la: dgra bgegs zlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: dmod pa drag sngags rig 'dzin chen po rnams: drag sngags gnas nas sku bzhengs 'dir gshegs shig: mchod pa'i gtor ma dgra sha 'di rol la: dgra bgegs zlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: rig 'dzin slob dpon lha tshogs 'dir gshegs shig: mi sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dam nyams 'byung po 'di la da rol cig: ma hā maṃ sa la khā hi: ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: ma hā tsit+ta la khā hi: ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi: ma hā ba su ta la khā hi: ma hā keṃ ni ri ti la khā hi: ma hā tsak+ṣuḥl khā hi: ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā hi: ma hā ba ling+ta la khā hi: bcu pa bzlog cing bh+yos gdab pa ni: hūm̐ */ zlog byed rig 'dzin thod pa rtsal: bh+yo zlog drag po'i dus la bab: sangs rgyas bstan zhugs rnal 'byor la: phyogs bcu kun nas gdug pa yi: bsam sbyor ngan pa'i rig sngags dang : sde brgyad dregs pa'i ngan sngags dang : snang srid lha 'dre'i rbod gtong dang : drang srong bka' yi dmod pa dang : ban bon 'dus pa'i sngags zor dang : gshin rje'i 'khor lo ma mo'i thun: klu yi gtad mnan pho nya'i zor: mthu brub byad dang mi kha ngan: lo zla zhag dang za ma'i skag: dus min 'chi ba la sogs rnams: byad ma dgra bgegs rnams la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo gnod pa'i bgegs la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo bar chad bdud la bh+yo:

zhes dang : oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī bh+yo zlog: oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī bh+yo zlog: oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī bh+yo zlog: oṃ karma ḍā ki nī bh+yo zlog: oṃ badz+ra ging ka ra bh+yo zlog: oṃ rat+na ging ka ra bh+yo zlog: oṃ pad+ma ging ka ra bh+yo zlog: oṃ karma ging ka ra bh+yo zlog: hrīḥmaḥhaḥriḥniḥsaḥbh+yo zlog: ma ma kha la yak+mo bh+yo zlog: dgra bo'i snying la he bh+yo zlog: haṃ khaṃ sti ta bh+yo zlog: snying la ti ri bh+yo zlog: ma ma ḍā ki nī kī la ya bh+yo zlog: ma ti rbod zor sarba bh+yo zlog: raḥtsaḥhrīḥyaḥd sha grī ba ma ma ting kha ru ti ya bh+yo zlog: ging ka ra ya du ni bh+yo zlog: hu lu hu lu gardza gardza bh+yo zlog: raḥtsaḥhrīḥyaḥsrog la bruṃ bruṃ ra tsa snying ti la shaka shaka bh+yo bh+yo zlog: da sha grī ba dgra bo'i srog la rbud rbud bh+yo zlog: ru tri ya rbud ya ging ka ra bh+yo zlog: ma ma dun dun bh+yo zlog: kā la rū pa tri ti rbad bh+yo zlog: rbod gtong sarba bh+yo zlog: dgra bo che ge mos btang ba'i phur kha zlog: zor kha zlog: byol kha zlog: dmod kha zlog: rbod gtong zlog: rbad kha zlog: mnan kha zlog: gtad kha zlog: khram kha zlog: rbad 'dre rbod gtong bsam ngan thams cad dgra la bh+yo zlog: oṃ traka rak+sha kha 'dar nṛ rbad bh+yo: kha la dza dun nṛ rbad bh+yo: nā ga shu tse nṛ rbad bh+yo: shan+tiṃ pa nṛ rbad bh+yo: ma nṛ rak+sha nṛ rbad bh+yo: yak+sha kha thun nṛ rbad bh+yo: kha thun tshal pa nṛ rbad bh+yo: hri tri dz+wa la nṛ rbad bh+yo: srid pa pho rgyud dregs pa'i chad pa dgra la bh+yo bh+yo: dza kha thun kha la yak+sha ya: du ra yak+sha snying la ya: khal tse nā ga srog la ya: kha sa ga sha rbad su ya: ma ma rak+sha khrag la ya: ha ri khā hi las la ya: rak+sha ya: shu'o rak+sha dbugs la ya: gh+raṃ bh+yo taṃ bh+yo las la ya: mo rgyud mkha' 'gro'i chad pa dgra la bh+yo bh+yo:

tri kha thun khal tse yak+sha rbad: ma ni dza la kha la rbad: ma nṛ rak+sha dbugs la rbad: bhi ri tsa ni gzugs la rbad: snying khrag dza la srog la rbad: a ka yak+sha srog la rbad: mā ra aṃ ku sha ya snying la rbad: ma ni rak+sha srog la rbad: klu gnyan dregs pa'i chad pa dgra la bh+yo bh+yo: dgra la thun bh+yo: dgra la byad bh+yo: dgra la zor bh+yo: dgra la pha bh+yo: dgra la ma bh+yo: dgra la ming po bh+yo: dgra la sring mo bh+yo: dgra la sngags bh+yo: dgra la bdud bh+yo: dgra la btsan bh+yo: dgra la rgyal po bh+yo: dgra la ma mo bh+yo: dgra la dri za bh+yo: dgra la gnod sbyin bh+yo: dgra la nā ga bh+yo: dgra la gshin rje bh+yo: dgra la rmu bh+yo: dgra la mu stegs bh+yo: dgra la rā hu la bh+yo: byad ma dgra bo'i steng du bh+yo: byad ma dgra bo'i steng du zlog: byad ma dgra bo'i steng du nan: byad ma dgra bo'i kha tham: byad ma dgra bo'i kā ya nan: byad ma dgra bo'i wāka nan: byad ma dgra bo'i tsit+ta nan: zhes bzlog cing bh+yos gdab bo: bcu gcig pa zor bskul ni: hūm̐ */ bcom ldan dpal dgu 'bar ba yi: mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: hūm̐ */ shar phyogs pho nya rab 'bar ba: mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: hūm̐ */ lho phyogs pho nya rab 'bar ba: mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: hūm̐ */ nub phyogs pho nya rab 'bar ba:

mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: hūm̐ */ byang phyogs pho nya rab 'bar ba: mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha pad+ma kro dhī shwa rī a hrīḥ badz+ra kī li kī la ya mahā yak+sha kā la rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ trika nan: e hur thuṃ dzaḥmā ra ya rbad: sarba ru tra hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥ sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ bh+yo: sha trūṃ hur dzaḥmā ra ya rbad: dgra bgegs dam sri nṛ tri rbad thuṃ: dha ra ya dha ra ya: mā ra ya mā ra ya: nā ga du tshin+dha tshin+dha: mi li mi li: bhan+dha bhan+dha: nā ga ni swā hā: hūm̐ ha he phaṭa bh+yo: hṛ da ya mo ha ya: pra ha ra ṇa ya hūm̐ phaṭa: sa ma ya a ti kra ma ni: sa ra ṇa bh+yo: a la la bh+yo zlog: ces brjod do: bcu gnyis pa bcol dam bya ba ni: hūm̐ */ rig 'dzin slob dpon lha tshogs la: dam nyams dgra bgegs 'byung po 'di: gsod cing bsgral bar bya ba'i phyir: mgo lus rgyan dang bcas pa 'bul: bcol lo gtad do gnyer du longs: lus ngag yid gsum rdul du rlogs: sha khrag gzugs kyi phung po shigs: rnam shes bde chen gnas su drongs: bzhes shig lhag ma med par bzhes: bcol lo gtad do gnyer du longs: zhes brjod do: bcu gsum pa smon lam gdab pa ni: hoḥ rig 'dzin rol pa'i dur khrod chen po na: rig 'dzin gtso bo rdo rje thod pa rtsal: che mchog yon tan gyi rig 'dzin: yang dag thugs kyi rig 'dzin: 'jam dpal sku yi rig 'dzin: pad+ma gsung gi rig 'dzin: phur pa phrin las kyi rig 'dzin:

lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin: phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin: sa la gnas pa'i rig 'dzin: tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin: ma mo rbod gtong gi rig 'dzin: dregs pa drag sngags kyi rig 'dzin: rig 'dzin sde bzhi: slob dpon sde bzhi: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sde lnga la sogs pa rig 'dzin slob dpon gyi lha tshogs sum cu rtsa gcig la phrin las gnyan po bcol ba ni: zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod la sogs pa'i phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub pa dang : rdo rje slob dpon mched dang lcam dral rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor dang bcas pa la bsrung zhing byin gyis brlab tu gsol: tshe ring ba dang : nad med pa dang : dpal 'byor longs spyod thams cad rgyas par mdzad du gsol: chag che nyam nga rbad 'dre rbod gtong mo ngan rmis ltas mtshan ma ngan pa thams cad phyir zlog cig: bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra la rbad cing gnod par byed pa'i bgegs rnams 'dul ba'i phrin las su bcol ba ni: sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa: dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smod pa: rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku dgra: rnal 'byor pa'i sgos dgra: mched dang lcam dral gyi spyi dgra: rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi rkyen dgra: sems can yongs la 'tshe ba: snga dgra lag gis bdar ba: phyi dgra snying la bsams pa: da dgra dngos su 'khu ba: gzugs can gyi dgra: gzugs med kyi bgegs: bar gcod kyi rkyen: bsam pa ngan pa 'chang ba: sbyor ba rtsub mo ston par byed pa'i byad ma dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad thal ba'i rdul du rlogs shig: sku gsung thugs kyi dbyings su gtad do: bcol ba'i las gyis shig: sgrub pa'i rtags phyung zhig: phrin las thams cad mngon sum du 'grub par mdzod cig: ces brjod do: ༈ /spyi don brgyad pa 'jig rten mchod bstod kyi zlog pa'i phrin las gzhung bsrang ba la yang bcu gsum ste: dang po gtor ma 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ */ 'jig rten snod du bcud rnams gtor mar bcas:

snang srid thams cad mchod pa'i yo byad de: mdzes shing bkra bar bshams nas su: 'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs la: gnyis su med pa'i tshogs su 'bul: phung po'i snod du dbang po'i gtor mar bcas: dur khrod gzhal yas mchod pa'i yo byad de: mdzes shing bkra bar bshams nas su: 'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs la: gnyis su med pa'i tshogs su 'bul: bhan+dha lcang lor 'bru bcud gtor mar bcas: dri ro reg bya mchod pa'i yo byad de: mdzes shing bkra bar bshams nas su: 'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs la: gnyis su med pa'i tshogs su 'bul: mchog chen mchog phran sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga: mchod pa'i yo byad bye brag sna tshogs rnams: mdzes shing bkra bar bshams nas su: 'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs la: gnyis su med pa'i tshogs su 'bul: zhes dbul lo: gnyis pa spyir bskul ba ni: hūm̐ */ dregs pa rol pa'i dur khrod chen po na: lha mchog dregs pa kun 'dul yab yum dang : dbang phyug ma hā de wa btsun mor bcas: dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu 'khor dang bcas: 'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs dus la bab: mi mngon dbyings nas sku bzhengs thugs dam bskul: rmad byung rol pa'i sman raka gtor mas mchod: thugs dam rgyud bskul phrin las rnam bzhi mdzod: ces dang : gsum pa dam can sgos su bskul ba ni: hūm̐ */ lha chen dbang phyug chen po ni: mthing nag dar nag ber chen gsol: phyag na gri gug thod khrag bsnams: chibs su seng ge dkar mo bcibs: dgra bgegs dam nyams rdul du rlog: yum chen u ma de wī ni: mthing nag dar nag ber chen gsol: phyag na kha ṭ+wāṃ thod khrag bsnams: chibs su glang chen dar ma bcibs: dam nyams dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: hūm̐ */ shar gyi phyogs nas bskul ba ni: gshin rje ya ma rā dza ste: sku mdog nag po mi bzad pa: na bza' gcan gzan pags pa gsol: phyag na be con thod dbyug bsnams:

chibs su ma he sngo nag bcibs: dgra bgegs dam nyams rdul du rlog: yum chen gshin rje za byed ma: nag mo dar nag go zu gsol: phyag na srid pa'i 'khor lo bsnams: chibs su chu glang dar ma bcibs: dgra bgegs dam nyams rdul du rlog: lho yi phyogs nas bskul ba ni: bdud po brkos rje drang dkar ni: sku mdog nag po ber nag gsol: phyag na khram shing dgra sta bsnams: chibs su bdud rta nag po bcibs: dgra bgegs dam nyams rdul du rlog: yum chen nag mo re ma ti: nag mo dar nag go zu gsol: khram baṃ g.yas la nad rkyal g.yon: chibs su bong bu ga dmar bcibs: dgra bgegs dam nyams rdul du rlog: nub kyi phyogs nas bskul ba ni: srin po yak+sha glog phreng can: sku mdog dud kha 'jigs pa la: sku la glog gi thul pa gsol: thog chen g.yas la glog dmar g.yon: chibs su nam mkha'i 'brug la bcibs: dgra bgegs dam nyams rdul du rlog: yum chen sha za khrag mig ma: sku mdog dmar nag mi bsrun ma: sku la khrag gi le brgan gsol: phyag na khrag phur khrag phor bsnams chibs su rnga mong ga pa bcibs: dgra bgegs dam nyams rdul du rlog: byang gi phyogs nas bskul ba ni: gnod sbyin yak+sha me dbal ni: na bza' mi yi pags pa gsol: phyag na rin chen ral gri bsnams: chibs su stag seng stobs ldan bcibs: dgra bgegs dam nyams rdul du rlog: yum ni gnod sbyin mon mo nag: nag mo dar gyi go zu gsol: phyag na spu gri spyang mo bsnams: chibs su lcags kyi phag mo bcibs: dgra bgegs dam nyams rdul du rlog: steng gi phyogs nas bskul ba ni: gza' bdud mi bzad sprul pa'i sku: sku mdog dud kha sku smad sbrul: phyag na mda' gzhu zhags pa bsnams: sku la 'brug gi slog pa gsol: chibs su 'brug chen kha gdang bcibs: dgra bgegs dam nyams rdul du rlog: yum chen thog gi bu yug ma: sku stod gser gyi go zu gsol:

g.yas g.yon phyag na thog ser bsnams: chibs su 'brug mo skad chen bcibs: gza' bdud gnam sman 'khor bcas kyis: dgra bgegs dam nyams rdul du rlogs: 'og gi phyogs nas bskul ba ni: klu bdud nag po mgo dgu pa: sku mdog dud kha 'bar ba la: na bza' sbrul gyi slog pa gsol: phyag na sbrul zhags nad rkyal bsnams: chibs su chu srin 'bar ba bcibs: dgra bgegs dam nyams rdul du rlog: yum ni klu bdud nag mo ste: sku mdog dud kha 'bar ba la: phyag na sbrul zhags nad rkyal bsnams: chibs su rus sbal mgo dgu bcibs: klu bdud 'khor dang bcas pa rnams: dgra bgegs dam nyams rdul du rlog: shar phyogs srid pa lha yi gtso: sku mdog dkar po go zu gsol: phyag na ral gri dar mdung bsnams: chibs su gnam ru g.yag dkar bcibs: dgra bgegs dam nyams rdul du rlog: dgung gi lha chen dkar po ni: za 'og sngo khra'i ber chen gsol: phyag na btsan dar ral gri bsnams: chibs su rta dkar phrum dmar bcibs: dgra bgegs dam nyams rdul du rlog: spyi bdud rgyal po sku mdog dkar: rgya bya dkar po'i khrab slog gsol: phyag na shel mdung ral gri bsnams: chibs su rdo rta sngon po bcibs: dgra bgegs dam nyams rdul du rlog: lho phyogs srid pa'i rgyal mo ni: dkar mo dar dkar go zu gsol: phyag na 'khor lo me long bsnams: chibs su nam mkha'i 'brug la bcibs: dgra bgegs dam nyams rdul du rlog: mthing nag e ka tsa ti ni: sku la dar nag go zu gsol: phyag na tsit+ta spyang mo bsnams: chibs su drel rta rkang gsum bcibs: dgra bgegs dam nyams rdul du rlog: mkha' 'gro nag mo mgyogs byed ma: sku la dar nag go zu gsol: phyag na rgyu zhags mtshon gru bsnams: chibs su bar snang rlung la bcibs: dgra bgegs dam nyams rdul du rlog: nub phyogs srid pa'i rgyal mo ni: ban chen bdud 'dul ber nag gsol: phyag na khrag thun yungs thun bsnams:

chibs su drel nag mgo dgu bcibs: dgra bgegs dam nyams rdul du rlog: brag btsan srog zan dmar po ni: sku la dar gyi ral ga gsol: phyag na mda' gzhu btsan dar bsnams: chibs su btsan rta dmar po bcibs: dgra bgegs dam nyams rdul du rlog: btsan 'gong dmar po zangs slog gsol: phyag na shang lang zangs zhags bsnams: chibs su gza' rta dmar po bcibs: dgra bgegs dam nyams rdul du rlog: byang phyogs srid pa'i rgyal po ni: bgegs rgyal bi nā ya ka ste: nag po dar nag go zu gsol: phyag na kha ṭ+wāṃ thod khrag bsnams: chibs su bdud rta nag po bcibs: dgra bgegs dam nyams rdul du rlog: mu stegs kā lā nag po ni: sku la dar nag ber chen gsol: phyag na rtse gsum thod khrag bsnams: chibs su seng ge dkar mo bcibs: dgra bgegs dam nyams rdul du rlog: byang gi nag po bkrag med ni: phyag na shang lang mda' gzhu bsnams: chibs su chu rta mchong rgod chibs: dam nyams dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: lha chen tshangs pa dkar po ni: sku la bya rgod thul pa gsol: phyag na spu gri nyi zhags bsnams: chibs su seng ge dkar mo bcibs: dgra bgegs dam nyams rdul du rlog: rgyal po'i sde dpon pe har ni: sku la dom gyi slog pa gsol: phyag na bdud zhags spu gri bsnams: chibs su ba glang sna ring bcibs: dam nyams dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: sku lha gsang ba chen po ni: dkar po sprin dkar slog pa gsol: phyag na rdo rje ru mtshon bsnams: chibs su ra dkar gnam ru bcibs: dgra bgegs dam nyams rdul du rlog: mgon po ma hā kā lā ni: mthing nag dar nag ber chen gsol: phyag na beng chen gri gug bsnams: chibs su bdud rta rting dkar bcibs: dgra bgegs dam nyams rdul du rlog: rgyal blon phyag brnyan bsam mi khyab: dregs pa'i sde dpon 'khor bcas kyis: dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: yid la gnag pa'i dgra bgegs myur du sgrol:

ma ma sarba ma tsa bh+yo: che ge mo sha trūṃ hur thuṃ dzaḥmā ra ya rbad: bzhi pa nya bo dgug pa ni: hūm̐ */ sangs rgyas bstan la rab zhugs shing : byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas: dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob pa'i: rig 'dzin rnal 'byor rnams la ni: gnod cing gdug pa'i dgra dang bgegs: bdud dang bar du gcod pa dang : dngos grub 'phrog cing 'tshe ba rnams: khro bo chen po'i byin rlabs dang : gsang sngags drag po'i mthu stobs kyis: yud tsam zhig gis 'dir khug la: mngon spyod tshul bzhin bsgral ba dang : lus ngag rdul du bshig nas kyang : sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar gyis: nga yi dbang du gyur nas kyang : bsgo ba'i bka' bzhin nyan par gyis: bcom ldan rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha: 'di na gnag pa'i las yod kyi: bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs: skyod cig yum gyi mkha' nas skyod: dam tshig can gyi thugs dam bskul: lcags kyu can gyis snying nas zung : zhags pa can gyis mgul nas chings: lcags sgrog can gyis yan lag sdoms: dril bu can gyis rdul du rlogs: mthu dang rdzu 'phrul 'phrog nas kyang : mgon skyabs grogs dang bral bar mdzod: bla srog rnam shes gzugs la phob: zung zhig rgyob cig rnam par chings: rings par khug la smyor chug cig: lus ngag rdul du brlags nas kyang : gzugs phung rngams pa'i zhal du stobs: pho nya kun gyis phrin las mdzod: ces brjod do: lnga ba bden stobs brjod pa ni: na mo/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ rigs sngags dang*/ gzungs sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ khyad par du bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams/ 'jig rten mchod bstod kyi lha tshogs khro bo dang khro mo yab yum sprul pa bka' sdod pho nya chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi thugs rje dang phrin las thogs pa med pa'i bka' bden pa dang*/

bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che bshig pa/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smod pa/ bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba/ dam nyams pa'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad skad cig yud tsam zhig la gzugs liṅga ru bris shing*| ming byang bu ru btab pa 'di la khug cig: badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐: badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ: badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭe hoḥ ā we sha ya a: zhes dang : oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ sogs dang : de bzhin du: a pā na ya a pā na ya: ha sa na ya ha sa na ya: ā we sha ya ā we sha ya: shri trin ha na ya shri trin ha na ya: dz+wa la pa ya dz+wa la pa ya: ta thā ya ta thā ya: bhan+dha ya bhan+dha ya: zhes brjod do: drug pa phur skor bya ba ni: hūm̐ */ chos dbyings rang byung grub pa'i lha: dregs pa rol pa'i dur khrod nas: shin tu mi bzad skur ston pa: dpal chen drag po'i phrin las mdzod: dpal chen dregs pa kun 'dul sku: yab yum sras 'khor pho nyar bcas: g.yas g.yon thabs shes phur bu sgril: sras mchog rigs kyi phur bu 'di: thogs med rang byung lhun gyis grub: sgril ba tsam gyis lha yang 'dar: rdeg pa tsam gyis srid gsum g.yo: btab na khams gsum thal bar rlog: btab bo theb par mdzod cig kī la ya: dgra bgegs 'byung po sgrol cig mā ra ya: hūm̐ */ yon tan rgyud las byung ba yi: dregs pa kun 'dul sprul pa ste: 'debs byed las kyi phur bu 'bum: srid gsum byad ma'i snying la thob: kī la ya yi sgra sgrog pa: srid pa'i phur bu bdag gis bskul: bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: ces phur bu btab: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ hūm̐ e dzaḥbh+yo: dgra bgegs sha trūṃ hur thuṃ dzaḥ mā ra ya rbad: ging ka ra ging ka ra: sarba tri dzaḥbh+yo: dgra bgegs sha trūṃ hur thuṃ dzaḥ mā ra ya rbad: bdud tra mā ra ya rbad sarba du dzaḥbh+yo: dgra bgegs sha trūṃ hur thuṃ dzaḥ

mā ra ya rbad: a bhi shu sarba tsa dzaḥbh+yo: dgra bgegs sha trūṃ hur thuṃ dzaḥ mā ra ya rbad: pa sha mi ki sa dzaḥ dgra bgegs sha trūṃ hur thuṃ dzaḥ mā ra ya rbad: nā ga sarba phu dzaḥbh+yo: dgra bgegs sha trūṃ hur thuṃ dzaḥ mā ra ya rbad: yak+sha sarba k+ṣa dzaḥbh+yo: dgra bgegs sha trūṃ hur thuṃ dzaḥ mā ra ya rbad: ma ma sarba ma dzaḥbh+yo: dgra bgegs sha trūṃ hur thuṃ dzaḥ mā ra ya rbad: ces brjod do: bdun pa dmar sbreng ba ni: hūm̐ */ nyon mongs 'khor ba dbyings su bsgral ba'i phyir: 'khor ba'i rtsa ba nyon mongs gzung 'dzin khrag: dug gsum ru tra bsgral ba'i rak+ta'i rgyun: dung chen snod du dmar chen ar+ghaṃ sbyar: dpal chen khrag 'thung 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: khams gsum yongs sgrol dpa' bo chen po yis: dug lnga chags pa khrag gi mtsho la rol: gzung 'dzin chags pas mnar ba'i dgra bo 'di: chags med bde chen sa la 'god par shog: ma hā mū la rak+ta la khā hi: zhes dbul lo: brgyad pa bstab pa bya ba ni: hūm̐ */ bstab bo bstab bo zhal du bstab: 'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs zhal phyes shig: nam mkha' gang ba'i zhal phye la: ri rab tsam gyi mche ba gtsigs: bar snang gang ba'i ljags sgril cig: chos dbyings stong nyid lto ba ru: mchod rdzas dgra bgegs zhal du bstab: zhal du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi: mgul du bsgril lo ā ra li: dbyings su bstim mo sa ma ya: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ sha trūṃ ma hā maṃ sa la khā hi: ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: ma hā tsit+ta la khā hi: ma hā keṃ ni ri ti la khā hi: ma hā ba su ta la khā hi: ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi: ma hā tsak+ṣuḥl khā hi: ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā hi: zhes dbul lo: dgu pa bzlog pa'i phrin las gzhung bsrang ba ni: hūm̐ */ bcom ldan lha mchog dregs pa kun 'dul yab: dam nyams dgra bgegs phung po da rol cig: dregs pa pho mo'i bka' bsgyur dgra la zlog:

yum chen khro mo khams gsum spyi 'dul ma: dam nyams dgra yi skye mched da rol la: dregs pa pho mo'i bka' bsgyur dgra la zlog: dbang phyug ma hā de wa btsun mor bcas: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la: lha srin sde brgyad bka' bsgyur dgra la zlog: gshin rje'i sde dpon ya ma rā dza ste: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la: gshin rje yongs kyi bka' bsgyur dgra la zlog: ma mo'i sde dpon srid pa'i rgyal mo ste: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la: ma mo yongs kyi bka' bsgyur dgra la zlog: bdud kyi sde dpon rkos rje drang dkar ni: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la: bdud po yongs kyi bka' bsgyur dgra la zlog: bdud mo'i sde dpon nag mo re ma ti: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la: bdud mo yongs kyi bka' bsgyur dgra la zlog: rgyal po'i sde dpon dgra lha pe har te: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la: rgyal po yongs kyi bka' bsgyur dgra la zlog: ging gi sde dpon srog bdag tshangs pa ste: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la: ging chen yongs kyi bka' bsgyur dgra la zlog: dgra lha'i sde dpon ku la gsang ba ste: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la: dgra lha yongs kyi bka' bsgyur dgra la zlog: gza' yi sde dpon gza' bdud rā hu la: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la: gza' bdud yongs kyi bka' bsgyur dgra la zlog: srin po'i sde dpon nag po glog phreng can: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la: srin po yongs kyi bka' bsgyur dgra la zlog: srin mo'i sde dpon sbal mgo khrag mig mas: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la: srin mo yongs kyi bka' bsgyur dgra la zlog: gnod sbyin sde dpon yak+sha me dbal ni: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la: gnod sbyin yongs kyi bka' bsgyur dgra la zlog:

gnod sbyin sde dpon mon mo nag mo ni: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la: gnod sbyin mo yi bka' bsgyur dgra la zlog: mgon po'i sde dpon ma hā kā lā ste: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la: mgon po yongs kyi bka' bsgyur dgra la zlog: ru tra'i sde dpon rdo rje bdud 'dul ni: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la: ru tra yongs kyi bka' bsgyur dgra la zlog: dmu bdud sde dpon nag po bkrag med de: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la: dmu bdud yongs kyi bka' bsgyur dgra la zlog: mu stegs sde dpon gu lang nag po ste: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la: mu stegs yongs kyi bka' bsgyur dgra la zlog: lha yi sde dpon lha rab sham po ste: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la: lha rnams yongs kyi bka' bsgyur dgra la zlog: gnam sman sde dpon thog gi bu yug ma: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la: gnam sman yongs kyi bka' bsgyur dgra la zlog: ma sangs sde dpon spyi bdud gu rum tse: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la: ma sangs yongs kyi bka' bsgyur dgra la zlog: 'gong po'i sde dpon yam shud dmar po ste: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la: 'gong po yongs kyi bka' bsgyur dgra la zlog: bgegs kyi sde dpon bi nā ya ka ste: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la: bgegs rnams yongs kyi bka' bsgyur dgra la zlog: mkha' 'gro'i sde dpon nag mo mgyogs byed ma: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la: mkha' 'gro yongs kyi bka' bsgyur dgra la zlog: klu yi sde dpon klu bdud mgo dgu pa: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la: klu bdud yongs kyi bka' bsgyur dgra la zlog: klu mo'i sde dpon yak+sha nag po ste: dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag 'di rol la: klu mo yongs kyi bka' bsgyur dgra la zlog:

gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: 'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs 'dir gshegs shig: mi sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dam nyams 'byung po 'di la da rol cig: ma hā maṃ sa la khā hi: ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: ma hā tsit+ta la khā hi: ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi: ma hā keṃ ni ri ti la khā hi: ma hā ba su ta la khā hi: ma hā tsak+ṣuḥl khā hi: ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā hi: bcu pa bzlog cing bh+yos gdab pa ni: hūm̐ */ zlog byed dregs pa kun 'dul sku: bh+yo zlog drag po'i dus la bab: sangs rgyas bstan zhugs rnal 'byor la: phyogs bcu kun nas gdug pa yi: bsam sbyor ngan pa'i rigs sngags dang : sde brgyad dregs pa'i ngan sngags dang : snang srid lha 'dre'i rbod gtong dang : drang srong bka' yi dmod pa dang : ban bon 'dus pa'i sngags zor dang : gshin rje'i 'khor lo ma mo'i thun: klu yi gtad mnan pho nya'i zor: mthu brub byad dang mi kha ngan: lo zla zhag dang za ma'i skag: dus min 'chi ba la sogs rnams: byad ma dgra bgegs rnams la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo gnod pa'i bgegs la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo bar chad bdud la bh+yo: zhes dang : oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: e tri ma phu: oṃ traka rak+sha nṛ rbad bh+yo: nā ga dun tsi nṛ rbad bh+yo: ma nu rak+sha nṛ rbad bh+yo: shan+tiṃ pa nṛ rbad bh+yo: ma ni rak+sha nṛ rbad bh+yo: yak+sha kha thun nṛ rbad bh+yo: kha thun tshal pa nṛ rbad bh+yo: hriṃ hriṃ nṛ rbad bh+yo: kha thun rak+sha bh+yo zlog: a du ru yak+sha snying la bh+yo zlog: kha la kha du srog la ya: kha raka yak+sha rbad su la ya: ma ma rak+sha khrag la ya: ha ri khā hi las la ya: shu'o rak+sha dbugs la ya: gh+raṃ bh+yo taṃ bh+yo las la ya: tri kha thun kha la kha tse yak+sha rbad: ma nṛ dzaḥkha thun rbad: dzaḥnṛ rak+sha snying la rbad: bhi ri tsa ni rū pa rbad: snying khrag dza la srog la rbad: a ka yak+sha srog la rbad:

mā ra aṃ ku sha ya snying la rbad: ma tri dgra bo'i srog la rbad: dgra la thun bh+yo: dgra la byad bh+yo: dgra la zor kha bh+yo: dgra la phur kha bh+yo: dgra la pha bh+yo: dgra la ma bh+yo: dgra la ming po bh+yo: dgra la sring mo bh+yo: dgra la sngags bh+yo: dgra la bdud bh+yo: dgra la btsan bh+yo: dgra la ma mo bh+yo: dgra la rā dza bh+yo: dgra la the'u rang bh+yo: dgra la 'gong po bh+yo: dgra la dri za bh+yo: dgra la yak+sha bh+yo: dgra la grī ba bh+yo: dgra la nā ga bh+yo: dgra la ya ma bh+yo: dgra la ru tra bh+yo: dgra la bigh+nāṃ bh+yo: dgra la rmu bh+yo: dgra la ma hā kā lā sarba bh+yo zlog: dgra la sarba bh+yo zlog: dgra bo che ge mos btang ba'i phur kha bh+yo zlog: zor kha zlog: byol kha zlog: dmod kha zlog: rbod gtong zlog: rbad kha zlog: mnan kha zlog: gtad kha zlog: khram kha zlog: rbad 'dre zlog: rbod gtong zlog: bsam ngan thams cad dgra la bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: oṃ traka rak+sha kha 'dar nṛ rbad bh+yo: nā ga shu tse nṛ rbad bh+yo: shan+tiṃ pa nṛ rbad bh+yo: yak+sha kha thun nṛ rbad bh+yo: kha thun tshal pa nṛ rbad bh+yo: hri tri dz+wa la nṛ rbad bh+yo: srid pa pho rgyud dregs pa'i chad pa dgra la bh+yo bh+yo: dza kha thun kha la yak+sha ya: du ra yak+sha snying la ya: khal tse nā ga srog la yā: kha sa ga sha rbad su ya: ma ma rak+sha khrag la ya: ha ri khā hi las la ya: rak+sha ya: shu'o rak+sha dbugs la ya: gh+raṃ bh+yo taṃ bh+yo las la ya: mo rgyud mkha' 'gro'i chad pa dgra la bh+yo: tri kha thun khal tse yak+sha rbad: ma ni dza la kha la rbad: ma nṛ rak+sha snying la rbad: bhi ri tsa ni gzugs la rbad: snying khrag dza la srog la rbad: a ka yak+sha srog la rbad: mā ra ya aṃ ku sha snying la rbad: ma nṛ rak+sha srog la rbad: klu gnyan dregs pa'i chad pa dgra la bh+yo bh+yo: lha ma srin sde brgyad kyi chad pa thams cad dgra la bh+yo bh+yo: byad ma dgra bo'i steng du bh+yo: byad ma dgra bo'i steng du zlog:

byad ma dgra bo'i steng du nan: byad ma dgra bo'i kha tham: byad ma dgra bo'i kā ya nan: byad ma dgra bo'i wāka nan: byad ma dgra bo'i tsit+ta nan: zhes bzlog cing bh+yos gdab bo: bcu gcig pa zor bskul ba ni: hūm̐ */ bcom ldan dpal dgu 'bar ba yi: mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: hūm̐ */ shar phyogs pho nya rab 'bar ba: mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: hūm̐ */ lho phyogs pho nya rab 'bar ba: mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: hūm̐ */ nub phyogs pho nya rab 'bar ba: mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: hūm̐ */ byang phyogs pho nya rab 'bar ba: mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha pad+ma kro dhī shwa rī a hrīḥ badz+ra kī li kī la ya ma hā yak+sha kā la rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ trika nan: e hur thuṃ dza mā ra ya rbad: sarba ru tra hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥ sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ bh+yo:

sha trūṃ hur thuṃ dzaḥ mā ra ya rbad: dgra bgegs dam sri nṛ tri rbad thuṃ: dha ra ya dha ra ya: mā ra ya mā ra ya: nā ga du tshin+dha tshin+dha: mi li mi li: bhan+dha bhan+dha nā ga ni swā hā: hūm̐ ha he phaṭa bh+yo: hṛ da ya mo ha ya: pra ha ra ṇa ya hūm̐ phaṭa: sa ma ya a ti kra ma ni: sa ra ṇa bh+yo: a la la bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: ces brjod do: bcu gnyis pa bcol dam bya ba ni: hūm̐ */ 'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs la: dam nyams dgra bgegs 'byung po 'di: gsod cing bsgral bar bya ba'i phyir: mgo lus rgyan dang bcas pa 'bul: bcol lo gtad do gnyer du longs: lus ngag yid gsum rdul du rlogs: sha khrag gzugs kyi phung po shigs: rnam shes bde chen gnas su drongs: bzhes shig lhag ma med par mdzod: bcol lo gtad do gnyer du longs: zhes brjod do: bcu gsum pa smon lam gdab ba ni: hoḥ dregs pa rol pa'i dur khrod chen po na: yab lha mchog dregs pa kun 'dul: yum khro mo khams gsum spyi 'dul ma: dbang phyug ma hā de wa: btsun mo u ma de wī: dge bsnyen rdo rje legs pa: chos skyong mgon po nag po: bstan srung lha srin sde brgyad: dkar po ging : nag po bdud: dmar po btsan: drag po gza': nad gtong ma mo: srog gcod srin po: smyo 'bog rgyal po'i tshogs la sogs te: 'jig rten mchod bstod kyi lha tshogs sum cu rtsa gnyis la phrin las gnyan po bcol ba ni: zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod la sogs pa'i phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub pa dang : rdo rje slob dpon mched dang lcam dral: rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor dang bcas pa la bsrung zhing byin gyis brlab tu gsol: tshe ring ba dang : nad med pa dang : dpal 'byor longs spyod thams cad rgyas par mdzad du gsol: chag che nyam nga rbad 'dre rbod gtong mo ngan rmis ltas mtshan ma ngan pa thams cad phyir zlog cig: bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra la rbad cing gnod par byed pa'i bgegs rnams 'dul ba'i phrin las su bcol ba ni:

sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che bshig pa: dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smod pa: rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku dgra: rnal 'byor pa'i sgos dgra: mched dang lcam dral gyi spyi dgra: rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi rkyen dgra: sems can yongs la 'tshe ba: snga dgra lag gis bdar ba: phyi dgra snying la bsams pa: da dgra dngos su 'khu ba: gzugs can gyi dgra: gzugs med kyi bgegs: bar gcod kyi rkyen: bsam pa ngan pa 'chang ba: sbyor ba rtsub mo ston par byed pa'i dgra bgegs byad ma gdug pa can thams cad thal ba'i rdul du rlogs shig: sku gsung thugs kyi dbyings su gtad do: bcol ba'i las gyis shig: sgrub pa'i rtags phyung zhig: 'phrin las thams cad mngon sum du 'grub par mdzod cig: ces brjod do: ༈ /spyi don dgu pa dmod pa drag sngags kyi lha tshogs kyi zlog pa'i phrin las gzhung bsrang ba la bcu gsum ste: dang po gtor ma 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ */ 'jig rten snod du bcud rnams gtor mar bcas: snang srid thams cad mchod pa'i yo byad de: mdzes shing bkra bar bshams nas su: dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs la: gnyis su med pa'i tshogs su 'bul: phung po'i snod du dbang po'i gtor mar bcas: dur khrod gzhal yas mchod pa'i yo byad de: mdzes shing bkra bar bshams nas su: dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs la: gnyis su med pa'i tshogs su 'bul: bhan+dha lcang lor 'bru bcud gtor mar bcas: dri ro reg bya mchod pa'i yo byad de: mdzes shing bkra bar bshams nas su: dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs la: gnyis su med pa'i tshogs su 'bul: mchog chen mchog phran sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga: mchod pa'i yo byad sna tshogs rnams: mdzes shing bkra bar bshams nas su: dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs la: gnyis su med pa'i tshogs su 'bul: zhes dbul lo: gnyis pa spyir bskul ba ni: hūm̐ */ drag sngags rol pa'i dur khrod chen po na: dpal ldan stobs ldan nag po yab yum dang :

drag sngags dregs pa'i sde dpon bco brgyad dang : bshan pa lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas: dmod pa drags sngags lha tshogs thugs dam can: mi mngon dbyings nas sku bzhengs thugs dam bskul: rmad byung rol pa'i sman raka gtor mas mchod: thugs dam rgyud bskul phrin las rnam bzhi mdzod: ces so: gsum pa dam can sgos su bskul ba ni: hūm̐ */ shar phyogs 'chi bdag gshin rje khyod: phyag na gri gug thod khrag bsnams: dam nyams dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: 'chi bdag gshin rje nag mo ni: phyag na gri gug mi mgo bsnams: dam nyams dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: lho phyogs bdud po me yi kha rlangs can: nag po khram shing bdud zhags bsnams: dam nyams dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: bdud mo nag mo khrag 'dzag ma: phyag na khram shing thod rlon thogs: dam nyams dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: nub phyogs srin po gsod byed ni: phyag na ral gri thod khrag thogs: dam nyams dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: srin mo za byed nag mo ni: phyag na gri gug mi mgo bsnams: dam nyams dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: byang phyogs gnod sbyin gang ba bzang : sngon po ral gri dar nag bsnams: dam nyams dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: gnod sbyin sha za ral gcig ma: dam nyams dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: lha chen ma hā de wa ni: dkar po ba dan shel gri thogs: dam nyams dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: ru tra thar pa nag po ni: phyag na mchod gtor thun gtor bsnams: dgra bgegs dam nyams rdul du rlog: dmu rje btsan po chen po ni: nag po dar nag zhags pa bsnams: dam nyams dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: mu stegs kā lā nag po ni: phyag na kha ṭ+wāṃ tri shūl bsnams: dam nyams dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: steng gi khyab 'jug rā hu la: nag po khram shing dgra sta bsnams: dam nyams dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: 'og gi klu rgyal sog ma med: ser po bum pa ru sbal bsnams:

sku la sbrul lpags na bza' gsol: dam nyams dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: rgyal po gnod mdzes dkar po ni: phyag na ral gri dar dkar bsnams: dam nyams dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: 'gong po 'phrul 'gyed ser po ni: sprul pa lag dgu 'gyed pa ste: dam nyams dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: skyes bu chen po dkar po ni: phyag na dar dkar dar nag bsnams: klu btsan dmar po chen po ni: phyag na btsan mdung btsan gri bsnams: dam nyams dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: kun kyang zhing pags na bza' gsol: zhabs kyis dgra bgegs ma lus gzer: bran dang yang 'khor bsam mi khyab: sngags bdag sde dpon 'khor bcas kyis: dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: yid la gnag pa'i dgra bgegs myur du sgrol: gṛ ha gṛ ṇa: sarba pi tsi ta: hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥ che ge mo nṛ hur thuṃ dzaḥmā ra ya rbad: ces bskul lo: bzhi pa nya bo dgug pa ni: hūm̐ */ sangs rgyas bstan la rab zhugs shing : byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas: dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob pa'i: rig 'dzin rnal 'byor rnams la ni: gnod cing gdug pa'i dgra dang bgegs: bdud dang bar du gcod pa dang : dngos grub 'phrog cing 'tshe ba rnams: khro bo chen po'i byin rlabs dang : gsang sngags drag po'i mthu stobs kyis: yud tsam zhig gis 'dir khug la: mngon spyod tshul bzhin bsgral ba dang : lus ngag rdul du bshig nas kyang : sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar gyis: nga yi dbang du gyur nas kyang : bsgo ba'i bka' bzhin nyan par gyis: bcom ldan rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha: 'di na gnag pa'i las yod kyi: bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs: skyod cig yum gyi mkha' nas skyod: dam tshig can gyi thugs dam bskul: lcags kyu can gyis snying nas zung : zhags pa can gyis mgul nas chings: lcags sgrog can gyis yan lag sdoms: dril bu can gyis rdul du rlogs: mthu dang rdzu 'phrul 'phrog nas kyang :

mgon skyabs grogs dang bral bar mdzod: bla srog rnam shes gzugs la phob: zung zhig rgyob cig rnam par chings: rings par khug la smyor chug cig: lus ngag rdul du brlags nas kyang : gzugs phung rngams pa'i zhal du stobs: pho nya kun gyis phrin las mdzod: ces brjod do: lnga pa bden stobs brjod pa ni: na mo/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ rigs sngags dang*/ gzungs sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ khyad par du bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams/ dmod pa drag sngags kyi lha tshogs khro bo dang khro mo yab yum sprul pa bka' sdod pho nya chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi thugs rje dang phrin las thogs pa med pa'i bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che bshig pa/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smod pa/ bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba/ dam nyams pa'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad skad cig yud tsam zhig la gzugs liṅga ru bris shing*/ ming byang bu ru btab pa 'di la khug cig: badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐: badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ: badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭe hoḥ ā we sha ya a: oṃ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ e dzaḥbh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ sogs dang*/ de bzhin du/ a pā na ya a pā na ya: ha sa na ya ha sa na ya: ā we sha ya ā we sha ya: shri trin ha na ya shri trin ha na ya: dz+wa la pa ya dz+wa la pa ya: ta thā ya ta thā ya: bhan+dha ya bhan+dha ya: zhes brjod do: drug pa phur skor bya ba ni: hūm̐ */ chos dbyings rang byung grub pa'i lha: drag sngags rol pa'i dur khrod nas: shin tu mi bzad skur ston pa: dpal chen drag po'i phrin las mdzod: dpal chen stobs ldan nag po'i sku: yab yum sras 'khor pho nyar bcas: g.yas g.yon thabs shes phur bu sgril: sras mchog rigs kyi phur bu 'di:

thogs med rang byung lhun gyis grub: sgril ba tsam gyis lha yang 'dar: rdeg pa tsam gyis srid gsum g.yo: btab na khams gsum thal bar rlog: btab bo theb par mdzod cig kī la ya: dgra bgegs 'byung po sgrol cig mā ra ya: hūm̐ */ yon tan rgyud las byung ba yi: dmod pa drag sngags sprul pa ste: 'debs byed las kyi phur bu 'bum: srid gsum byad ma'i snying la thob: kī la ya yi sgra sgrog pa: srid pa'i phur bu bdag gis bskul: bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: ces phur bu btab: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ e dzaḥhūm̐ bh+yo: badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ e tsit+ta hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥ dgra bgegs nṛ hur thuṃḥmā ra ya rbad: ya ma sarba tsit+ta hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥ dgra bgegs nṛ hur thuṃ dzaḥmā ra ya rbad: nā ga rak+sha sarba tsit+ta hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥ dgra bgegs nṛ hur thuṃ dzaḥmā ra ya rbad: de wa rak+sha sarba tsit+ta hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥ dgra bgegs nṛ hur thuṃ dzaḥ mā ra ya rbad: rā hu la sarba tsit+ta hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥ dgra bgegs nṛ hur thuṃ dzaḥ yak+sha sarba tsit+ta hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥ dgra bgegs nṛ tri hur thuṃ dzaḥ mā ra ya rbad: rak+sha sarba tsit+ta hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥ dgra bgegs nṛ hur thuṃ dzaḥmā ra ya rbad: ces brjod do: bdun pa dmar sbreng ba ni: hūm̐ */ nyon mongs 'khor ba dbyings su bsgral ba'i phyir: 'khor ba'i rtsa ba nyon mongs gzung 'dzin khrag: dug gsum ru tra bsgral ba'i rak+ta'i rgyun: dung chen snod du dmar chen ar+ghaṃ sbyar: dpal chen khrag 'thung 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: khams gsum yongs sgrol dpa' bo chen po yis: dug lnga chags pa khrag gi mtsho la rol: gzung 'dzin chags pas mnar ba'i dgra bo 'di: chags med bde chen sa la 'god par shog: ma hā mū la rak+ta la khā hi: zhes dbul lo: brgyad pa bstab pa bya ba ni: hūm̐ */ bstab bo bstab bo zhal du bstab: dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs zhal phyes shig: nam mkha' gang ba'i zhal phye la:
