ri rab tsam gyi mche ba gtsigs: bar snang gang ba'i ljags sgril cig: chos dbyings stong nyid lto ba ru: mchod rdzas dgra bgegs zhal du bstab: zhal du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi: mgul du bsgril lo ā ra li: dbyings su bstim mo sa ma ya: oṃ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ e dzaḥbh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa: sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ sha trūṃ ma hā maṃ sa la khā hi: ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: ma hā tsit+ta la khā hi: ma hā keṃ ni ri ti la khā hi: ma hā ba su ta la khā hi: ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi: ma hā tsak+ṣuḥl khā hi: ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā hi: zhes dbul lo: dgu pa bzlog pa'i phrin las gzhung bsrang ba ni: hūm̐ */ lha mchog stobs ldan nag po chen po yis: dam nyams dgra bgegs rnam shes da rol la: dregs pa pho mo'i tshogs rnams gzir zhing zlog: yum chen 'byung ba lnga yi bdag mo yi: dam nyams dgra yi 'byung ba'i lus 'di rol: dregs pa mo rnams dbang du bsdus shing zlog: 'chi bdag dregs pa gshin rje nag po khyod: dam nyams dgra yi snying la da rol la: gshin rje rnams kyi dmod pa'i mtshon cha zlog: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i btsun mo srog bdag khyod: dam nyams dgra yi snying la da rol la: gshin rje mo yi dmod pa'i mtshon cha zlog: kā la yak+sha mu stegs sngags kyi bdag: dam nyams dgra yi snying la da rol la: mu stegs rnams kyi dmod pa'i mtshon cha zlog: bdud po me yi kha rlangs sngags kyi bdag: dam nyams dgra yi snying la da rol la: bdud po yongs kyi dmod pa'i mtshon cha zlog: bdud mo'i sngags bdag nag mo khrag 'dzag ma: dam nyams dgra yi snying la da rol la: bdud mo yongs kyi dmod pa'i mtshon cha zlog: ru tra'i mnga' bdag thar pa nag po ste: dam nyams dgra yi snying la da rol la: ru tra rnams kyi dmod pa'i mtshon cha zlog: nag po gsod byed srin po dmod pa'i bdag: dam nyams dgra yi snying la da rol la: srin po rnams kyi dmod pa'i mtshon cha zlog:

srin mo'i mnga' bdag nag mo gsod byed ma: dam nyams dgra yi snying la da rol la: srin mo rnams kyi dmod pa'i mtshon cha zlog: gza' yi sngags bdag gza' bdud rā hu la: dam nyams dgra yi snying la da rol la: gza' bdud yongs kyi dmod pa'i mtshon cha zlog: ma hā de wa lha yi dmod pa'i bdag: dam nyams dgra yi snying la da rol la: lha rnams yongs kyi dmod pa'i mtshon cha zlog: gnod sbyin sngags bdag gang ba bzang po ni: dam nyams dgra yi snying la da rol la: gnod sbyin yongs kyi dmod pa'i mtshon cha zlog: gnod sbyin mo yi sngags bdag ral gcig ma: dam nyams dgra bo'i snying la da rol la: gnod sbyin mo yi dmod pa'i mtshon cha zlog: rgyal po'i sngags bdag le byin har legs te: dam nyams dgra yi snying la da rol la: rgyal po rnams kyi dmod pa'i mtshon cha zlog: btsan gyi sngags bdag yam shud dmar po ste: dam nyams dgra yi snying la da rol la: btsan rgod rnams kyi dmod pa'i mtshon cha zlog: dmu yi sngags bdag dmu rje btsan pa ste: dam nyams dgra yi snying la da rol la: dmu bdud rnams kyi dmod pa'i mtshon cha zlog: 'gong po'i sngags bdag khu le lag dgu ste: dam nyams dgra yi snying la da rol la: 'gong po rnams kyi dmod pa'i mtshon cha zlog: the'u rang sngags bdag rdo rje legs pa ste: dam nyams dgra bo'i snying la da rol la: the'u rang rnams kyi dmod pa'i mtshon cha zlog: gzhon nu gtum po klu yi sngags bdag ste: dam nyams dgra bo'i snying la da rol la: klu rnams yongs kyi dmod pa'i mtshon cha zlog: gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs 'dir gshegs la: mi sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dam nyams 'byung po 'di la da rol cig: ma hā maṃ sa la khā hi: ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: ma hā tsit+ta la khā hi: ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi: ma hā keṃ ni ri ti la khā hi: ma hā ba su ta la khā hi:

ma hā tsak+ṣuḥl khā hi: ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā hi: zhes brjod do: bcu pa bzlog cing bh+yos gdab pa ni: hūm̐ */ zlog byed stobs ldan nag po yi: bh+yo zlog drag po'i dus la bab: sangs rgyas bstan zhugs rnal 'byor la: phyogs bcu kun nas gdug pa yi: bsam sbyor ngan pa'i rigs sngags dang : sde brgyad dregs pa'i ngan sngags dang : snang srid lha 'dre'i rbod gtong dang : drang srong bka' yi dmod pa dang : ban bon 'dus pa'i sngags zor dang : gshin rje'i 'khor lo ma mo'i thun: klu yi gtad mnan pho nya'i zor: mthu brub byad dang mi kha ngan: lo zla zhag dang za ma'i skag: dus min 'chi ba la sogs rnams: byad ma dgra bgegs rnams la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo gnod pa'i bgegs la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo bar chad bdud la bh+yo: zhes dang : oṃ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ e dzaḥbh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ eḥyaḥ maḥthaḥduḥduḥ.aḥraḥraḥraḥnṛḥk+ṣaḥk+ṣaḥ tsaḥtsaḥpaḥtriḥtriḥtriḥphuḥ rbod gtong sa ma ya bh+yo zlog: sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ mā ra ya: dgra bo'i snying la dun ting bh+yo zlog: ki li kī la ya bh+yo zlog: rak+sha tsit+ta ya bh+yo zlog: hur bu hur bu bh+yo zlog: snying khrag tsa la ya bh+yo zlog: tsit+ta baṃ ril bh+yo zlog: khrag tshal pa bh+yo zlog: tsit+ta yo ga bh+yo zlog: sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ ya myag ya ye rngub mug shi ka dun ka dun nṛ hur thuṃ dzaḥ dgra bo'i srog la mā ra ya: rbod zor sarba bh+yo zlog: dgra bo che ge mos btang ba'i phur kha zlog: zor kha zlog: byol kha zlog: dmod mo zlog: rbod gtong zlog: rbad kha zlog: mnan kha zlog: gtad kha zlog: khram kha zlog: rbad 'dre rbod gtong bsam ngan thams cad bh+yo zlog: oṃ traka rak+sha kha 'dar nṛ rbad bh+yo: nā ga shu tse nṛ rbad bh+yo: shan+tiṃ pa nṛ rbad bh+yo: ma nṛ rak+sha nṛ rbad bh+yo: yak+sha kha thun nṛ rbad bh+yo: kha thun tshal pa nri rbad bh+yo:

hri tri dz+wa la nṛ rbad bh+yo: srid pa pho rgyud dregs pa'i chad pa dgra la bh+yo bh+yo: dza kha thun kha la yak+sha ya: du ra yak+sha snying la ya: khal tse nā ga srog la ya: kha sa ga sha rbad su ya: ma ma rak+sha khrag la ya: ha ri khā hi las la ya: rak+sha ya: shu'o rak+sha dbugs la ya: gh+raṃ bh+yo taṃ bh+yo las la ya: mo rgyud mkha' 'gro'i chad pa dgra la bh+yo bh+yo: tri kha thun khal tse yak+sha rbad: ma ni dza la kha la rbad: ma nṛ rak+sha snying la rbad: bhi ri tsa ni gzugs la rbad: snying khrag dza la srog la rbad: a ka yak+sha srog la rbad: mā ra aṃ ku sha ya snying la rbad: ma nṛ rak+sha srog la rbad: klu gnyan dregs pa'i chad pa dgra la bh+yo bh+yo: dgra la thun bh+yo: dgra la byad bh+yo: dgra la zor kha bh+yo: dgra la pha bh+yo: dgra la ma bh+yo: dgra la ming po bh+yo: dgra la sring mo bh+yo: dgra la sngags bh+yo: dgra la bdud bh+yo: dgra la btsan bh+yo: dgra la rgyal po bh+yo: dgra la ma mo bh+yo: dgra la dri za bh+yo: dgra la gnod sbyin bh+yo: dgra la nā ga bh+yo: dgra la gshin rje bh+yo: dgra la mu stegs bh+yo: dgra la rmu bh+yo: dgra la rā hu la bh+yo: byad ma dgra bo'i steng du bh+yo: byad ma dgra bo'i steng du zlog: byad ma dgra bo'i steng du nan: byad ma dgra bo'i kha tham: byad ma dgra bo'i kā ya nan: byad ma dgra bo'i wāka nan: byad ma dgra bo'i tsit+ta nan: zhes bzlog cing bh+yos gdab bo: bcu gcig pa zor bskul ba ni: hūm̐ */ bcom ldan dpal dgu 'bar ba yi: mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la bsgyur: hūm̐ */ shar phyogs pho nya rab 'bar ba: mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen:

bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: hūm̐ */ lho phyogs pho nya rab 'bar ba: mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: hūm̐ */ nub phyogs pho nya rab 'bar ba: mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: hūm̐ */ byang phyogs pho nya rab 'bar ba: mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha pad+ma kro dhī shwa rī a hrīḥ badz+ra kī li kī la ya ma hā yak+sha kā la rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ trika nan: e hur thuṃ dzaḥmā ra ya rbad: sarba ru tra hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥ sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ bh+yo: sha trūṃ hur thuṃ dzaḥ mā ra ya rbad: dgra bgegs dam sri nṛ tri rbad thuṃ: dha ra ya dha ra ya: mā ra ya mā ra ya: nā ga du tshin+dha tshin+dha: mi li mi li: bhan+dha bhan+dha nā ga ni swā hā: hūm̐ ha he phaṭa bh+yo: hṛ da ya mo ha ya: pra ha ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa: sa ma ya a ti kra ma ni: sa ra ṇa bh+yo: a la la bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: ces brjod do: bcu gnyis pa bcol dam bya ba ni: hūm̐ */ dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs la: dam nyams dgra bgegs 'byung po 'di: gsod cing bsgral bar bya ba'i phyir: mgo lus rgyan dang bcas pa 'bul: bcol lo gtad do gnyer du longs: lus ngag yid gsum rdul du rlogs: sha khrag gzugs kyi phung po shigs: rnam shes bde chen gnas su drongs:

bzhes shig lhag ma med par mdzod: bcol lo gtad do gnyer du longs: zhes brjod do: bcu gsum pa smon lam gdab ba ni: hoḥ dregs pa rol pa'i dur khrod chen po na: yab lha mchog stobs ldan nag po: yum 'byung ba lnga yi bdag mo: 'chi bdag gshin rje nag po: skye 'gro srog gi bdag mo: bdud po me'i kha rlangs: bdud mo nag mo khrag 'dzag: srin po gsod byed nag po: srin mo nag mo gsod byed ma: gnod sbyin gang ba bzang po: yum sha za ral gcig ma: lha chen ma hā de wa: ru tra thar pa nag po: dmu rje btsan po chen po: mu stegs kā la yak+sha: gza' rgod khyab 'jug nag po: klu rgyal gzhon nu gtum po: rgyal po le byin har legs: 'gong po khu le lag dgu: skyes bu rdo rje legs pa: btsan rgod yam shud dmar po: bshan pa lha srin sde brgyad: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i bshan pa: ḍā ki ma mo'i bshan pa: che grags lha yi bshan pa: drag rtsal gnod sbyin gyi bshan pa: khro gtum srin po'i bshan pa: dbang chen gza' yi bshan pa: gtad khram klu yi bshan pa: gzhan yang phyi yi lha ma srin sde brgyad: nang gi lha ma srin sde brgyad: gsang ba'i lha ma srin sde brgyad: sbas pa'i lha ma srin sde brgyad: yang gsang gter gyi lha ma srin sde brgyad: las byed myur mgyogs kyi lha ma srin sde brgyad: drag po sngags kyi lha ma srin sde brgyad: btags chags kyi lha ma srin sde brgyad la sogs pa'i dmod pa drag sngags kyi lha tshogs nyi shu tham pa la phrin las gnyan po bcol ba ni: zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod la sogs pa'i phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub pa dang : rdo rje slob dpon mched dang lcam dral: rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor dang bcas pa la bsrung zhing byin gyis brlab tu gsol: tshe ring ba dang : nad med pa dang : dpal 'byor longs spyod thams cad rgyas par mdzad du gsol: chag che nyam nga rbad 'dre rbod gtong mo ngan rmis ltas mtshan ma ngan pa thams cad phyir zlog cig:

bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra la rbad cing gnod par byed pa'i bgegs rnams 'dul ba'i phrin las su bcol ba ni: sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa: dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smod pa: rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku dgra: rnal 'byor pa'i dgos dgra: mched dang lcam dral gyi spyi dgra: rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi rkyen dgra: sems can yongs la 'tshe ba: snga dgra lag gis bdar ba: phyi dgra snying la bsams pa: da dgra dngos su 'khu ba: gzugs can gyi dgra: gzugs med kyi bgegs: bar gcod kyi rkyen: bsam pa ngan pa 'chang ba: sbyor ba rtsub mo ston par byed pa'i dgra bgegs byad ma gdug pa can thams cad thal ba'i rdul du rlogs shig: sku gsung thugs kyi dbyings su gtad do: bcol ba'i las gyis shig: sgrub pa'i rtags phyung zhig: 'phrin las thams cad mngon sum du 'grub par mdzod cig: ces brjod do: ༈ /spyi don bcu pa dpal gyi bka' srung gi lha tshogs kyi bzlog pa'i phrin las gzhung bsrang ba la bcu gsum ste: dang po gtor ma 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ */ 'jig rten snod du bcud rnams gtor mar bcas: snang srid thams cad mchod pa'i yo byad de: mdzes shing bkra bar bshams nas su: bka' srung dam can lha tshogs la: gnyis su med pa'i tshogs su 'bul: phung po'i snod du dbang po'i gtor mar bcas: dur khrod gzhal yas mchod pa'i yo byad de: mdzes shing bkra bar bshams nas su: bka' srung dam can lha tshogs la: gnyis su med pa'i tshogs su 'bul: bhan+dha lcang lor 'bru bcud gtor mar bcas: dri ro reg bya mchod pa'i yo byad de: mdzes shing bkra bar bshams nas su: bka' srung dam can lha tshogs la: gnyis su med pa'i tshogs su 'bul: mchog chen mchog phran sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga: mchod pa'i yo byad sna tshogs rnams: mdzes shing bkra bar bshams nas su: bka' srung dam can lha tshogs la: gnyis su med pa'i tshogs su 'bul: zhes dbul lo:

gnyis pa spyir bskul ba ni: hūm̐ */ phyi yi dkyil 'khor bar khyams so so na: dpal gyi bka' sdod ci bgyid bka' nyan tshogs: dbang phyug mkha' 'gro ging dang laṅka dang : 'bar ba pho nya ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dpal gyi bka' srung pho nya thugs dam can: mi mngon dbyings nas sku bzhengs thugs dam bskul: rmad byung rol pa'i sman raka gtor mas mchod: thugs dam rgyud bskul phrin las rnam bzhi mdzod: ces so: gsum pa dam can sgos su bskul ba ni: rgyas par byed na: bh+yoḥ srin mo smug nag thod rlon 'chang : tshangs pa ser mo pad+ma 'dzin: lha chen dkar ljang tri shūl 'dzin: rtog 'dod sngon mo 'khor lo 'dzin: gzhon nu dmar mo mdung thung 'dzin: brgya byin dkar mo in+d+ra gdengs: rdo rje ser mo bdud rtsi 'thung : bdud rtsi dmar mo bum pa 'dzin: zla ba dkar mo puṇ+ḍa 'dzin: be con ljang nag dbyug to 'phyar: srin mo sngo nag thod khrag 'thung : za ba ser nag ba su 'dren: dga' ba dkar mo ka ltar 'chang : stobs chen dkar mo thong gshol 'dzin: rdo rje ser mo spu gri 'dzin: 'dod pa dmar mo mda' gzhu 'gengs: nor srung dkar mo bum pa 'dzin: rlung lha sngon mo ba dan 'dzin: gsod byed dmar mo ral gri 'dzin: mi mo dmar mo gsal shing 'dzin: phag mo nag mo mche zhags thogs: rgan byed dmar mo zhing za ma: sna chen ljang nag thod khrag 'thung : chu lha sngon mo sbrul zhags 'dzin: rdo rje nag mo lcags kyu thogs: rdo rje ser mo zhags pa 'dzin: rdo rje dmar mo lcags sgrog 'dzin: rdo rje ljang nag dril 'khrol byed: mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa gnyis ni: dkar mo rdo rje mkha' 'gro brgyad: lag na rdo rje lcags kyu thogs: ser mo rin chen mkha' 'gro brgyad: lag na rdo rje zhags pa thogs: dmar mo pad+ma mkha' 'gro brgyad: lag na rdo rje lcags sgrog thogs: sngon mo las kyi mkha' 'gro brgyad: lag na rdo rje dril bu thogs:

rdo rje ging chen bco brgyad ni: rdo rje rigs kyi ging chen bzhi: dkar po lag na shel gri thogs: rin chen rigs kyi ging chen bzhi: ser po lag na gser gri thogs: pad+ma rigs kyi ging chen bzhi: dmar po lag na zangs gri thogs: las kyi rigs kyi ging chen bzhi: sngon po lag na lcags gri thogs: sna tshogs rigs kyi ging chen gnyis: sna tshogs mdog can ral gri thogs: laṅka drug cu'i thugs dam bskul: sna tshogs rigs kyi laṅka ste: g.yas pa rang rigs phyag mtshan la: g.yon pa tri shūl rtse gsum 'dzin: 'bar ma brgyad kyi thugs dam bskul: 'bar ma nyi ma'i zhags pa thogs: 'bar ma me khyer glog phreng can: 'bar ma gshin rje skar mda' gtong : 'bar ma srin mo mdung thung 'phen: 'bar ma klu mo lce 'bebs ma: 'bar ma 'jigs byed khyung thogs ma: 'bar ma rlung bdag ral gri'i skra: 'bar ma 'jigs byed ba glang sna: sa bdag chen mo sum cu gnyis: sa bdag bdud 'dul chen mo brgyad: dkar gsal lcags kyu phur bu thogs: sa bdag gza' bdud chen mo brgyad: ser mo zhags pa phur bu thogs: sa bdag klu 'dul chen mo brgyad: dmar mo lcags sgrog phur bu thogs: sa bdag btsan 'dul chen mo brgyad: sngon mo dril bu phur bu thogs: pho nya drug cu rtsa bzhi sprul: rdo rje rigs dang pad+ma'i rigs: rin chen rigs dang las kyi rigs: phyogs bzhi'i pho nya drug cu ste: dkar ser dmar ljang rigs kyi mdog: las bzhi rigs kyi phur bu sgril: ma mo bdun dang sring mo bzhi: rdo rje rigs kyi ma dang sring : lag na rdo rje thod khrag thogs: rin chen rigs kyi ma dang sring : lag na rin chen thod khrag thogs: pad+ma rigs kyi ma dang sring : lag na pad+ma thod khrag thogs: las kyi rigs kyi ma dang sring : lag na ral gri thod khrag thogs: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro bskul: tshangs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag gcig: de bzhin dri za chen mo 'bum:

drang srong mo dang grul bum mo: srin mo klu mo rlung lha mo: gnod sbyin dbang ldan sa bdag mo: sman mo sha za bdud mo dang : dkar mo 'bum dang ser mo dang : dmar mo sngon mo nag mo dang : smug mo chen mo 'bum phrag ste: 'bum phrag bsam gyis mi khyab pa: la la gser gyi ri la gnas: rgya mtsho'i gnas dang ri rab dang : gling chen bzhi dang gling phran brgyad: nam mkha'i mthong dang sa yi 'og: dpag bsam shing dang gangs ri'i rtse: la la nam mkha'i sprin la gnas: kun kyang cha lugs sna tshogs kyis: la la gcan gzan sder chags zhon: de bzhin rmig zlum kha dbrag dang : mche ba can dang gshog pa can: la la rlung dang 'brug la zhon: dgu tshigs gzhung dang skar mda' 'od: la la chu bo'i gzhung la zhon: dus dang dus min kun tu rgyu: dus bzhi'i dus tshigs dus chen brgyad: nam gyi gung dang nyi ma'i gung : la la zla ba'i zer la rgyu: mun pa'i smag dang grib so dang : skya rengs dmar thag dus su rgyu: phyag mtshan rnam pa sna tshogs te: la la gsal ba'i me long thogs: de bzhin dar gyi g.yab mo dang : lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril: la la mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs: be con bdud kyi khram shing dang : nad rkyal bdud kyi sho rdel dang : mtshon gru bya dmar bab po dang : mi snying mi mgo'i thod phor dang : mi lpags rlon pa'i rgyal mtshan dang : la la sna tshogs ru mtshon thogs: tri shūl la dang 'khor lo dang : gdug pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs: kun kyang srog gcod dbugs 'phrog cing : sha za khrag 'thung mgo lus 'phral: kun gyi mdangs dang bcud len ma: rgyal mo blon mo yang g.yog mo: zhing skyong ma mo mkha' 'gro dang : dmag dpon bzhi dang sring mo bzhi: dbang gi gru 'degs chen mo bzhi: sa bdag sum cu so gnyis te: gnod sbyin sha za 'phrog ma dang : 'jig rten skyong ba brtan ma'i tshogs: dpal gyi bka' srung thugs dam bskul: dam rdzas sha khrag gtor ma bzhes:

bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: ces so: bsdus pa ni: hūm̐ */ dbang phyug ging dang laṅka 'bar ma dang : pho nya mgyogs ma ma bdun sring mo bzhi: sa bdag mched bzhi mkha' 'gro brtan ma'i tshogs: dpal gyi bka' nyan dam can mang po'i tshogs: dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: yid la gnag pa'i dgra bgegs myur du sgrol: oṃ badz+ra sarba yak+sha sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa: ces rbad cing bskul lo: bzhi pa nya bo dgug pa ni: hūm̐ */ sangs rgyas bstan la rab zhugs shing : byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas: dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob pa'i: rig 'dzin rnal 'byor rnams la ni: gnod cing gdug pa'i dgra dang bgegs: bdud dang bar du gcod pa dang : dngos grub 'phrog cing 'tshe ba rnams: khro bo chen po'i byin rlabs dang : gsang sngags drag po'i mthu stobs kyis: yud tsam zhig gis 'dir khug la: mngon spyod tshul bzhin bsgral ba dang : lus ngag rdul du bshig nas kyang : sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar gyis: nga yi dbang du gyur nas kyang : bsgo ba'i bka' bzhin nyan par gyis: bcom ldan rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha: 'di na gnag pa'i las yod kyi: bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs: skyod cig yum gyi mkha' nas skyod: dam tshig can gyi thugs dam bskul: lcags kyu can gyis snying nas zung : zhags pa can gyis mgul nas chings: lcags sgrog can gyis yan lag sdoms: dril bu can gyis rdul du rlogs: mthu dang rdzu 'phrul 'phrog nas kyang : mgon skyabs grogs dang bral bar mdzod: bla srog rnam shes gzugs la phob: zung zhig rgyob cig rnam par chings: rings par khug la smyor chug cig: lus ngag rdul du brlags nas kyang : gzugs phung rngams pa'i zhal du stobs: pho nya kun gyis phrin las mdzod: ces brjod do: lnga pa bden stobs brjod pa ni: na mo/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/

dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ rigs sngags dang*/ gzungs sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ khyad par du bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams/ bka' srung dam can gyi lha tshogs khro bo dang khro mo yab yum sprul pa bka' sdod pho nya chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi thugs rje dang phrin las thogs pa med pa'i bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che bshig pa/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smod pa/ bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba| dam nyams pa'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad skad cig yud tsam zhig la gzugs liṅga ru bris shing*/ ming byang bu ru btab pa 'di la khug cig: badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐: badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ: badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭe hoḥ ā we sha ya a: zhes dang*/ oṃ badz+ra sarba yak+sha sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ sogs dang*/ de bzhin du/ a pā na ya a pā na ya: ā we sha ya ā we sha ya: shri trin ha na ya shri trin ha na ya: dz+wa la pa ya dz+wa la pa ya: ta thā ya ta thā ya: bhan+dha ya bhan+dha ya: zhes brjod do: drug pa phur skor bya ba ni: hūm̐ */ chos dbyings rang byung grub pa'i lha: srung ma rol pa'i dur khrod nas: shin tu mi bzad skur ston pa: dpal chen drag po'i phrin las mdzod: bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i lha: yab yum sras 'khor pho nyar bcas: g.yas g.yon thabs shes phur bu sgril: sras mchog rigs kyi phur bu 'di: thogs med rang byung lhun gyis grub: sgril ba tsam gyis lha yang 'dar: rdeg pa tsam gyis srid gsum g.yo: btab na khams gsum thal bar rlog: btab bo theb par mdzod cig kī la ya: dgra bgegs 'byung po sgrol cig mā ra ya: hūm̐ */ bka' srung rgyud las byung ba yi: dpal gyi bka' srung sprul pa ste: 'debs byed las kyi phur bu 'bum: srid gsum byad ma'i snying la thob: kī la ya yi sgra sgrog pa:

srid pa'i phur bu bdag gis bskul: bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: ces phur bu btab: oṃ badz+ra sarba yak+sha sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa: dgra bgegs nṛ hur thuṃ dzaḥmā ra ya rbad: ces brjod do: bdun pa dmar sbreng ba ni: hūm̐ */ nyon mongs 'khor ba dbyings su bsgral ba'i phyir: 'khor ba'i rtsa ba nyon mongs gzung 'dzin khrag: dug gsum ru tra bsgral ba'i rak+ta'i rgyun: dung chen snod du dmar chen ar+ghaṃ sbyar: dpal gyi bka' srung 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: khams gsum yongs sgrol dpa' bo chen po yis: dug lnga chags pa khrag gi mtsho la rol: gzung 'dzin chags pas mnar ba'i dgra bo 'di: chags med bde chen sa la 'god par shog: ma hā mū la rak+ta la khā hi: zhes dbul lo: brgyad pa bstab pa bya ba ni: hūm̐ */ bstab bo bstab bo zhal du bstab: bka' srung dam can lha tshogs zhal phyes shig: nam mkha' gang ba'i zhal phye la: ri rab tsam gyi mche ba gtsigs: bar snang gang ba'i ljags sgril cig: chos dbyings stong nyid lto ba ru: mchod rdzas dgra bgegs zhal du bstab: zhal du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi: mgul du bsgril lo ā ra li: dbyings su bstim mo sa ma ya: oṃ badz+ra sarba yak+sha sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa: sarba du sha trūṃ ma hā maṃ sa la khā hi: ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: ma hā tsit+ta la khā hi: ma hā keṃ ni ri ti la khā hi: ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi: ma hā ba su ta la khā hi: ma hā tsak+ṣuḥl khā hi: ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā hi: zhes dbul lo: dgu pa bzlog pa'i phrin las gzhung bsrang ba ni: hūm̐ */ dkar mo chen mo zhi ba'i las byed bdun: ser mo chen mo rgyas pa'i las byed bdun: dmar mo chen mo dbang gi las byed bdun: ljang mo chen mo drag po'i las byed bdun: dbang phyug chen mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyang : dam nyams dgra yi rnam shes 'di rol la: lha chen nyi shu rtsa brgyad gdug rtsub zlog: rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro rnam pa brgyad:

dam nyams dgra yi sha khrag 'di rol la: shar phyogs dri za'i tshogs kyi bka' bsgyur la: dri za'i chad pa dam nyams dgra la zlog: rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro rnam pa brgyad: dam nyams dgra yi sha khrag 'di rol la: lho phyogs gshin rje'i tshogs kyi bka' bsgyur la: gshin rje'i chad pa sdang ba'i dgra la zlog: pad+ma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro rnam pa brgyad: dam nyams dgra yi sha khrag 'di rol la: nub phyogs klu yi tshogs kyi bka' bsgyur la: klu yi chad pa sdang ba'i dgra la zlog: las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro rnam pa brgyad: dam nyams dgra yi sha khrag 'di rol la: byang phyogs gnod sbyin tshogs kyi bka' bsgyur la: gnod sbyin chad pa sdang ba'i dgra la zlog: 'bar ma gnod sbyin chen mo brgyad rnams kyang : dam nyams dgra yi sha khrag 'di rol la: lha srin sde brgyad tshogs kyi bka' bsgyur la: sde brgyad chad pa sdang ba'i dgra la zlog: ging dang laṅka chung mar bcas pa yang : dam nyams dgra yi sha khrag 'di rol la: dur khrod bdag mo rnams kyi bka' bsgyur la: srin po srin mo'i chad pa dam nyams dgra la zlog: sa bdag bdud 'dul ma mo rnam pa brgyad: dam nyams dgra yi sha khrag 'di rol la: bdud sna ring po'i tshogs kyi bka' bsgyur la: bdud kyi chad pa sdang ba'i dgra la zlog: sa bdag gza' 'dul chen mo rnam pa brgyad: dam nyams dgra yi sha khrag 'di rol la: gza' rgod mig dmar chen po'i bka' bsgyur la: gza' yi chad pa sdang ba'i dgra la zlog: sa bdag btsan 'dul chen mo rnam pa brgyad: dam nyams dgra yi sha khrag 'di rol la: zla ba 'od dkar zhes bya'i bka' bsgyur la: btsan gyi chad pa sdang ba'i dgra la zlog: sa bdag klu 'dul chen mo rnam pa brgyad: dam nyams dgra yi sha khrag 'di rol la: klu rgyal dga' bo zhes bya'i bka' bsgyur la: sa bdag klu'i chad pa sdang ba'i dgra la zlog: rigs bzhi'i pho nya drug cu rtsa bzhi yang : dam nyams dgra yi sha khrag 'di rol la:

rigs lnga pho nya'i tshogs kyi bka' bsgyur la: phyogs bzhi'i pho nya rnams kyi chad pa sdang ba'i dgra la zlog: ma mo bdun dang sring mo bzhi rnams kyang : dam nyams dgra bo'i sha khrag 'di rol la: phyogs bzhi'i dam sri rnams kyi bka' bsgyur la: grong rje dkar po'i chad pa dgra la zlog: pho nya 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma: dam nyams dgra yi sha khrag 'di rol la: snang srid mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi bka' bsgyur la: ma mo mkha' 'gro'i chad pa dgra la zlog: sha khrag rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: dpal gyi bka' sdod lha tshogs 'dir gshegs shig: mi sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dam nyams 'byung po 'di la da rol cig: ma hā maṃ sa la khā hi: ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: ma hā tsit+ta la khā hi: ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi: ma hā keṃ ni ri ti la khā hi: ma hā ba su ta la khā hi: ma hā tsak+ṣuḥl khā hi: ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā hi: zhes brjod do: bcu pa bzlog cing bh+yos gdab pa ni: hūm̐ */ zlog byed dpal gyi bka' srung tshogs: bh+yo zlog drag po'i dus la bab: sangs rgyas bstan zhugs rnal 'byor la: phyogs bcu kun nas gdug pa yi: bsam sbyor ngan pa'i rigs sngags dang : sde brgyad dregs pa'i ngan sngags dang : snang srid lha 'dre'i rbod gtong dang : drang srong bka' yi dmod pa dang : ban bon 'dus pa'i sngags zor dang : gshin rje'i 'khor lo ma mo'i thun: klu yi gtad mnan pho nya'i zor: mthu brub byad dang mi kha ngan: lo zla zhag dang za ma'i skag: dus min 'chi ba la sogs rnams: byad ma dgra bgegs rnams la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo gnod pa'i bgegs la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo bar chad bdud la bh+yo: zhes dang*/ oṃ badz+ra sarba yak+sha sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa: shrī ma hā kro dha bh+yo zlog: oṃ ā yuḥnṛ sha sarba sha bh+yo zlog: badz+ra tsakra warti bh+yo zlog: lo ki yan+t+ra bh+yo zlog: man+t+ra bh+yo zlog:

tan+t+ra tan+t+ra bh+yo zlog: ya ma rā tsa bh+yo zlog: ha na ha na bh+yo zlog: pa sha rā hu la bh+yo zlog: da sha grī ba bh+yo zlog: pa tsa pa tsa bh+yo zlog: bhan+dha bhan+dha bh+yo zlog: ha ya grī ba bh+yo zlog: hu lu hu lu bh+yo zlog: kri kri phreng phreng bh+yo zlog: tiṣ+ṭa tiṣ+ṭa bh+yo zlog: rak+sha grī ba bh+yo zlog: tshin+dha tshin+dha bh+yo zlog: rā tsa sa ma ya bh+yo zlog: bhan+dha bhan+dha bh+yo zlog: shu shu yak+sha bh+yo zlog: bha na bha na bh+yo zlog: ka na ra tsa bh+yo zlog: thun bh+yo thun bh+yo: sa du tri tra du tri mā ra ya bh+yo zlog: badz+ra ka ya gling bh+yo zlog: badz+ra hi baṃ gar+bha ya bh+yo zlog: traka traka ta shig shig ya shin bh+yo zlog: badz+ra he sa ka nan bh+yo zlog: ha de wa ti pi ri ya tsha tsa bh+yo zlog: tri kha la yan te bh+yo zlog: tshar ti thuṃ dza ya bh+yo zlog: rak+mo rak+mo bh+yo zlog: dgra bo'i srog la slar la bh+yo zlog: te hed bh+yo zlog: ya mān+ta ka bh+yo zlog: ma ma ta kan bh+yo zlog: kha yan khum bh+yo zlog: dgra bo'i srog la rgyugs rgyugs: slar nan bh+yo zlog: ma mo ra tsa bh+yo zlog: e ka du na bh+yo zlog: ma hā kā lā bh+yo zlog: nā ga du na bh+yo zlog: ma hā du na bh+yo zlog: sa ga du na bh+yo zlog: sum tri du na bh+yo zlog: rak+ti phor du na bh+yo zlog: ma mo dun tri bh+yo zlog: rak+sha yak+sha bh+yo zlog: yak+sha me ru tse bh+yo zlog: sarba shu ta bh+yo zlog: da sha mu kha bh+yo zlog: ḍā ki nī dha ya bh+yo zlog: ya ma thod bsgyur bh+yo zlog: ya ma thod khrol bh+yo zlog: pha la bhi bh+yo zlog: a ma la bh+yo kha na sa ma ya hrīḥbh+yo zlog: dgra bo'i snying la dum bu dum bu bh+yo zlog: thuṃ thuṃ ma yā ma yā te rbud bh+yo zlog: a ta sha la rā dza baṃ ka na kaṃ pā ma phaṭa bh+yo zlog: ha sha dza la bhi sha ha la ha la hūm̐ bh+yo zlog: rbod zor sarba bh+yo zlog: dgra bo che ge mos btang ba'i phur kha zlog:

zor kha zlog: byol kha zlog: dmod kha zlog: rbod gtong zlog: rbad 'dre zlog: mnan kha zlog: gtad kha zlog: khram kha zlog: rbad 'dre rbod gtong bsam pa ngan pa thams cad bh+yo zlog: ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig zlog: ye 'brog sum brgya drug cu zlog: glo bur bdun brgya nyi shu zlog: bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rigs zlog: yas kyi bdud du g.yos pa zlog: mas kyi sri ru langs pa zlog: dpral ba'i gshed du 'khor ba zlog: ltag pa'i bdud du bab pa zlog: chos pas byas pa'i chos zor zlog: sngags pas byas pa'i sngags zor zlog: skye bos byas pa'i mda' zor zlog: gtso bos byas pa'i gros ngan zlog: bud med byas pa'i dmod zor zlog: bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la sdang bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad med par gyur cig: brlag par gyur cig: zhi bar gyur cig: kun tu zhi bar gyur cig: oṃ traka rak+sha kha 'dar nṛ rbad bh+yo: kha la dzaḥthun nṛ rbad bh+yo: nā ga shu tse nṛ rbad bh+yo: shan+tiṃ pa nṛ rbad bh+yo: ma nṛ rak+sha nṛ rbad bh+yo: yak+sha kha thun nṛ rbad bh+yo: kha thun tshal pa nṛ rbad bh+yo: hri tri dz+wa la nṛ rbad bh+yo: srid pa pho rgyud dregs pa'i chad pa dgra la bh+yo bh+yo: dza kha thun kha la yak+sha ya: du ra yak+sha snying la ya: khal tse nā ga srog la ya: kha sa ga sha rbad su ya: ma ma rak+sha khrag la ya: ha ri khā hi las la ya: rak+sha ya: shu'o rak+sha dbugs la ya: gh+raṃ bh+yo taṃ bh+yo las la ya: mo rgyud mkha' 'gro'i chad pa dgra la bh+yo bh+yo: tri kha thun khal tse yak+sha rbad: ma ni dza la kha la rbad: ma nṛ rak+sha snying la rbad: bhi ri tsa ni gzugs la rbad: snying khrag dza la srog la rbad: a ka yak+sha srog la rbad: mā ra aṃ ku sha ya snying la rbad: ma ni rak+sha srog la rbad: klu gnyan dregs pa'i chad pa dgra la bh+yo bh+yo: lha ma srin sde brgyad kyi chad pa thams cad dgra la bh+yo bh+yo: byad ma dgra bo'i steng du bh+yo: byad ma dgra bo'i steng du zlog:

byad ma dgra bo'i steng du nan: byad ma dgra bo'i kha tham: byad ma dgra bo'i kā ya nan: byad ma dgra bo'i wāka nan: byad ma dgra bo'i tsit+ta nan: zhes bh+yos gdab bo: bcu gcig pa zor bskul ba ni: hūm̐ */ bcom ldan dpal dgu 'bar ba yi: mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la bsgyur: hūm̐ */ shar phyogs pho nya rab 'bar ba: mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: hūm̐ */ lho phyogs pho nya rab 'bar ba: mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: hūm̐ */ nub phyogs pho nya rab 'bar ba: mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: hūm̐ */ byang phyogs pho nya rab 'bar ba: mi bzad sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: rab 'jigs rab tu rngam pa yi: brgya phrag brgya yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs rnams la zor 'di 'phen: bzlog go rab 'bar gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha pad+ma kro dhī shwa rī a hrīḥ badz+ra kī li kī la ya ma hā yak+sha kā la rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ trika nan: e hur thuṃ dzaḥmā ra ya rbad: sarba ru tri hriṃ hriṃ dza: sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ bh+yo: sha trūṃ hur thuṃ dzaḥmā ra ya rbad:

dgra bgegs dam sri nṛ tri rbad thuṃ: dha ra ya dha ra ya: mā ra ya mā ra ya: nā ga du tshin+dha tshin+dha: mi li mi li: bhan+dha bhan+dha: nā ga ni swā hā: hūm̐ ha he phaṭa bh+yo: hṛ da ya mo ha ya: pra ha ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa: sa ma ya a ti kra ma ni: sa ra ṇa bh+yo: a la la bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: ces brjod do: bcu gnyis pa bcol dam bya ba ni: hūm̐ */ bka' srung dam can lha tshogs la: dam nyams dgra bgegs 'byung po 'di: gsod cing bsgral bar bya ba'i phyir: mgo lus rgyan dang bcas pa 'bul: bcol lo gtad do gnyer du longs: lus ngag yid gsum rdul du rlogs: sha khrag gzugs kyi phung po shigs: rnam shes bde chen gnas su drongs: bzhes shig lhag ma med par mdzod: bcol lo gtad do gnyer du longs: zhes brjod do: bcu gsum pa smon lam gdab pa ni: hoḥ dkyil 'khor phyi yi bar khyams chen po na: dpal gyi bka' nyan srung ma'i tshogs: dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad: mkha' 'gro sum cu so gnyis: ging chen bco brgyad: laṅka drug cu: dur khrod dregs pa'i ma mo bdun: rgyal chen sring mo bzhi: pho nya drug cu rtsa bzhi: sa bdag mo sum cu so gnyis: 'bar ma brgyad: dbang gi gru 'degs bzhi: pho nya 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro: 'jig rten skyong ba brtan ma'i tshogs: dpal gyi bka' srung dam can pho nya'i tshogs rnams la phrin las gnyan po bcol ba ni: zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod la sogs pa'i phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub pa dang : rdo rje slob dpon mched dang lcam dral: rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor dang bcas pa la bsrung zhing byin gyis brlab tu gsol: tshe ring ba dang : nad med pa dang : dpal 'byor longs spyod thams cad rgyas par mdzad du gsol: chags che nyam nga rbad 'dre rbod gtong mo ngan rmis ltas mtshan ma ngan pa thams cad phyir zlog cig: bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra la rbad cing gnod par byed pa'i bgegs rnams 'dul ba'i phrin las su bcol ba ni:

sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa: dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smod pa: rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku dgra: rnal 'byor pa'i sgos dgra: mched dang lcam dral gyi spyi dgra: rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi rkyen dgra: sems can yongs la 'tshe ba: snga dgra lag gis bdar ba: phyi dgra snying la bsams pa/ da dgra dngos su 'khu ba: gzugs can gyi dgra: gzugs med kyi bgegs: bar gcod kyi rkyen: bsam pa ngan pa 'chang ba: sbyor ba rtsub mo ston par byed pa'i dgra bgegs byad ma gdug pa can thams cad thal ba'i rdul du rlogs shig: sku gsung thugs kyi dbyings su gtad do: bcol ba'i las gyis shig: sgrub pa'i rtags phyung zhig: phrin las thams cad mngon sum du 'grub par mdzod cig: ces brjod do: ༈ /spyi don gsum pa mjug tu gtong ba'i thabs la gsum ste: khyung dang rnga mo'i zlog pa: ltas ngan brgyad cu'i zlog pa: srin mo za lam bstan pa'o: dang po khyung zlog la don brgyad de/ sku bskyed pa/ spyan 'dren/ bzhugs gsol/ phyag 'tshal/ mchod 'bul/ bstod pa/ bskul/ khyung zlog dngos so: dang po gsang lung las: bar chad kun sel gtor zlog ni: dkyil 'khor khrag byug e khram steng : gtor chen khrag zor rtsang bcas dgu: rtse la stobs chen gyad sprul gzugs: sbyor dngos las kyi gzhung bsrangs la: dpal dgu'i snying por sham bur bcas: so lnga'i drag sngags 'bru tshug bzlas: spyi dang sgos bskul bh+yo zlog bcas: phur thun tshom bur bskul cing zlog: dus min 'chi dang zor ltas zlog: ces gsungs pas: dang po sku bskyed pa la gnyis te: rgyas pa dngos dang : bsdus pa'o: dang po rgyas pa ni: hūm̐ */ skad cig gis pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du: khroṃ dang k+ṣiṃ las bya khyung rgyal po dgu ni: dbus mthing nag: shar dang shar lho dkar po: lho dang lho nub ser po: nub dang nub byang dmar po: byang dang byang shar ljang gu'am:

yang na gzhung ltar rigs lnga bskyed: gnyis pa bsdus pa ni: dbus nyid du bya khyung rgyal po mthing nag me rab tu 'bar ba: rdo rje'i rwa gnyis rnam par gdengs pa'i dbus su nor bu 'bar bas brgyan pa: zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa: mchu dang sder mo gnam lcags las grub pa: rab tu 'jigs pa: ba spu'i bu ga nas sprul pa'i pho nya dang me'i tsha tsha 'phro ba klu bdud gdug pa can rnams phyag gnyis kyis bzung nas zhal du gsol ba: g.yas g.yon gnyis su gshog ru lnga lnga rnam par gdengs pa: mjug sgro brgyad dang bcas shing : spu rnams spu gri'i so ltar rno zhing 'bar ba: khyung gi sprul pa dpag tu med pa 'phros pas gdug pa can thams cad rlog par byed pa'i skur byung bar bsam: de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po: mgrin par āḥdamar po: thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po: hūm̐ dang khroṃ las 'od zer 'phros: 'og min gyi gnas dpal dgu'i thugs ka nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i bya khyung spyan drangs te: mdun gyi nam mkha' khengs par bsams la: hūm̐ */ klu dang sa bdag nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan: 'bar ba'i yi ge khroṃ las sku bskyed pa: 'dab chags rgyal po bya khyung ga ru ḍa: mthing nag g.yu gshog mgo bo zangs las grub: gnam lcags 'bar ba'i mchu sder rab tu 'chang : rdo rje'i rwa bgrad spyi gtsug rin chen 'bar: phyag gis sbrul bzung rngams shing zhal du gsol: lcags ral nag po yan lag sbrul gyis brgyan: spyan bgrad mche gtsigs me dpung klong dkyil nas: zhabs bgrad 'gyings pa klu yi gdan la bzhugs: sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las khyung : klu bdud sa bdag bsnol ba'i khri steng du: nyi zla pad steng khroṃ las sku bskyed pa: rigs lnga khyung chen rab tu 'bar ba ni: che mchog khyung chen mthing nag 'khor lo 'dzin: yang dag khyung chen dkar po rdo rje 'dzin: 'jam dpal khyung chen ser nag rin chen 'dzin: pad+ma'i khyung chen dmar nag pad+ma 'dzin:

phrin las khyung chen ljang nag rgya gram 'dzin: khyung chen rigs lnga me dpung 'bar ba'i klong : sprin bzhin gtibs nas klu yi gdan la bzhugs: oṃ bud+dha ga ru ḍa: badz+ra ga ru ḍa: rat+na ga ru ḍa: pad+ma ga ru ḍa: karma ga ru ḍa hūm̐ phaṭa: ces sku bskyed la/ gnyis pa spyan drang ba ni: hūm̐ */ 'og min gnas nas rigs lngar sprul pa'i sku: khyung rnams g.yu gshog mgo bo zangs las grub: rdo rje'i rwa bgrad spyi gtsug nor bus brgyan: mchu sder gnam lcags 'jigs pa'i nga ro sgrog: smug nag khyung gis klu dang sa bdag 'dul: mthing nag khyung gis dri za rgyal rigs 'dul: ser nag khyung gis grul bum rje rigs 'dul: dmar nag khyung gis klu dbang bram ze 'dul: ljang nag khyung gis gnod sbyin gdol pa 'dul: thugs rjes dbang gis spyan 'dren bzhugs su gsol: oṃ bud+dha ga ru ḍa: badz+ra ga ru ḍa: rat+na ga ru ḍa: pad+ma ga ru ḍa: karma ga ru ḍa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa dbyer med du gyur par bsam mo: gsum pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐ */ rigs lnga khyung gis klu rnams 'dul phyir du: sprul pa'i khyung chen du ma'i tshogs dang bcas: klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong gi gdan: pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol: oṃ bud+dha ga ru ḍa: badz+ra ga ru ḍa: rat+na ga ru ḍa: pad+ma ga ru ḍa: karma ga ru ḍa hūm̐ phaṭa: sarba ga ru ḍa: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: zhes pas ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa bzang ngan med par dbyer mi phyed pa'i bdag nyid du mos: bzhi pa phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐ */ che mchog rigs kyi khyung rnams ni: smug nag 'khor lo pha lam thogs: yang dag thugs kyi khyung rnams ni: mthing nag rdo rje pha lam thogs: 'jam dpal sku yi khyung rnams ni: ser nag rin chen pha lam thogs: pad+ma gsung gi khyung rnams ni: dmar nag pad+ma pha lam thogs: phur pa phrin las khyung rnams ni: ljang nag ral gri pha lam thogs: phyag zhabs sor mo ba spu las:

sprul pa'i khyung la phyag 'tshal lo: oṃ bud+dha ga ru ḍa: badz+ra ga ru ḍa: rat+na ga ru ḍa: pad+ma ga ru ḍa: karma ga ru ḍa: sarba ga ru ḍa: a ti pū hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ a la la hoḥ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa dbyer med pa la: gnyis su med pa'i phyag 'tshal bar bsam mo: lnga pa mchod pa 'bul ba la gnyis te: gtor ma dang bdud rtsis mchod pa'o: dang po ni: hūm̐ */ klu rnams 'dul mdzad khro bo rigs kyi gtso: rigs lnga'i khyung chen rab tu 'jigs pa'i sku: klu dang sa bdag ma lus 'dul mdzad pa: 'dab chags rgyal po bya khyung 'khor bcas la: dug gsum sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma dang : mchod pa'i 'dod yon rnam lnga la sogs pa: klu gnyan sa bdag sha khrag rus pa rnams: 'jigs byed khyung gi tshogs la mchod pa 'bul: gdug pa bsgral phyir gtor ma bzhes su gsol: oṃ bud+dha ga ru ḍa i daṃ ba ling+ta khā hi: badz+ra ga ru ḍa i daṃ ba ling+ta khā hi: rat+na ga ru ḍa i daṃ ba ling+ta khā hi: pad+ma ga ru ḍa i daṃ ba ling+ta khā hi: karma ga ru ḍa i daṃ ba ling+ta khā hi: ma hā maṃ sa la khā hi: ma hā rak+ta khā hi: ma hā tsit+ta khā hi: ma hā keṃ ni ri ti khā hi: ma hā ba su ta khā hi: ma hā go ro tsa na khā hi: ma hā tsak+ṣuḥl khā hi: ga ru ḍa sarba ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā: pā d+yaṃ= puṣ+pe= dhū pe= ā lo ke= gan+dhe= nai wi d+ye= shapad pra tīts+tsha swā hā: gnyis pa bdud rtsis mchod pa ni: hūm̐ */ che mchog khyung dang yang dag khyung : gshin rje'i khyung dang pad+ma'i khyung : las kyi khyung la sogs pa yi: klu rnams 'dul byed khyung chen 'khor dang bcas: dus gsum bde gshegs sprul pa'i khyung rnams la: rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dgra bgegs bsgral du gsol: zhes dbul lo: drug pa bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐ */ gdug pa ma rungs 'dul bar mdzad pa yi: rigs lnga'i sprul pa khyung du bstan pa ni: 'dab chags rgyal po bya khyung ga ru ḍa:

rdo rje'i g.yu gshog mgo bo zangs las grub: rdo rje'i rwa mchu gnam lcags sder mo can: rdo rje'i rwa can nor bu 'bar ba la: lcags kyi ral pa sbrul gyis yan lag brgyan: rigs kyi klu gnyan sa bdag 'dul mdzad pa: sangs rgyas sprul pa'i bya khyung rgyal por bstod: hūm̐ */ gang gis gang la ci 'dul ba'i: sna tshogs sku ni ston par mdzad: khyung chen nyid du skur sprul nas: klu gnyan 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod: yang sprul bye ba bsam mi khyab: klu srin dgu khri snying 'byin pa: sum sprul nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam: sprul pa'i khyung la phyag 'tshal bstod: khams gsum sems can thams cad la: mi ma yin gyis 'tshe byed pa: gzhom phyir khyung du skur bstan pa: khyung chen rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: rnam rtog 'joms mdzad thugs rje'i bdag: khyung chen lngar ni rab tu grags: so so'i rigs su skur ston pa: khyung du sprul la phyag 'tshal bstod: mthu stobs dpal ldan bya khyung khyod: gdug pa ma lus kun 'dul mdzad: sprul pa phyogs bcur 'gyed mdzad pa: gdug pa 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod: gnod sbyin gdon tshogs ma lus kun: rngams pa'i tshul gyis sgrol ba yi: drag po'i mdzad spyod rnams rdzogs pa'i: stobs chen khyung la phyag 'tshal bstod: gti mug tshogs kun 'joms pa'i mchog: che mchog khyung chen drag po ste: thams cad dbyings su sgrol mdzad pa: rnam snang sprul pa'i khyung la bstod: zhe sdang gdug pa 'dul mdzad pa: yang dag khyung chen drag po ste: zhe sdang rtsad nas gcod mdzad pa: mi bskyod khyung la phyag 'tshal bstod: nga rgyal dregs pa 'joms mdzad pa'i: gshin rje'i khyung chen drag po ste: mnyam nyid dbyings su sgrol mdzad pa: rin chen khyung la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'dod chags rtsad nas gcod mdzad pa'i: pad+ma'i khyung chen drag po ste: so sor mnyam pa nyid sbyor ba: snang mtha'i khyung la phyag 'tshal bstod: phrag dog rtsad nas gcod mdzad pa:

phrin las khyung chen drag po ste: thams cad sgrol ba'i las la brtson: don grub khyung la phyag 'tshal bstod: bla med khyung dang rig 'dzin khyung : mchod bstod khyung dang drag sngags khyung : bka' sdod khyung la sogs pa yi: bka' brgyad khyung la phyag 'tshal bstod: ye shes lnga yi sprul pa las: khyung chen lngar ni rab tu grags: so so'i sku mdog phyag mtshan 'dzin: klu rigs rnam lnga 'dul la bstod: zhi ba'i khyung dang rgyas pa'i khyung : dbang gi khyung dang drag po'i khyung : zhi khro'i lha tshogs khyung du sprul: sprul pa rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: me tog bdug spos mar me dang : zhal zas byug pa sgra snyan sogs: phyi nang lha mo'i khyung la bstod: stobs chen gshin rje rta mgrin bdud rtsi 'khyil: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu ste: sgo srung khro bo khro mo khyung du bstan: sprul pa'i khyung chen rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ */ khyod kyi spyi bo'i gtsug steng na: de bzhin rigs kyi ga ru ḍa: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dkar: gshog pa 'khor los gtams pa'i tshul: spyan mig dmar zlum phyogs bcur gzigs: mchu sder lcags kyu lta bu yis: rgyal rigs klu rnams zhal du gsol: bud+dha'i khyung la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ */ khyod kyi gsung gi mgrin dbus na: pad+ma rigs kyi ga ru ḍa: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar: gshog pa pad+mas gtams pa'i tshul: spyan mig dmar zlum phyogs bcur gzigs: mchu sder lcags kyu lta bu yis: bram ze'i klu rnams zhal du gsol: pad+ma'i khyung la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ */ khyod kyi thugs kyi dkyil du ni: rdo rje rigs kyi khyung chen ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog mthing : gshog pa rdo rjes gtams pa'i tshul: spyan mig dmar zlum phyogs bcur gzigs: mchu sder lcags kyu lta bu yis: rje rigs klu rnams zhal du gsol: rdo rje'i khyung la phyag 'tshal bstod:

hūm̐ */ khyod kyi lte ba'i dkyil dag na: rin chen rigs kyi ga ru ḍa: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog ser: gshog pa rin chen gtams pa'i tshul: spyan mig dmar zlum phyogs bcur gzigs: mchu sder lcags kyu lta bu yis: dmangs rigs klu rnams zhal du gsol: rin chen khyung la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ */ khyod kyi gsang ba'i dkyil dbus na: phrin las rigs kyi ga ru ḍa: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog ljang : gshog pa ral gris gtams pa'i tshul: spyan mig dmar zlum phyogs bcur gzigs: mchu sder lcags kyu lta bu yis: gdol pa'i klu rnams zhal du gsol: don grub khyung la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ */ sprul pa'i khyung dang yang sprul khyung : khyung gi gshog sgra 'u ru ru: khyung gi gshog sgra chems se chem: khyung gi bro rdung khrigs se khrig: rigs lnga'i khyung la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'gro ba'i don la myur brtson pa: khyung gi char pa si li li: nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhi khengs: sprul pa'i khyung la phyag 'tshal bstod: yang sprul khyung ni thog ltar grags: zas su klu gnyan sa bdag za: skom du dmar chen khrag la 'thung : gtum chen khyung la phyag 'tshal bstod: khams gsum klu rnams 'dul ba'i phyir: drag po'i cha lugs 'jigs pa'i gzugs: mi mthun phyogs rnams 'dul mdzad phyir: gdug pa sbrul rnams zhal du gsol: drag po gsod byed khyung la bstod: bde gshegs bstan pa bsrung mdzad phyir: bde gshegs dbu la khyung gis brgyan: sku lus ba spu khyung gis gang : sangs rgyas bstan srung khyod la bstod: sprul pa'i bye brag khyung sprul nas: 'gro don phyogs med mdzad pa po: sa bdag klu yi gnyen po ste: mgon dang skyabs mdzad khyod la bstod: chos nyid gcig las ma g.yos kyang : 'gro ba'i don du sna tshogs khyung : dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams kyi sprul: sprul pa'i 'gro don phyogs ris med: sangs rgyas rnam sprul khyung la bstod:

ces bstod: bdun pa phrin las bcol ba ni: hūm̐ */ mkha' lding rgyal po 'joms byed ga ru ḍa: rdo rje'i gshog pa brkyangs pas nam mkha' khengs: lcags rwa chen pos ri rab rtse nas bsnyil: lcags kyi 'dab gshog me dpung rab tu 'bar: gser gyi rdeb sgro bskal pa'i rlung sgra can: rdo rje'i gshog pa drag shul brdab pa yis: klu rnams 'khor bcas sder mos spyi nas 'dren: nga rgyal cher 'chang shin tu khro gtum can: gdug pa'i klu bgegs gnyan po rdul du rlog: mchu sder ring pos sbrul gyi nor bu 'dren: sha khrag rnams la dgyes pas bzhes su gsol: rgyal rigs la sogs rigs lnga klu yi sbrul: rngams shing drag pos zhal du gsol bar byed: klu la sogs pa'i dgra bgegs rdul du rlogs: hūm̐ */ 'jigs byed rgyal po bya khyung khyod: sku la bud+dha rigs kyi khyung : gdug pa 'dul ba'i phrin las mdzod: gsung la pad+ma rigs kyi khyung : gdug pa 'dul ba'i phrin las mdzod: thugs la badz+ra rigs kyi khyung : gdug pa 'dul ba'i phrin las mdzod: lte bar rin chen rigs kyi khyung : gdug pa 'dul ba'i phrin las mdzod: gsang bar las kyi rigs kyi khyung : gdug pa 'dul ba'i 'phrin las mdzod: oṃ kaṃ ka ra: kaṃ ka ra: dza ti hūm̐ dza dzaḥ oṃ ga ru ḍa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭa: od kaṃ od kaṃ: khyung ka ra khyung ka ra: sha ma ra byin du: badz+ra ma hā kro dha gnod byed mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa: ces so: yang kha cig ltar khyung gi phrin las bsdus pa byed na: bskyed chog gong du bsdus pa ltar bya zhing : spyan drang ba ni: hūm̐ */ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: tshur gshegs tshur gshegs bya khyung rgyal: 'dab chags rgyal po ga ru ḍa: gser mig 'khyil ba dkar la 'tsher: gnam lcags gdug pa'i mchu sder gyis: sa bdag klu rnams 'jigs par byed: 'dab gshog gser gyi ral gri gshibs: klu rnams ma lus zhal du gsol: lcags gshog lcags kyi le brgan la:

g.yu yi mkhal kheb mdzes pas brgyan: mjug ma g.yu yi ru mtshon can: 'khor lo rin chen 'bar bas dbu la brgyan: rnal 'byor bdag gis bya khyung bos pa'i tshe: spyan nas khrag gi rba klong kyi li li: gshog pa g.yas pas nyi zla so sor 'phen: gshog pa g.yon pas sa gzhi brdar sha gcod: bya khyung rgyal po bos so snyan ma sra: bya khyung rgyal po g.yab bo spyan ma btul: bya khyung rgyal po bsten no rgyang ma ring : bya khyung rgyal po sgrub bo mthu ma chung : bya khyung rgyal lo bskul lo sgab ma lji: ltas ngan zlog dang las kun bsgrub pa'i phyir: ri rab rtse yi gnas mchog dam pa nas: bstan pa bsrung phyir gnas 'dir spyan 'dren no: 'gro ba'i don la mchod phyir gshegs su gsol: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ khroṃ ga ru ḍa rā dza sa ma ya dza dzaḥ zhes brjod do: hūm̐ */ bdag nyid che mchog dbu la khyung bsgoms te: rmad du byung ba'i gtor ma'i mchod pa dang : bdud rtsi sbyor sgrol rak+ta chen pos mchod: ma hā ga ru ḍa rā dza ba ling+ta khā hi khā hi: pañtsa a mṛ ta ga ṇa ta na pū dza me gha hūm̐: zhes dbul lo: hūm̐ */ 'dab chags rgyal po bya khyung ga ru ḍa: lcags sder bgrad pas tshangs pa'i g.yul rtse gnon: gshog pa brkyangs pas gza' klu dbang du sdud: spu gri'i mche ba 'jigs par gtsigs pa yis: klu chen rgyal po 'khor bcas las la 'khol: mnyam nyid thabs mkhas thugs rjes mnga' bdag nyid: khro rgyal nyid dang dgongs pa mnyam par bzhugs: thabs dang ldan pas shes rab yum dang sbyor: dgra bgegs gshed gyur bya khyung rgyal po khyod: ltas ngan ma lus zlog sgyur phrin las mdzod: ces so: brgyad pa khyung bzlog bya ba ni: khyung gtor mar bzhugs: kha phyir bstan nas 'di skad do: hūm̐ */ bcom ldan dpal chen che mchog he ru kaḥ khyung gi rdo rje'i rwa gnyis la: phyag rdor khro bo bco brgyad shar: ri la chu chen 'brub pa'i byad: rdo rje 'jigs byed ltas ngan zlog:

spyi gtsug nor bu 'bar ba yis: nor lha pho mo drug cu sprul: nam mkhar sprin dmar mched pa'i byad: chu rgyun chad pa'i ltas ngan zlog: spyan mig dmar zlum bgrad pa las: khrag 'thung lnga bcu rtsa brgyad sprul: 'od zer gnam lcags 'phro ba'i byad: phyogs rnams g.yo ba'i ltas ngan zlog: lcags kyi sder mo rdo rje'i mchu: dbang chen khro bo lnga bcu brgyad: sa rnams steng du 'phyo ba'i byad: sna tshogs sprul pa'i ltas ngan zlog: sbrul za sbrul gyis sku la brgyan: mkha' lding rgyal po lnga ru shar: ri rab shing gis brtol ba'i byad: bcud chen 'gyur ba'i ltas ngan zlog: hūm̐ */ bya khyung rgyal po khyed rnams kyis: gdong pas gdong can ltas ngan zlog: gshog pas 'dab chags ltas ngan zlog: sder mos sder chags ltas ngan zlog: mchu yis lto 'gro'i ltas ngan zlog: rwa yis rwa can ltas ngan zlog: sbrul gyis klu yi ltas ngan zlog: stong pa'i ting 'dzin pho nyas zlog: hū?m̐ */ khro rgyal khams gsum hūm̐ sgra can: sku la zangs khrab 'od kyis mdzes: phyag na mdung dmar chems se chem: ba dan rtse gsum g.yab mo rdeb: g.yas nas bskor bas lha srin sdud: g.yon nas bskor bas klu srin sdud: klad la bskor bas bdud dpung 'joms: srog dbugs dbang byed las la khyab: ltas ngan dmigs kyis bsgral du gtor: zhes brjod do: gnyis pa rnga mo'i bzlog pa ni: hūm̐ */ nga ni che mchog he ru kaḥ ltas ngan zlog pa'i mthu bo che: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i drag rtsal can: ltas ngan bzlog pa'i dus la bab: bh+yo bh+yo ltas ngan dgra la bh+yo: sgyur sgyur ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: zor zor ltas ngan dgra la zor: zlog zlog ltas ngan dgra la zlog: hūm̐ */ bcom ldan dpal chen he ru ka'i: ltas ngan bzlog pa'i pho nya ni: sgyur byed rnga mo stobs po che: zlog byed rnga mo'i dpral ba na: skyes pa dmag la chas pa dgu: skyes pas mda' zor 'phen pa yi:

ltas ngan cho 'phrul dgra la bh+yo: rnga mo'i dpung pa g.yas pa na: sngags nag dgra bo sgrol ba dgu: sngags pas phur zor 'phen pa yi: ltas ngan cho 'phrul dgra la bh+yo: rnga mo'i dpung pa g.yon pa na: ban+dhe thal mo rdeb pa dgu: dgra bcom btsun pas dmod pa yi: ltas ngan cho 'phrul dgra la bh+yo: zlog byed rnga mo'i dpyi g.yas na: khye'u 'ur rdo thogs pa dgu: khye'us rdo zor 'phen pa yi: ltas ngan cho 'phrul dgra la bh+yo: sgyur byed rnga mo'i dpyi g.yon na: bud med dul mo thogs pa dgu: yug sas dul zor 'phen pa yi: ltas ngan cho 'phrul dgra la bh+yo: rnga mo'i rtsibs logs g.yas pa na: bon po ngan sngags 'don pa dgu: bon pos sngags zor 'phen pa yi: ltas ngan cho 'phrul dgra la bh+yo: rnga mo'i rtsibs logs g.yon pa na: ngar glud dkar dmar dgu po 'di: zhang zhung glud zor 'phen pa yi: ltas ngan cho 'phrul dgra la bh+yo: hūm̐ */ bcom ldan dpal chen he ru kaḥ khyung gi ltas ngan bzlog pa ni: rwa yis rwa can ltas ngan zlog: mchu yis mchu can ltas ngan zlog: gshog pas gshog can ltas ngan zlog: gdong pas gdong can ltas ngan zlog: hūm̐ */ bcom ldan dpal chen he ru ka'i: dbu ni nyi shu rtsa gcig la: phyag ni bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis te: sangs rgyas bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis bsnams: dur khrod chas brgyad sku la brgyan: khro tshul nyi shu rtsa gcig sprul: dbu la khyung chen 'bar bas brgyan: khyung gi ral pa sprugs pa las: sprul pa'i ma mo bcu gsum mched: nam mkha' smug nag 'thib pa'i byad: dred mo ral 'dzing ltas ngan zlog: hūm̐ */ g.yas kyi gshog zur dang po la: steng gi khro bcu 'bar ba sprul: seng ge 'brug sngon 'thab pa'i byad: gnam lcags 'bar ba'i ltas ngan zlog: gshog zur 'bar ba gnyis pa la: gsang ba'i khro bo chen po bcu: glang chen sna la 'phyo ba'i byad: stag seng 'dzing ba'i ltas ngan zlog: gshog zur 'bar ba gsum pa la:

spyi dpal khro bo bcu 'bar ba: gnam sa sprin dmar mched pa'i byad: bud med ral 'dzing ltas ngan zlog: g.yas kyi gshog zur bzhi pa la: rdzogs pa chen po'i khro bcu 'bar: skar mda' sa la ltung ba'i byad: dbyig gi nor bu'i ltas ngan zlog: g.yas kyi gshog zur lnga pa la: ta kṛta sgo ba bcu ru sprul: ri rab me chen mched pa'i byad: lci ba zas kyi ltas ngan zlog: hūm̐ */ g.yon gyi gshog zur dang po la: srog rtsa'i ma mo bdun shar bas: rgya mtshor dug sbrul 'khyil ba'i byad: me tog bcud nyams ltas ngan zlog: g.yon gyi gshog zur gnyis pa la: e ka drag mo spun drug sprul: mkha' la stag mo 'phyo ba'i byad: rdzi yis bskyod pa'i ltas ngan zlog: g.yon gyi gshog zur gsum pa la: srin mo 'bar ma bdun du sprul: mkha' la bya rgod sder 'dzing byad: gter gyi bcud nyams ltas ngan zlog: g.yon gyi gshog zur bzhi pa la: sring mo bzhi dang rgyal mo lnga: g.yu sha dkar mo 'dzing ba'i byad: seng ge ngu 'bod ltas ngan zlog: g.yon gyi gshog zur lnga pa la: nyi shu rtsa brgyad sprul pa ste: rno dbal ngar gyi ltas ngan dang : rma bya spangs pa'i ltas ngan zlog: g.yu sgong sngon po yar ba dang : lcags kyi ser ba 'bab pa dang : shel dkar snod du dug g.yos dang : zangs sgong dmar po 'dril ba dang : mi bzad 'bar ba klad la 'khor: nyi ma sprin gyis bsgribs pa dang : 'tshub ma mang po rmi ltas dang : seng ge gangs kyi steng du ngu: ltas ngan sum cu slar las zlog: hūm̐ */ khyung gi mjug sgro brgyad po las: gdong mo bzhi dang rgyal mo lnga: sprul pa bzhi yi phreng bar shar: bse sgong khra bo'i zur bstan pa: lcugs phran zor gyis 'debs pa dang : gza' skar 'khrugs pa'i byad byung ba: zor brgyad rtse la sbur pa chags: de yi ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: hūm̐ */ khro rgyal khams gsum hūm̐ sgra can: sku la zangs khrab 'od kyis mdzes:

phyag na mdung dmar chems se chem: ba dan rtse gsum g.yab mo rdeb: g.yas nas bskor bas lha srin sdud: g.yon nas bskor bas klu srin sdud: klad la bskor bas bdud dpung 'joms: srog dbugs dbang byed srog la khyab: ltas ngan dmigs kyis gzir ba ni: khra gsum kha nas sbrul khyer ba: klu dang gnyan gyi ltas ngan yin: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: dur bya'i kha nas nya khyer ba: klu dang ma mo'i ltas ngan yis: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: bya gsum sder 'dzing byed pa ni: phung sri langs ba'i ltas ngan yin: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: rgod bzhis gshog 'dzing byed pa ni: gnam lha dkar po'i ltas ngan yin: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: rma byas mi ro za ba ni: srid pa rgyal mo'i ltas ngan yin: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: bya gnyis mchu yis sa rko ba: ma bdud chen mo'i ltas ngan yin: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: 'dab chags gcig la gcig zhon pa: srid kha langs pa'i ltas ngan yin: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: 'dab chags ltas ngan nyi shu po: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: dom gsum kha nas mi ro khyer: dbyings kyi ma mo'i ltas ngan yin: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: sbrul nag thur la rgyug pa ni: klu dang dmu yi ltas ngan yin: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur:

wa mo dur khrod brgyal ba ni: phung sri langs pa'i ltas ngan yin: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: ne'u le kha nas sbrul khyer ba: chung sri langs pa'i ltas ngan yin: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: spyang gsum 'o dod 'bod pa ni: rgyal po btsan gyi ltas ngan yin: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: shwa bud nang du khyer ba ni: lha bdud khros pa'i ltas ngan yin: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: tho rangs sgo khyi ngu zug byed: ya bdud langs pa'i ltas ngan yin: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: byi bas skra la za ba ni: gnam sa 'khrugs pa'i ltas ngan yin: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: sder chags ltas ngan nyi shu po: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: rta phrug glang mgo byung ba ni: klu btsan sdong ba'i ltas ngan yin: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: cang shes gru gsum shel mig ni: ya bdud rgyal po'i ltas ngan yin: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: rnga mor mi ro bkal ba ni: phung gsum langs pa'i ltas ngan yin: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: phru gu mgo brnyan byung ba ni: dgra sri langs pa'i ltas ngan yin: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: rte'u steng na bya bab na: ma mo dam sri'i ltas ngan yin: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog:

bsgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: ming sring srid pa'i bu byung ba: bdag srid log pa'i ltas ngan yin: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: bong bu sbrul gyi mthur can ni: ma bdud khros pa'i ltas ngan yin: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: bong thor mgo gsum byung ba ni: ma yam brtan ma'i ltas ngan yin: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: rmig zlum ltas ngan nyi shu po: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: spre'u lag na khram khyer ba: the'u rang spun gsum ltas ngan yin: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: spre'u gsum rta la zhon pa ni: phung sri langs pa'i ltas ngan yin: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: 'dab chags drel la zhon pa ni: rgyal blon bran gsum ltas ngan yin: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: rte'u phrug mi ro za ba de: ma yam brtan ma'i ltas ngan yin: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: sbal pa lag na sbrul khyer ba: klu gnyan sa bdag ltas ngan yin: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: bud med 'thab cing 'dzing ba ni: ma yam dam sri'i ltas ngan yin: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: dred mo rnga 'bral brang rdung ba: lha mo bdud mo'i ltas ngan yin: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: pho mo lha sar bsnol byed pa:

lha klu langs pa'i ltas ngan yin: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: gdong can ltas ngan nyi shu po: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: ltas ngan chen po zhes bya ba: mdzo la dur bya zhon pa ni: bde chen ma mo'i ltas ngan yin: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: srod la bya pho zer ba dang : nam gung 'og rta 'tsher ba dang : tho rangs sgo khyi ngu ba dang : thad nas shing chen chag pa dang : ltag lkog brag ral sa chad sogs: sde brgyad 'khrugs pa'i ltas ngan yin: bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: zhes so: gsum pa ltas ngan brgyad cu'i zlog pa tshang ba shes par bya'o: 'di'i bar la chas gzhan dang khram zlog gyer: gtor ma yang 'di'i skabs su bsgril bya ba yin no: bzhi pa srin mo za lam bstan pa ni: bca' thabs ni gong du bshad pa ltar bya zhing : zlog sngags dang za lam bstan pa dngos so: dang po zlog sngags ni: a+ye a+ye a+ye: a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka: ya ma ye: kā la rū pa ka pa ye: hrīḥṣ+ṭī a pa ye: a a ne a ne: u u ne u ne: du du ne du ne: a i: u e: o aṃ: ra rī la lī: du ru ye: bya tsa ye: singha ye: hṛ da ye: bhi ta ye: tsit+ta ye: ha la ye: mu kha ye: u u ne: u u ne: byi tri ta: a a na na: ya mān+ta ka: ya ma rā dza: ya ma rak+sha: ya ma kro ta: ya ma raka ā: be tā lī kro dhī shwa rī: ma mo e ka tsa ti: de ma kha la baṃ ril: bh+yo ya snying kha raka srog la bh+yo bh+yo: oṃ mu ni sha trūṃ: oṃ ga ru ḍa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐ a kro rā tsa dur na sa dur snying la sbrel sbrel: hūm̐ a kro rā tsa dur na snying la: sha la sha la rbad rbad: ya ya: rnal ma rnal tri dza: snying la thun mā ra ya rbad: traka rak+sha kha mun tra mu ru lu ru lu bh+yo bh+yo:

rak+mo te ke ma dza dzaḥl la he bh+yo: oṃ āḥ.uṣ+ṇī ṣa badz+ra tsakra warti: sarba bi lo ki ni ka: lo kod ta ra yan+t+ra man+t+ra tan+t+ra sarba bhi sa bhi tsur+ṇa ya: ka pra dz+ya ki ni: ma ma tra tri ya na ke na: tsi kṛta ta ni sarba bigh+nāṃ: bhi ta bha ya: uṣ+ṇī ṣa badz+ra tsakra warti: bruṃ bruṃ bruṃ: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: e ka du na zlog: tsa du snying du zlog: ma shā du na zlog: sa ma ya du na zlog: oṃ he ka ya ma: ghṛ ma ya ma: sarba tsit+ta badz+ra gzir thuṃ: bhig nan: trika nan: rbad ya: sngags 'chang bdag la rak+ṣa: dgra bgegs gnod byed kyi srog la hūm̐ phaṭa: zlog ya: lo hūm̐ badz+ra hrīḥ mā ra ya dza: sha trūṃ bā ti ka swā hā: che ge mo spub cig spub cig: thir phur nan swā hā: hūm̐ ri ti bha ta ya: mo ha ya: lo ka bha sha ya: ha hūm̐ zlog zlog: hūm̐ hrīḥdzaḥhūm̐: sa ma ya hri zlog: chil chil: sa ma ya zlog: a la la ho: pra mo ha: bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo: sha khri khram: stam kham tam: ma thod khrag tsit+ta tsit+ta rbad: ma ma rbad: dum kha li kha li rbad: srog rbad su rbad su: du rba ma du yag pa rbad: khrag tīk+ṣ+ṇa ga ra pa ma shaṃ: yam pa pug pub: srog tsit+ta yaṃ: pa te du ste rbad: sha tsit+ta srog dum kha li yag pa rbad: rbad rbad: kha li duṃ bu: du ya ma du ya: che ge mo'i srog la rbad: oṃ na mo bud+dhā ya: dharmā ya: saṅghā ya: sarba ta thā ga ta kro dha bi dza ye: a nir dza la dza la ni: dza ho nṛ ta: sri ku ru yang : gnod byed rbod gtong pha rol tshur rol la gnod pa thams cad hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa: ma hā pa tsa ha na da ha pa tsa dzā ti lam+bho dha ra u tsuṣ+ma: pad+ma badz+ra ma hā kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa: a sha sa ma ra tsa pa ta ka ṭha sa la phaṭa: tsa dur snying na zlog: ya ma rā tsa sa ma ya zlog: shan traka rak+sha pa sha ma zlog: rak+sha re ma ti shaka mu la zlog: sa ma ya zlog: raka ma re khri pa la rā tsa ye zlog: suṃ tri rā tsa ya zlog: a pa ka ru ṇa zlog:

oṃ a kro te ka ya shrī mañdzu ya ma rā tsa zlog: oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: gṛh+ṇā pa ya gṛh+ṇā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: ā na ya ho: bha ga wān badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: ma ma rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: snying kha raka dun te rbad: srog la rbad: gtub gtub sha la chom: sha rus khrag tsa la nur nur: a ma tsa du tri: na pa ra pa: badz+ra ya ti trika mā ra ya: snying kha raka dun te rbad: triṃ triṃ che ge mo gtub gtub: na maḥs man+ta bud+dhe bh+ya: badz+ra ma hā kro dha ya: ma hā badz+ra hrīḥ ma mo bha sha na: bha ba re ye: dza ya ru hur: tri trir: ta o he: gzhan gyi rbod gtong gtor zor gyi gnod pa thams cad phyir zlog bh+yo: oṃ de ba de ba tad+ya thā: na maḥs man+ta bud+dhe bh+ya: na ya ma li laṃ: than dan ta ya: hu ru hu ru: mu ru mu ru: sarba ru ru: na la ma ra: ri de wa: tad+ya thā: na maḥs man+ta bud+dhe bh+ya: ga ma khud ka rus tsan+dha laṃ ta la khros pa ka ra ya: de ba tad taṃ: na maḥs man+ta bud+dhe bh+ya: ma hā ra ṇa: badz+ra ra bi ni: su ru rū rur ma de ba byu: de niṃ naṃ tha: de ba har taṃ: na maḥs man+ta bud+dhe bh+ya: na maḥ.a kro nā ya: tse mi ta mi ta: ku ta ku ta: bud+dhe bh+ya: ru lu ru lu: a nya si: pad me rus: mi ti ku ru: be shan te ba tad ti: na maḥs man+ta bud+dhe bh+ya: loṃ ta ṭha re cha de ba tad khaṃ: oṃ bha la ni: oṃ bha la taṃ: karma ban+ta ta naṃ: kī la ya naṃ: a po gud kud: ta ni mi ta ra rad: sarba tshin+dha ma: tshin+dha ya: oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: gṛh+ṇā pa ya gṛh+ṇā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: ā na ya ho: bha ga wān badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: sngags 'chang bdag la rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: a ta gh+ra sa sha ta ni: hu lu shu ru: pi sha na tsig ta la ya su pra ta dun ti na: ga ba da dha ya: sha sha ya: ma ni nā ga s+t+waṃ bha ya: tha kṛ ta tri: kri dza gra de ba tsakra warti ā: a pa ra ṇa: la la hūm̐:

tha gi ha gardza ya: ni ma sha ku ru rbud: bhi ru yo ga rbud: dgra bgegs sarba sha trūṃ nṛ tri: nā ga mā ra ya phaṭa: oṃ e ka du na zlog: ma hā du na zlog: sa ga du na zlog: tsa du snying la zlog: sum tri rak+sha du na zlog: rak+sha ti phor du na zlog: oṃ a kro te ka shrī mañdzu ya ma rā tsa zlog: yaṃ te gur thed khrol: ba la de tsam zlog: ma ma rak+ṣa rak+ṣa che ge mo la bh+yo: oṃ badz+ra kā ya gling zlog: badz+ra his baṃ: gha ru ya zlog: badz+ra his ka nan zlog: ha be sa de ya sa ri sa ma ya zlog sod: tri ya kha la ma de zlog sod: bir te bru dza dza dzaḥzlog sod: bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo: dgra bgegs la bh+yo: slar zlog: ted ted zlog: han ti zlog: ma ma k+ṣan zlog: sha pa khrug zlog: che ge mo rgyugs rgyugs: slar sod: oṃ ya mān+ta ka pa ke sa re hūm̐: oṃ te pre te sa ma ya nan: pra tog ga rak+sha nan: zhes dbang bskur bar bya'o: ā we sha ya: pra we sha: ru pe sha: kha thun bh+yo: ta pa la: mu li sarba ru ru ru ru hūm̐ phaṭa: nag mo re ma ti: rā trī ru tri re ma ti bh+yo: zhes bskur ro: ga ru ḍa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭa: ta ki tsa ti: si tsa ti hūm̐: ya hu lu hu lu pu ru te swā hā: zhes dbang bskur zhing bzlog pa bya'o: ban+de la yungs kar dang khrag gis bsgril te mchod rten 'og tu 'dogs so: a kro dur na tsa dur na: sa dur snying la sril sril: a kro rā tsa tsit+ta ni sha la rbad rbad: ya ya rnal ma tri dza: snying la kha thun mā ra ya rbad rbad: rak+mo ni rak+mo ni: kha lo ni kha lo ni: tsit+ta rbad rbad: dug ni rbad rbad: khyi kha lo kyi kha lo tsit+ta rbad rbad: nir ti nir ti rmugs rmugs: suṃ ti suṃ ti tsit+ta rbad rbad: dgra bo'i snying la 'dar yod yod: ces brjod do: de nas gtor ma rnams dgra phyogs su btang zhing : gzhung du shes so: 'di ni khro rol chen mo yin no: zhes pa 'di ni/ gsang sngags kyi rig pa 'dzin pa chen po gnam lcags me 'bar gyis bsgrigs pa'o// khro bo chen po rol pa'i cho ga 'di la sngon chad phyi mo ma dag sna tshogs 'dug par brten/

'bri gung pa dus mtha'i sngags 'chang thugs kyi rdo rjes legs par zhus shing*/ de yang bden stobs brjod pa'i skabs che mchog la rgyas par bris nas/ gzhan rnams 'gres rkang du bzhag 'dug pa dkyil 'khor so so'i dkyus su bcug /gzhan chad lhag yin nges rnams tshig don dang brda dag blos gang chod rnams dag par bcos yod pas khro rol gyi phyi mo gzhan rnams las 'di nyid ches cher dag pa yod mod kyang*/ bzlog cing bh+yos gdab pa'i skabs la sogs pa'i sngags 'ga' zhig 'gres rkang yin pa 'dra ba la'ang*/ dkyil 'khor so so'i skabs mang nyung dang 'dra min 'dug pa sogs ni ma rtogs log rtog gi nyes par 'gyur gyi dogs nas rang sor bzhag /sngags la la ni gsar rnying gi khyad par gyi sgra dang mi mthun pa 'dug kyang lugs de rang du bzhag rnga mo khyung zhon gyi gshog mjug gi ltas ngan gyi gzugs dang ming sogs ni/ gter byon rang du 'dra min gnyis tsam 'dug pa bdag rang gi mig lam du byung bas 'dir yang sngar gang 'dug las cher ma bcos/ lha'i mtshan sogs la lar the tshom yod pa 'dug kyang slar brtag dpyad byed dgos pa'ang yod do// zhes pa yang sngags pa nag po thugs kyi rdo rjes sug bris su btab pa'o// 'di dges rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas par gyur cig gu// //maṅgalaṃ shrī dz+wa la dzam+bu dwī pa a laṅkā ra ā gats+tsha//
